name: SEC EDGAR submissions overflow pages
description: The older-filings continuation file named in the parent submissions JSON's filings.files[] array. Parallel arrays: accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, acceptanceDateTime, act, form, fileNumber, filmNumber, items, size, isXBRL, isInlineXBRL, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription. Without this hop you only ever see the ~1,000 most recent filings of a CIK; with it you reach the full filing history back to 1993.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR per-filing document index
description: Turns one accession number into the full document manifest of that filing: name, type, size, last-modified for every exhibit, the raw .txt dissemination file, the -index-headers.html, the XBRL zip and the primary XML. This is the hop that gets you from 'a filing exists' to the actual exhibit files (Form 4 ownership XML, 13F information table, credit agreements, subsidiary lists).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR company archive folder listing
description: Directory listing of every accession folder ever filed under a CIK, with last-modified timestamps. Folder name is the accession number without dashes, which is exactly the key the per-filing index.json needs. Useful when you have a CIK but no submissions JSON, and for detecting new filings by timestamp.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR Form 3/4/5 insider ownership XML
description: XML (served as text) with issuerCik/issuerName/issuerTradingSymbol, reportingOwnerId (rptOwnerCik, rptOwnerName, address), reportingOwnerRelationship (isDirector/isOfficer/isTenPercentOwner/officerTitle), and every nonDerivativeTransaction / derivativeTransaction with security title, transaction date, code, shares, price per share and shares owned following the transaction. This is the officer-and-beneficial-owner layer behind a listed company.

name: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR information table
description: Position-by-position institutional holdings XML behind a 13F-HR filing: nameOfIssuer, titleOfClass, CUSIP, market value, sshPrnamt/sshPrnamtType, putCall, investmentDiscretion, otherManager index and votingAuthority Sole/Shared/None. Resolves 'which fund owns how much of which company' at security level. The file name comes from the filing folder index.json.

name: SEC XBRL frames (cross-company fact slice)
description: Inverts companyfacts: one XBRL tag + unit + calendar period returns EVERY filer that reported it, as accn, cik, entityName, loc (state/country), end date and val. 6,254 companies for Assets CY2024Q4I, 3,767 for AccountsPayableCurrent CY2023Q1I. Lets you rank or screen all US registrants on a single financial-statement line and gives you the accession + CIK to hop into each filing.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC XBRL frames annual duration slice
description: Same frames mechanism for duration (flow) tags rather than instant tags: CY2024 revenues for every filer that tagged us-gaap:Revenues, with accn, cik, entityName, loc, start, end, val. Period format CY{yyyy} for annual, CY{yyyy}Q{n} for quarterly duration, CY{yyyy}Q{n}I for instant.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC ticker-CIK-exchange master file
description: Columnar variant (fields: cik, name, ticker, exchange; data: array of 4-element rows) that additionally carries the listing venue - Nasdaq, NYSE, NYSE American, CBOE, OTC. Lets you filter a universe by exchange before pivoting into filings.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC mutual-fund series/class ticker file
description: Fields cik, seriesId (S000nnnnnn), classId (C000nnnnnn), symbol - the full registrant -> fund series -> share class -> ticker tree for every registered investment company. Resolves a fund ticker to the filing entity CIK and to the series/class ids used in N-PORT, N-CEN and 485BPOS filings.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR quarterly full index (by form type)
description: Fixed-width text index of every filing disseminated in a quarter: Form Type, Company Name, CIK, Date Filed, File Name (edgar/data/{cik}/{accession}.txt). 5.3 MB for 2025 QTR1. The bulk backbone - sweep all 8-Ks, all SC 13Ds, all Form Ds for a quarter without a single search query. Sibling files company.idx, master.idx, xbrl.idx in the same folder.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR daily index directory
description: JSON listing of the per-day index files (company.YYYYMMDD.idx, form.YYYYMMDD.idx, master.YYYYMMDD.idx, crawler., sitemap.) with size and last-modified. Drives day-granular incremental collection: poll this, fetch only the new .idx, then hop into each accession.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR browse-edgar company filing feed
description: Atom feed carrying a <company-info> block (business and mailing addresses with phone, assigned SIC + description, state of incorporation, former names, fiscal year end, IRS number) plus one <entry> per filing with accession-number, filing-date, filing-href, file-number, act and size. The address/SIC block is data the JSON submissions file presents differently and the former-names history is genuinely useful for entity resolution.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR registrant search by state + SIC
description: Atom list of every registrant located in a US state and classified under a given SIC code, each entry giving cik, sic, state and a link back into that company's filing list. Enumerates a whole industry sector (6022 = state commercial banks, 7372 = prepackaged software) rather than starting from a known name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR registrant name search
description: Name-prefix search over EDGAR registrants returning company-info (addresses, phone, SIC, state of incorporation, former names) and CIK. The name -> CIK pivot for non-listed filers that never appear in company_tickers.json (private issuers, funds, foreign private issuers, Form D filers).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR latest-filings live feed
description: Real-time feed of filings as they are accepted: title carries form type + company name + CIK + filer role, summary carries filing date, accession number, size and the 8-K item numbers disclosed (2.02 Results of Operations, 5.02 Departure of Directors, 1.01 Material Agreement). Link points straight at the accession index. Filterable by type=.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR ownership display - insiders of an issuer
description: HTML table of every Section 16 reporting person for a company: insider name, their own CIK, relationship (Director / Officer / 10% Owner), officer title, and each transaction (date, form type, transaction code, shares, price, ownership form D/I, shares held after). This is literally 'the officers behind the company' with a CIK for each one to pivot on.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC EDGAR ownership display - all issuers of one insider
description: The reverse hop: given an individual's CIK (e.g. 0001214156 = COOK TIMOTHY D) it lists every issuer that person files Section 16 reports for, with relationship and every transaction. Maps one natural person across all the public companies where they sit as director, officer or 10% holder - the cross-directorship graph.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC DERA Financial Statement Data Sets
description: Quarterly ZIP containing sub.txt (one row per submission: adsh, cik, name, SIC, EIN, former name, business/mail address, countryba, fye, form, period, filed, accepted, prevrpt, detail, instance), num.txt (every numeric XBRL fact), pre.txt (statement presentation) and tag.txt. Confirmed by range request - first bytes are the PK zip header with sub.txt as first member. Bulk fundamentals for all filers, no per-company requests.

name: SEC administrative proceedings RSS
description: Named respondents in SEC administrative proceedings - title is the respondent(s) (firm and individuals together, e.g. 'GlennCap LLC and Jonathan Vincent Glenn'), dc:creator is the release number (34-106135, 33-11433), link is the order PDF, pubDate the issue date. Enforcement layer against registrants and their principals.

name: SEC litigation releases RSS
description: SEC civil actions filed in federal court: title lists all defendants by name, dc:creator is the LR-nnnnn release number, link is the release page describing the charges, relief sought and case caption. Pairs with the administrative-proceedings feed to cover both SEC enforcement tracks.

name: FDIC BankFind institutions
description: Every FDIC-insured institution, searchable by any field via filters=FIELD:value. Full record (~200 fields) includes CERT, NAME, ADDRESS, CITY, STALP, ZIP, ACTIVE, ASSET, DEP, NETINC, ROAQ, ESTYMD, INSDATE, ENDEFYMD, CHARTER, CHRTAGNT (OCC/FDIC/state), REGAGNT, FDICSUPV, OCCDIST, FED, NAMEHCR + RSSDHCR (the bank holding company and its RSSD id), WEBADDR, OFFICES, OFFFOR, SPECGRP, CB/MUTUAL flags, CFPB supervision dates. total=1,286 for California, 4,250 active institutions nationwide.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FDIC quarterly call-report financials
description: Detail hop off a CERT: the institution's entire quarterly call-report history (169 quarters back to 1984 for Wells Fargo CERT 3511). Row id is {CERT}_{REPDTE}; hundreds of selectable fields - ASSET, DEP, DEPDOM, NETINC, LNLSNET, LNATRES, EQ, ROA, ROE, NIM, NPTLA, EINTEXP, NUMEMP. Turns one bank into a 40-year financial time series.

name: FDIC branch locations
description: Detail hop off a CERT: every branch office of the institution - UNINUM, FI_UNINUM, OFFNAME, ADDRESS, CITY, COUNTY, STCNTY FIPS, ZIP, LATITUDE/LONGITUDE, ACQDATE, ESTYMD, SERVTYPE + SERVTYPE_DESC (full service brick and mortar, drive-through, mobile), CBSA/CSA/metro-division codes, MDI_STATUS (minority depository institution), BKCLASS. 4,185 branches for CERT 3511.

name: FDIC structure-change history
description: Detail hop off a CERT: the M&A and structure-change ledger - TRANSNUM, CHANGECODE + REPORT_TYPE, EFFYEAR/ACQYEAR, INSTNAME and the predecessor FRM_* block (FRM_INSAGENT1, FRM_REGAGENT, FRM_CLCODE, FRM_OFF_PCITY/PADDR), plus explicit flags: FAILED_RTC_FLAG, ASSISTED_PAYOUT_FLAG, CLASS_CHANGE_FLAG, RELOCATE_FLAG, CHARTER_OTS_TO_COM_FLAG, UNASSIST_OTHER_TO_COM_FLAG. 14,082 events for CERT 3511 - the full acquisition tree of a megabank.

name: FDIC bank failures and assistance transactions
description: All 4,115 US bank failures back to 1934: NAME, CITY, CITYST, PSTALP, CERT, FAILDATE, FAILYR, RESDATE, RESTYPE + RESTYPE1 (PO payout, PA purchase and assumption, PI insured deposit transfer), CHCLASS, QBFASSET and QBFDEP (assets/deposits at failure), COST to the insurance fund, FUND, SAVR, and the acquirer - BIDNAME, BIDCITY, BIDSTATE. Names who took over each failed bank.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FDIC Summary of Deposits (branch-level deposits)
description: Detail hop off a CERT: annual deposits held at each individual branch - YEAR, UNINUMBR, BRSERTYP, ADDRESS, CITY2BR, ZIPBR, STNUMBR/CNTYNUMB FIPS, SIMS_LATITUDE/LONGITUDE, DEPSUMBR (branch deposits) vs DEPSUM/DEPDOM (institution total), ESCROW, plus holding-company linkage NAMEHCR/RSSDHCR/HCTMULT and CHRTAGNT/CHRTAGNN. 120,249 branch-years for CERT 3511 - lets you track a bank's physical footprint and deposit concentration year by year.

name: FDIC institution demographics time series
description: 1,665,311 CERT-by-quarter demographic rows: CERT, REPDTE, CLCODE, OFFTOT/OFFDMULT/OFFSTATE/OFFOTH/OFFNDOM/OFFUSOA/OFFSOD office counts, BRANCH flag, CNTYNUM, CNTRYALP, CBSANAME, METRO/MICRO flags, FDICTERR, RISKTERR, FDICAREA, FLDOFDCA (FDIC field office), MNRTYCDE, OAKAR, SIMS_LAT/LONG. Row id {CERT}_{REPDTE}.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FDIC aggregate industry summary
description: Pre-aggregated banking-industry totals by state and year back to 1934 (134 year-rows for Ohio): BANKS count, plus ~300 aggregated call-report line items - ASSET, DEP, NETINC, LNLSNET, LNRESRE, LNAUTO, EQ, INTBAST, NUMEMP, NEW/REL_CO/PAID_OFF entity-flow counters and TOT_FDIC/TOT_OTS charter mix. Baseline for detecting an outlier institution against its state cohort.

name: FINRA BrokerCheck individual search
description: Name search over 10,640 registered brokers/advisers per common surname. Each hit: ind_source_id (the CRD number), ind_firstname/middlename/lastname, ind_other_names (aliases), ind_bc_scope and ind_ia_scope (Active/InActive/Expanded/NotInScope), ind_bc_disclosure_fl and ind_ia_disclosure_fl (Y = has customer complaints, regulatory actions, criminal or financial disclosures), ind_industry_days, ind_current_employments. The CRD number is the key into the detail record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FINRA BrokerCheck individual full record
description: The deep hop. _source.content is a JSON string containing basicInformation (individualId, full name, otherNames, bcScope, iaScope, daysInIndustry), currentEmployments and currentIAEmployments, and previousEmployments - every firm the person ever worked at with firmId, firmName, bdSECNumber, city/state/country and exact registrationBeginDate / registrationEndDate. Also carries examinations, stateExamCategory, registeredStates and the disclosure records (customer disputes, regulatory actions, terminations, bankruptcies, judgments). Firm-hopping career history for anyone selling securities in the US.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FINRA BrokerCheck firm full record
description: Detail hop off a firmId/CRD: basicInformation with firmName, iaFirmName, otherNames/DBAs, bcScope + iaScope, finraRegistered, districtName, firmType (Corporation/LLC/Partnership), formedState and formedDate, firmSize, firmStatus + firmStatusDate, regulator (SEC or state), finraLastApprovalDate, fiscalMonthEndCode, iaSECNumber / bdSECNumber. Also carries branch counts, disclosure counts and the firm's registered states.

name: SEC IAPD investment-adviser firm search
description: Adviser-side twin of BrokerCheck. Hits give firm_source_id (CRD), firm_name, firm_other_names, firm_ia_sec_number and firm_ia_full_sec_number (the 801-nnnnn / 802-nnnnn registration), firm_ia_scope, firm_ia_disclosure_fl (Y = disciplinary history), firm_branches_count and firm_ia_address_details as an embedded JSON office address including foreign offices. 21 hits for 'blackrock'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC IAPD investment-adviser firm full record
description: Detail hop: _source.iacontent is a JSON string with basicInformation (firmId, firmName, otherNames, iaScope, isIAFirm, legacyReportStatus, advFilingDate - the date of the latest Form ADV, hasPdf flag pointing at the full ADV brochure), plus office addresses, AUM/employee brackets and disclosure records. advFilingDate + hasPdf is the hop into the actual Form ADV Part 1/2 PDF at reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov.

name: SEC IAPD investment-adviser representative search
description: Adviser-representative name index (10,640 hits for 'smith'): ind_source_id (CRD), first/middle/last name, ind_other_names, ind_bc_scope and ind_ia_scope, ind_ia_disclosure_fl, ind_approved_finra_registration_count, ind_employments_count. Same CRD space as BrokerCheck so a person found here resolves in both systems.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SEC IAPD adviser-representative full record
description: Detail hop: iacontent JSON string with basicInformation (individualId, names, otherNames, bcScope, iaScope), currentEmployments, currentIAEmployments, previousEmployments and previousIAEmployments (firmId, firmName, SEC number, city/state, registration begin/end dates), examinations and disclosures. The investment-adviser-side career and discipline record for a named person.

name: FINRA OTC Transparency weekly ATS/OTC volume
description: Keyless FINRA data API (no OAuth needed for the otcMarket group). CSV columns: issueSymbolIdentifier, issueName, firmCRDNumber, MPID, marketParticipantName, tierIdentifier + tierDescription, summaryStartDate, totalWeeklyTradeCount, totalWeeklyShareQuantity, totalNotionalSum, productTypeCode, summaryTypeCode, weekStartDate, lastUpdateDate. Ties a named dark pool / ATS (MPID + CRD) to per-symbol weekly volume - which venue traded which stock and how much.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FINRA OTC Transparency monthly ATS/OTC volume
description: Monthly aggregation of the same venue-by-symbol series: issueSymbolIdentifier, issueName, firmCRDNumber, marketParticipantName, tierIdentifier, summaryStartDate, totalMonthlyTradeCount, totalMonthlyShareQuantity, productTypeCode, summaryTypeCode, monthStartDate, lastUpdateDate.

name: FINRA ATS block-trade summary
description: Per-ATS block-trading profile: MPID, marketParticipantName, summaryStartDate, totalTradeCount, totalShareQuantity, averageTradeSize, averageTradeSizeRank, ATSTradeRank, ATSShareRank, ATSTradePercent, ATSSharePercent, ATSBlockCount, ATSBlockQuantity. Ranks named dark pools against each other on block activity.

name: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume
description: Daily short-sale volume by security and reporting facility: tradeReportDate, securitiesInformationProcessorSymbolIdentifier, shortParQuantity, shortExemptParQuantity, totalParQuantity, marketCode, reportingFacilityCode (NQTRF, NCTRF, ORF). Per-symbol daily short-selling pressure.

name: FINRA consolidated short interest
description: Bi-monthly settlement-date short interest per security: accountingYearMonthNumber, symbolCode, issueName, issuerServicesGroupExchangeCode, marketClassCode, currentShortPositionQuantity, previousShortPositionQuantity, stockSplitFlag, averageDailyVolumeQuantity, daysToCoverQuantity. The official short-interest series behind a listed company.

name: FINRA Reg SHO threshold securities list
description: Securities with persistent failures-to-deliver: tradeDate, issueSymbolIdentifier, issueName, marketClassCode, thresholdListFlag, marketCategoryDescription, regShoThresholdFlag, rule4320Flag. Flags the OTC and listed names under settlement stress.

name: FINRA OTC transparency publication calendar
description: Publication manifest for the weekly OTC/ATS files: lastUpdateDate, tierIdentifier, summaryTypeCode (ATS_W_FIRM, ATS_W_SMBL), weekStartDate. Tells a collector exactly which weeks/tiers are available so it can enumerate the whole series instead of guessing dates.

name: USAspending award detail
description: The core detail hop: generated_unique_award_id -> full award. id, piid, category, type + type_description, description, total_obligation, base_exercised_options, base_and_all_options, subaward_count, total_subaward_amount, date_signed, period_of_performance, account_outlays/obligations_by_defc, parent_award, and latest_transaction_contract_data with solicitation_identifier, solicitation_procedures, number_of_offers_received, extent_competed, type_of_set_aside, naics + product_or_service_code, plus recipient (name, UEI, DUNS, parent UEI, address, business categories), awarding and funding agency/sub-agency/office, and place of performance.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending subawards of a prime award
description: POST {"award_id":"CONT_AWD_72027821C00002_7200_-NONE-_-NONE-","limit":5,"page":1}. Returns the second tier of money: id, subaward_number, description, action_date, amount, recipient_name for each subcontractor/subgrantee under the prime. Verified against an award with 75 subawards (an award with none returns 200 and an empty results array, which is the honest answer, not a failure).

name: USAspending subaward count probe
description: Cheap {"subawards": n} probe telling you whether an award has a subaward tier worth fetching (returned 75 for the FMI/USAID contract, 0 for the Navy ALE-70 contract). Lets a collector skip empty second hops instead of spending a request per award.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending award modification history
description: POST {"award_id":"CONT_AWD_N0001919C0001_9700_-NONE-_-NONE-","limit":5,"page":1}. Every modification under one award: transaction id, type + type_description, action_date, action_type + action_type_description, modification_number (P00001, P00022...), description of what the mod did, federal_action_obligation, face_value_loan_guarantee, original_loan_subsidy_cost. The amendment trail behind a contract.

name: USAspending award funding by treasury account
description: POST {"award_id":"...","limit":3,"page":1,"sort":"reporting_fiscal_date","order":"desc"}. Which appropriations actually paid for an award: transaction_obligated_amount, gross_outlay_amount, disaster_emergency_fund_code, federal_account code + account_title, funding and awarding agency names/ids/slugs, object_class + name, program_activity_code + name, reporting_fiscal_year/quarter/month. NOTE sort must be one of 10 allowed values or the call 400s.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending award federal-account rollup
description: POST {"award_id":"...","limit":3,"page":1}. Rolled-up view of the same money trail: total_transaction_obligated_amount per federal_account, with account_title, funding_agency_abbreviation/name/id and slug. Shorter hop than /awards/funding/ when you only need which accounts fund an award.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending transaction-level keyword search
description: POST {"filters":{"keywords":["Lockheed"],"award_type_codes":[...]},"fields":["Award ID","Mod","Recipient Name","Action Date","Transaction Amount","Awarding Agency","Transaction Description"],"sort":"Transaction Amount","order":"desc"}. Searches individual modifications rather than awards, so free-text in a mod description is findable. Returns the internal transaction id and generated award id for the hop into award detail.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending spending aggregated by recipient
description: POST with a time_period filter. Ranks recipients by total amount and hands back recipient_id, name, uei, code and total_outlays for each - the recipient_id is exactly what /api/v2/recipient/{id}/ takes. Lets you find the top vendors in any slice (agency, NAICS, place of performance, DEF code) and then drill into each one.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending recipient directory
description: POST {"order":"desc","sort":"amount","page":1,"limit":3,"award_type":"all"}. Paginated directory of all 18,295,190 federal award recipients: id (recipient hash + level suffix -R recipient / -P parent / -C child), duns, uei, name, recipient_level, amount. The DUNS/UEI -> internal recipient_id crosswalk.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending recipient profile
description: Detail hop off recipient_id: name plus alternate_names (every historical spelling the entity has been awarded under - 8 aliases for the California DHCS), duns, uei, parent_id / parent_name / parent_duns / parent_uei (the corporate parent link), location (address, city, state, county, congressional district, country), business_types, total_transaction_amount and total_transactions. Entity resolution + corporate parentage for federal vendors.

name: USAspending state recipient profile
description: Detail hop off the state list already in the tree: name, code, fips, type, population + pop_year + pop_source, median_household_income + mhi_year + mhi_source, total_prime_amount, total_prime_awards, award_amount_per_capita. Normalises federal money against population for any state/territory FIPS.

name: USAspending federal accounts list
description: POST {"limit":3,"page":1,"sort":{"field":"budgetary_resources","direction":"desc"}}. All 2,261 treasury federal accounts: account_id, account_number (020-0550), account_name, budgetary_resources, agency_identifier, managing_agency + acronym. The appropriation dimension that /awards/funding/ points into.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending federal account detail
description: Detail hop: fiscal_year, id, agency_identifier, main_account_code, account_title, federal_account_code, parent_agency_toptier_code + name, bureau_name + bureau_slug, total_obligated_amount, total_gross_outlay_amount, total_budgetary_resources, and children[] listing each TAS under the account with its own obligated/outlay/budgetary_resources.

name: USAspending agency profile
description: Detail hop off a toptier agency code: fiscal_year, toptier_code, name, abbreviation, agency_id, mission statement, website, congressional_justification_url, subtier_agency_count, and def_codes[] listing every disaster/emergency funding statute the agency draws on (code, public_law, title, govinfo URL, disaster type).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending agency sub-agency and office breakdown
description: Detail hop: each sub-tier agency (abbreviation, name, total_obligations, transaction_count, new_award_count) with a nested children[] array of the individual CONTRACTING OFFICES (code like 1234HK, name, obligations, transaction and new-award counts). Resolves federal money down to the specific office that signed it - 23 sub-agencies for USDA.

name: USAspending agency federal-account breakdown
description: 157 federal accounts for USDA FY2024, each with code, name, obligated_amount, gross_outlay_amount and children[] listing the treasury account symbols beneath it. The appropriations map of an agency.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending agency object-class breakdown
description: 30 object classes per agency-year with name, obligated_amount and gross_outlay_amount - what the money was spent ON (Grants subsidies and contributions, Insurance claims and indemnities, Personnel compensation, Equipment). Detects an agency's spending mix shifting.

name: USAspending agency program-activity breakdown
description: 457 named program activities for USDA FY2024 with obligated_amount and gross_outlay_amount (BENEFITS ISSUED, BELOW 130 OF POVERTY...). The programme dimension, finer than object class and usable as a filter back into award search.

name: USAspending agency award totals
description: fiscal_year, latest_action_date, toptier_code, transaction_count (1,671,909 for USDA FY2024), obligations, messages[]. Cheap freshness/volume probe telling a collector how much award data exists for an agency-year and when it last moved.

name: USAspending agency reference record
description: agency_name, active_fy, active_fq, outlay_amount, obligated_amount, budget_authority_amount, current_total_budget_authority_amount, mission, website, icon_filename. Resolves the internal numeric agency_id (which appears inside award and funding records) into a named agency with current-year totals.

name: USAspending NAICS hierarchy with award counts
description: Three-level NAICS tree (2-digit -> 4-digit -> 6-digit) with naics, naics_description, year_retired and count of awards under each node. Lets a collector walk an industry code down to the leaf and then use that leaf as a filter in spending_by_award.

name: USAspending federal obligations by account
description: 176 account rows per agency-year with account_title, account_number and obligated_amount, plus page_metadata carrying explicit next/current/previous URLs for exhaustive pagination.

name: USAspending agency data-quality overview
description: 111 agencies with agency_name, abbreviation, toptier_code, agency_id, current_total_budget_authority_amount, recent_publication_date, discrepancy_count, obligation_difference, unlinked contract/assistance award counts and assurance statement URL. This is the metadata that tells you how trustworthy an agency's reported spending is.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending agency TAS reporting discrepancies
description: Detail hop: 15 treasury account symbols where the agency's File A and File B submissions disagree - tas, file_a_obligation, file_b_obligation, difference. Directly surfaces accounting inconsistencies in an agency's own reporting.

name: USAspending data freshness stamp
description: {"last_updated":"08/16/2026"} - single-field probe for when the award database was last refreshed. Lets a scheduler skip a full re-crawl when nothing has changed.

name: FPDS-NG contract award ATOM feed by vendor
description: The authoritative federal contract-writing system, keyless. 165 KB per page of Atom entries, each embedding the full FPDS award XML: awardID (PIID, modNumber, agencyID, referencedIDVID), relevantContractDates, dollarValues (obligatedAmount, baseAndExercisedOptionsValue, baseAndAllOptionsValue), purchaserInformation (contracting office agency + office code), vendor block (vendorName, UEI/CAGE/DUNS, full address, phone, business-size and socio-economic flags, parent vendor name and id), productOrServiceInformation (PSC, NAICS, principalNAICSCode), competition (extentCompeted, solicitationProcedures, numberOfOffersReceived, typeOfSetAside, evaluatedPreference) and placeOfPerformance. Query language accepts any FPDS field.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FPDS-NG contract detail feed by PIID
description: Detail hop: every base award and every modification sharing one PIID, in full FPDS XML (203 KB for the Navy ALE-70 contract). This is the complete amendment history of a single contract straight from the contract-writing system - the same trail USAspending exposes, but with FPDS's richer competition, set-aside and vendor-parent fields.

name: Federal Reserve enforcement actions (full history CSV)
description: 455 KB CSV, columns: Effective Date, Termination Date, Individual (the NAMED person barred or fined), Individual Affiliation (their bank and city/state), Banking Organization (for entity actions), Action (Prohibition from Banking, Written Agreement, Cease and Desist, Civil Money Penalty), URL to the press release, Name, Note. Both the institution-level and the named-individual-level enforcement record of the Federal Reserve, in one file, no scraping.

name: Federal Reserve large commercial bank ranking
description: Fixed-width release ranking every US domestically chartered commercial bank by consolidated assets: Bank Name / Holding Co Name, National Rank, BANK ID (the RSSD identifier), headquarters city/state, charter type, consolidated assets, domestic assets, pct domestic, cumulative pct, domestic branch count, foreign branch count, IBF flag. The RSSD id is the Federal Reserve's entity key and links a bank to its holding company.

name: Federal Reserve Data Download Program
description: Keyless bulk extract for any Fed statistical release (rel=H15 rates, H8 bank assets/liabilities, G19 consumer credit, Z1 flow of funds, CHGDEL charge-offs and delinquencies). Returns Series Description header rows then dated observations, one column per series. Alternative to FRED that needs no API key.

name: NY Fed SOMA portfolio summary
description: Weekly System Open Market Account holdings back to 2003: asOfDate, bills, notesbonds, tips, tipsInflationCompensation, frn, mbs, cmbs, agencies, total. The Fed's own balance sheet composition, keyless JSON. Sibling paths under /api/soma/ expose CUSIP-level holdings.

name: NY Fed primary dealer statistics
description: Primary dealer positions, financing and transaction volumes as asofdate / keyid / value triples (keyid encodes instrument and maturity bucket, e.g. PDMEGNMA-OUTT, PDMEFHLMCNONUMBS-DR30). Aggregated across the ~24 primary dealers - the Fed's counterparty banks.

name: NY Fed secured reference rates (SOFR)
description: effectiveDate, type, percentRate, percentPercentile1/25/75/99, volumeInBillions, revisionIndicator. Path pattern /api/rates/{secured|unsecured}/{sofr|bgcr|tgcr|effr|obfr}/last/{n}.json - the official US benchmark rates with their volume and distribution, keyless.

name: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA filer list
description: Every mortgage lender that reported HMDA loan records in a state-year, with lei (the Legal Entity Identifier - the global corporate key), name, count of loan records and period. 29 KB for California 2023. The LEI makes this joinable to GLEIF, SEC and FDIC data, and the count tells you a lender's origination volume in that state.

name: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA data browser aggregations
description: Aggregated mortgage counts and dollar sums over any HMDA dimension combination - years, states, counties, msamds, leis, actions_taken, races, sexes, ethnicities, loan_types, loan_purposes, dwelling_categories, total_units. Returned 433,460 originations totalling $231.7bn for CA 2023. At least one non-geographic filter is required or it 400s with the list of valid criteria.

name: IRS Exempt Organizations BMF (region 4 / territories)
description: Same 28-column schema as eo1.csv covering the remaining IRS regions and US territories (Puerto Rico etc.). Collecting eo1 through eo4 gives the complete national EO Business Master File - roughly 1.8 million exempt entities with officer care-of names, assets, income and revenue.

name: IRS Form 990 e-file index
description: 91 MB CSV listing every electronically filed 990 for a year. Columns: RETURN_ID, FILING_TYPE, EIN, TAX_PERIOD, SUB_DATE, TAXPAYER_NAME, RETURN_TYPE (990 / 990EZ / 990PF), DLN, OBJECT_ID, XML_BATCH_ID. The OBJECT_ID is the filename of the full return XML - which contains officer/director/trustee names and compensation, grants paid to named recipients, and related-organisation schedules. EIN joins straight to the BMF.

name: IRS automatic revocation of exemption list
description: ZIP (confirmed by range request; member is data-download-revocation.txt) listing every organisation whose tax-exempt status was automatically revoked for failing to file for three consecutive years: EIN, legal name, doing-business-as, address, subsection, revocation date, revocation posting date and any reinstatement date. The negative-status counterpart to the BMF.

name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (financial futures)
description: Weekly positioning by trader category for every financial futures contract: market and exchange name, report date, CFTC contract market code, open interest, then long/short/spreading positions for dealer-intermediary, asset manager, leveraged funds, other reportables and non-reportables, week-over-week changes, percent-of-open-interest and the NUMBER OF TRADERS in each category. Sibling files in /dea/newcot/ cover commodities and disaggregated formats.

name: NCUA credit union quarterly call report data
description: 8.2 MB ZIP (members include AcctDesc.txt, Acct-DescTradeNames.txt, FOICU.txt, FOICUDES.txt, Credit Union Branch Information.txt and the numbered FS220 schedules) with the full quarterly call report of every federally insured credit union: charter number, name, address, branch list, peer group, total assets, loans by type, delinquency, net worth ratio, membership counts. This is the only reachable NCUA bulk source - mapping.ncua.gov's API paths all return the Angular SPA shell instead of JSON.

name: CourtListener court registry
description: 3,359 courts, keyless: id (the court slug used as a filter everywhere else, e.g. scotus, cand, nysd), full_name, short_name, citation_string, jurisdiction, start/end dates, in_use, has_opinion_scraper, has_oral_argument_scraper, pacer_court_id and pacer_has_rss_feed. Needed to translate a court slug in a search hit into a real court, and to enumerate which courts have live PACER RSS feeds.

name: EPA ECHO — cross-programme facility search
description: Search all EPA-regulated facilities by name/state/SIC/NAICS. Returns a query summary: QueryRows (11,734 for 'exxon'), plus counts of significant violations (SVRows), current violations (CVRows), 3-yr violations (V3Rows), formal enforcement actions (FEARows), informal actions (InfFEARows), inspections (INSPRows), TotalPenalties ($11,075,965), and per-statute row counts CAARows/CWARows/RCRRows/TRIRows — and a QueryID that unlocks the actual facility rows.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — facility info + geographic clustering
description: Same universe as get_facilities but echoes back QueryParameters, ClusterOutput (county-level lat/lon clusters with ClusterName/ClusterIcon), IconBaseURL/PopUpBaseURL, plus the violation/inspection/penalty roll-up. QueryID feeds get_qid for the rows.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — facility rows for a query id
description: The row-level payload behind an ECHO search. Per facility: FacName, FacStreet/City/State/Zip/County, RegistryID (FRS id, the key into every other EPA system), FacSICCodes/FacNAICSCodes, lat/lon, FacSNCFlg (significant non-compliance), FacQtrsWithNC, FacComplianceStatus, per-statute CAA/CWA/RCRA/SDWA compliance status, FacInspectionCount, FacDateLastInspection, FacDateLastFormalAction, FacPenaltyCount, FacDateLastPenalty, CAAPenalties, CAAHpvFlag (high priority violator), CAA/RCRA/SDWA 3-yr quarterly compliance history strings, TRIReleasesTransfers. NOTE: qid is a recycled server cache slot — always take it from the QueryID of the paired search call.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — Detailed Facility Report (DFR)
description: THE deep hop: one FRS RegistryID expands into the full compliance dossier — MultipleFRSFacilities, Reports flags (HasPollRpt/HasAimRpt/HasBiosolidAnnualRpt/HasBflmRpt), and a Permits array carrying, per EPA system (FRS/ICIS-AIR/NPDES/RCRAInfo/SDWIS/TRI), the Statute, EPASystem, EPARegion, SourceID, facility name/address/FIPS/county, Universe, permit ExpDate, lat/lon, IndianCountry flag, SIC/NAICS and geocoding provenance. Downstream sections carry inspections, violations, formal/informal enforcement actions and penalties for that facility.

name: EPA ECHO — Clean Air Act (ICIS-AIR) facility search
description: CAA-only universe. Summary gives QueryRows 947, SVRows/CVRows/V3Rows violation counts, FEARows 31 formal + InfFEARows 42 informal enforcement actions, INSPRows 124 inspections, FCERows 121 full compliance evaluations, TotalPenalties $7,681,243, and a QueryID. Rows via air get_qid: AIRName, SourceID (ICIS-AIR plant id), address, local control agency, HPV flag, evaluation and penalty history.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — Clean Water Act (NPDES) facility search
description: CWA/NPDES permit-holder universe. Summary: QueryRows 698, SVRows/CVRows/V3Rows, BioCVRows/BioV3Rows (biosolids), VioLast4QRows 57 (violations in last 4 quarters), FEARows/InfFEARows, INSPRows 96, TotalPenalties $416,488, QueryID. Rows via cwa get_qid: CWPName, SourceID (NPDES permit number), address, permit status, SNC status.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — RCRA hazardous-waste handler search
description: RCRAInfo handler universe. Summary: QueryRows 5,848, SVRows/CVRows/V3Rows violations, FEARows/InfFEARows enforcement, INSPRows 79 evaluations, TotalPenalties $232,321, QueryID. Rows via rcra get_qid: RCRAName, SourceID (EPA Handler ID e.g. NJD986604429), address, handler universe, compliance status.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — Safe Drinking Water Act public water systems
description: Public water systems by state. Summary: QueryRows 1,135, SVRows/CVRows/V3Rows violations, FEARows 15 formal + InfFEARows 284 informal actions, INSPRows 491 site visits, QueryID. Rows via sdw get_qid under Results.WaterSystems: PWSName, PWSId, CitiesServed, CountiesServed, StateCode, EPARegion, system type, population served, violation and enforcement counts.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — federal enforcement case search (by statute)
description: EPA civil/criminal enforcement case docket filtered by statute (p_law = CAA|CWA|RCRA|SDWA|EPCRA|TSCA|CERCLA|FIFRA). Summary returns QueryRows 12,695, JDCRows 176 judicial, AFRRows 12,518 administrative-formal, FedPenRows 8,599 cases with federal penalties, SEPRows 674 supplemental environmental projects, CriminalRows, and per-statute breakdowns, plus QueryID. Rows via case get_qid under Results.Cases: CaseNumber, CaseName (the defendant), CaseCategoryDesc, CaseStatusDesc, DOJDocketNmbr, CourtDocketNumber, PrimaryLaw, PrimarySection, DateFiled, DateLodged, SettlementDate, FedPenalty, SEPCost, CostRecovery, StateLocPenaltyAmt, PrimaryNAICSCode, ActivityID, EnfOutcome, CivilCriminalIndicator, Lead, TribalLandFlag.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ECHO — enforcement case detail report
description: Full record behind one enforcement case, keyed on ActivityId (NOT case number). Returns ActivityId, CaseNumber, CaseName, CaseType, CaseStatus + date, RegionalDocketNumber, DOJDocketNumber, Lead agency, ReliefSought, EnforcementOutcome, HeadquartersDivision, Branch, ResultVolDisclosure (voluntary self-disclosure), MultiMediaCase flag, EnforcementType, TotalFederalPenalty, TotalStatePenalty, PenaltyCollected, plus defendant/facility linkage, statutes and sections violated, milestones and compliance-action amounts.

name: EPA ECHO — NPDES effluent (DMR) discharge history
description: 871 KB per permit. Every discharge-monitoring-report measurement for an NPDES permit: permit identity (CWPName/Street/City/State/Zip, CWPPermitStatusDesc, CWPMajorMinorStatusFlag, CWPPermitTypeDesc, CWPCurrentSNCStatus, CWPComplianceTracking), then PermFeatures (outfalls) → Parameters (pollutant code + description) → per-monitoring-period limit value, DMR reported value, exceedance percentage and violation code. This is the raw evidence behind a water-pollution violation.

name: EPA ECHO — NPDES effluent violation summary by outfall/parameter
description: Compact version of the DMR history: permit identity plus PermFeatures[] (PermFeatureNmbr, PermFeatureTypeCode/Desc e.g. 'External Outfall') each carrying Parameters[] with ParameterCode, ParameterDesc, MaxVioStatus and CurrentVioStatus — i.e. which pollutant at which outfall is currently in violation. StartDate/EndDate bound the window.

name: EPA ECHO — bulk CSV export of a query
description: Dumps an entire ECHO query result set as CSV instead of paging get_qid. Columns are selected by index via qcolumns (1,2,3 = FacName, FacStreet, FacCity; RegistryID always included). 30,577 data rows in the observed response. Same qid-recycling caveat: take qid from the paired search call's QueryID.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI facility master
description: Toxics Release Inventory reporting facilities. Per row: tri_facility_id, facility_name, street_address, city_name, county_name, state_county_fips_code, state_abbr, zip_code, EPA region, fac_closed_ind, and the full mailing-address block (mail_name/street/city). Filter by any column: /efservice/tri_facility/<column>/<value>/rows/0:N/JSON. Joins straight into tri_reporting_form.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI Form R submissions
description: One row per chemical per facility per reporting year. doc_ctrl_num (the join key to release/transfer quantities), tri_facility_id, tri_chem_id, form_type_ind, reporting_year, certif_name and certif_official_title (the NAMED EXECUTIVE who signed the toxics report), certif_signature, certif_date_signed, postmark_date, partial_fac/entire_fac, max_amount_of_chem, active_status.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI on-site release quantities
description: The actual pollution numbers behind a Form R: doc_ctrl_num, environmental_medium ('AIR FUG', 'AIR STACK', water/land media), water_sequence_num, release_range_code, total_release, release_na flag, release_basis_est_code (M = measured, E = estimated). Join on doc_ctrl_num from tri_reporting_form.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI off-site waste transfers
description: Where a facility's toxic waste was SENT: doc_ctrl_num, transfer_loc_num (receiving site), off_site_amount_sequence, type_of_waste_management (e.g. P91), transfer_range_code, total_transfer, transfer_est_na, transfer_basis_est_code. Chains facility → chemical → receiving disposal site.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI chemical dictionary
description: Resolves tri_chem_id to a substance: chem_name, active_date/inactive_date, caac_ind (Clean Air Act chemical), carc_ind (carcinogen), r3350_ind, metal_ind, feds_ind, classification, pbt_start_year (persistent bioaccumulative toxic).

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS program-system facility crosswalk
description: Maps a facility to every EPA programme system it appears in — filter by pgm_sys_acrnm (RCRAINFO, ICIS-AIR, NPDES, TRIS, SDWIS, AIRS/AFS, CERCLIS, EIS, GHG) and by state_code. Carries location_address, std_full_address, std_city_name, country_name, tribal_land_name, federal_agency_code, standardised street components, create/update/refresh dates. This is the join table that lets one company name reach all its permits.

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS facility site master
description: The Facility Registry Service master record — the canonical EPA identity for a regulated site. state_name, location_address, std_full_address and standardised address components (std_base_name, std_stype_before/after, std_city_name), country_name, tribal_land_name, federal_agency_code, parent linkage, user_id/create_date/update_date provenance. Registry ID here is the key used by ECHO's DFR.

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS NAICS industry codes per facility
description: naics_uin, pgm_sys_acrnm, pgm_sys_id (the programme-system facility id), naics_code, primary_indicator (PRIMARY/SECONDARY), source_of_data, last_reported_date, create_date/update_date. Lets you pivot 'all regulated sites in industry X'.

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS SIC industry codes per facility
description: sic_uin, pgm_sys_acrnm, pgm_sys_id, sic_code, primary indicator, source of data and reporting dates. SIC counterpart of frs_naics for the older programme systems.

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS regulatory interest records
description: Which regulatory 'interest' each programme system asserts over a facility: pgm_sys_acrnm, pgm_sys_id, interest_type (e.g. STATE MASTER, AIR MAJOR, TRI REPORTER), fed_state_code, start_date/start_date_qualifier, end_date/end_date_qualifier, create source. Shows when a site entered and left each regulatory universe.

name: EPA SDWIS — public water system master
description: Every regulated public water system. pwsid (the key for the whole SDWIS family), pws_name, primacy_agency_code, epa_region, season_begin/end_date, pws_activity_code, pws_deactivation_date, pws_type_code (CWS/TNCWS/NTNCWS), gw_sw_code (groundwater/surface), dbpr and lt2 schedule categories, cds_id, population served. Pivots directly to that system's drinking-water violations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA SDWIS — drinking water violations
description: Every Safe Drinking Water Act violation for a system. pwsid, violation_id, facility_id, population_served_count, pws_activity_code, primary_source_code, pop_cat_5_code, primacy_agency_code, epa_region, pws_type_code, violation_code, violation_category_code (MCL / MRDL / TT / MR / MON / RPT), is_health_based_ind, contaminant, compliance period begin/end, RTC (return-to-compliance) date and status, public-notification tier.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA SDWIS — drinking water enforcement actions
description: What the regulator DID about the violations: pwsid, enforcement_id, originator_code (R = state/regional), enforcement_date, enforcement_action_type_code (EFG = formal notice, SOX/SIX/SFX = orders, penalties), enforcement_comment_text. The violation → enforcement pair for every US public water system.

name: EPA SDWIS — Lead and Copper Rule sampling events
description: Lead/copper monitoring rounds per system: pwsid, sample_id, sampling_start_date, sampling_end_date, reconciliation_id, primacy_agency_code, epa_region. sample_id is the key into lcr_sample_result for the measured lead concentrations.

name: EPA SDWIS — Lead and Copper Rule sample results
description: The measured values behind each LCR sampling event: pwsid, sample_id, primacy_agency_code, sample measure, unit of measure, contaminant code, result sign code and sar_id. Note: filtering on sample_id returns HTTP 500 — filter on pwsid instead.

name: EPA SDWIS — physical facilities within a water system
description: Wells, intakes, treatment plants and storage inside a PWS: pwsid, facility_id, facility_name, state_facility_id, facility_activity_code, facility_deactivation_date, facility_type_code, submission_status_code, is_source_ind, water_type_code, availability_code, seller/treatment linkage. Lets a violation be pinned to a specific well or plant.

name: EPA SDWIS — treatment processes per facility
description: pwsid, facility_id, treatment_id, comments_text (free text, e.g. 'Membrane filter plant with iron removal prior to filters'), treatment_objective_code, treatment_process_code. Explains what treatment exists — or is missing — where a treatment-technique violation was cited.

name: EPA SDWIS — geographic area served by a water system
description: pwsid, geo_id, primacy_agency_code, epa_region, pws_activity_code, pws_type_code, tribal_code, state_served, ansi_entity_code, zip_code_served, city/county served. Turns a violating PWSID into the population and territory actually affected.

name: EPA SDWIS — service area type per water system
description: pwsid, primacy_agency_code, epa_region, pws_activity_code, pws_type_code, service_area_type_code (RA = residential area, school, hospital, industrial…), is_primary_service_area_code. Identifies whether a violating system serves homes, a school or a hospital.

name: EPA PCS — NPDES permitted discharger master
description: Permit Compliance System discharger record: npdes (permit number, the join key), name_1 and name_2 (facility and process description), major_discharge_indicator, region, city_code/city_name, county_code/county_name, state, SIC, permit dates. Pivots to that permit's inspections and enforcement actions.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA PCS — NPDES inspections per permit
description: Every water-discharge inspection recorded against an NPDES permit: npdes, insp_date, insp_type (C = compliance evaluation, S = sampling, etc.), insp_code. Filterable by npdes — a direct 'facility → its inspections' hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA PCS — NPDES enforcement actions per permit
description: Formal actions taken against a discharge permit: npdes, enfor_action_code, enfor_action_type (E = enforcement), enfor_action_date, enfor_action_stat_code (CL = closed) and status date, enfor_action_resp_due_date, docket/order references. The 'what did the regulator do' layer on top of pcs_inspection.

name: EPA ICIS — modern NPDES permit records
description: ICIS-NPDES permit table (successor to PCS): complete_app_received_date, appeal_flag, grace-period and effective/expiration dates, permit type and status, issuing agency, major/minor designation. Filterable by any column via the /efservice/<table>/<col>/<val>/ pattern.

name: EPA ICIS — facility interest records
description: Facility-side of ICIS-NPDES: location_address, city, state, zip, geocoding coordinates and format code, facility UIN, federal/state flag. Joins ICIS permits to physical sites and to FRS.

name: EPA RCRA Biennial Report — hazardous waste generation
description: Biennial hazardous-waste report rows: handler_id (EPA Handler ID), activity_location (state), source_type (B = biennial), sequence number, waste description, generation quantity, management method and receiving facility. The tonnage behind a RCRA generator.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA RCRA Biennial Report — waste codes per handler
description: Which specific hazardous-waste codes a handler reported: handler_id, activity_location, source_type, seq_number, hz_pg (hazardous waste page), waste_code_owner (HQ = federal, or state), waste_code (e.g. D009 = mercury). Turns a generator id into the actual toxics it handles.

name: EPA GHGRP — greenhouse gas reporting facility dimension
description: Mandatory greenhouse-gas reporters: facility_id, facility_name, latitude/longitude, address1/address2, city, state, state_name, zip, county and county_fips, naics_code, reporting year, bamm_used_desc (best-available-monitoring-method), emission classification. facility_id joins to sector emissions.

name: EPA GHGRP — sector greenhouse gas emissions by facility-year
description: facility_id, year, sector_id, subsector_id and the reported gas quantities (CO2e by sector). Joined to pub_dim_facility this gives per-plant annual emissions for every large US emitter.

name: openFDA — adverse drug event detail by safety report id
description: DETAIL HOP: expands one FAERS safety report id into the complete case — patient age/sex/weight, patient.reaction[] (MedDRA preferred terms + outcome), patient.drug[] with medicinalproduct, drugcharacterization (suspect/concomitant), dosage, route, indication, start/end dates and nested openfda block (brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_name, substance_name, product_ndc, unii, rxcui, spl_id), serious/seriousnessdeath/hospitalization flags, occurcountry, primarysource qualification, sender/receiver, transmission dates.

name: openFDA — adverse reaction frequency profile for a drug
description: Faceted aggregation: for a given brand/generic/manufacturer, returns the ranked list of MedDRA reaction terms with counts (results[].term, results[].count). Answers 'what does this product actually harm people with, and how often' in one request instead of paging every report.

name: openFDA — device adverse events (MAUDE) by brand
description: 34,389 matching MDR reports. Each carries mdr_report_key, report_number, event_type (Malfunction/Injury/Death), date_received, date_of_event, patient[] outcomes and sequence numbers, device[] with brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_d_name and full address, model_number, catalog_number, lot_number, device_report_product_code, implant/explant dates, and mdr_text[] — the narrative describing what went wrong.

name: openFDA — 510(k) clearance detail by K-number
description: DETAIL HOP on a device clearance: k_number, applicant, contact, address_1/2, city/state/postal_code/country_code, date_received, decision_date, decision_code/description, clearance_type, product_code, advisory_committee and description, review_advisory_committee, statement_or_summary, third_party_flag, expedited_review_flag, device_name, plus the openfda block (device_class, regulation_number, medical_specialty_description). Links a marketed device back to the firm that cleared it.

name: openFDA — PMA premarket approval detail by PMA number
description: DETAIL HOP: pma_number, supplement_number and supplement_type/reason, applicant, street/city/state/zip, generic_name, trade_name, product_code, advisory_committee, date_received, decision_date, decision_code, expedited_review_flag, ao_statement (the approval-order text), docket_number, and openfda device_class/regulation_number.
