name: openFDA — Unique Device Identifier record detail
description: DETAIL HOP into the GUDID: public_device_record_key, public_version_number/date/status, device_description, brand_name, version_or_model_number, catalog_number, company_name, labeler DUNS, identifiers[] (GTIN/DI values and issuing agency), device_sizes, sterilization info, mri_safety, is_rx/is_otc/is_kit/is_combination_product, has_lot_or_batch_number/serial_number/expiration_date, product_codes[], customer_contacts[], device_publish/commercial_distribution dates.

name: openFDA — device product-code classification detail
description: DETAIL HOP that resolves the product_code appearing on every MAUDE report, recall and 510(k): device_name, medical_specialty_description, device_class, regulation_number, definition, physical_state, technical_method, target_area, gmp_exempt_flag, implant_flag, life_sustain_support_flag, third_party_flag, review_panel, submission_type_id, unclassified_reason.

name: openFDA — device recall detail by recall event number
description: DETAIL HOP: groups every product line under one recall event. res_event_number, product_res_number, firm_fei_number, recalling_firm and address, event_date_initiated/posted/terminated, recall_status, root_cause_description (WHY it failed), reason_for_recall, action, product_code, product_quantity, distribution_pattern, code_info, k_numbers[] and pma_numbers[] (linking the recall back to the clearance that allowed it), other_submission_description.

name: openFDA — device enforcement report detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP on the formal FDA enforcement report: recall_number, classification (Class I/II/III), status, recalling_firm and full address, event_id, product_type, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, and openfda linkage.

name: openFDA — drug enforcement report detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP: full FDA drug recall enforcement record — recall_number, classification, status, recalling_firm, city/state/country/postal_code, event_id, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, plus openfda (application_number, brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_name, product_ndc, substance_name, unii, spl_id).

name: openFDA — Drugs@FDA application detail by NDA/ANDA/BLA number
description: DETAIL HOP: application_number, sponsor_name, products[] (product_number, reference_drug, brand_name, active_ingredients[] with strength, dosage_form, route, marketing_status, te_code), submissions[] — every supplement with submission_type, submission_number, submission_status and date, review_priority, submission_class_code_description, and application_docs[] with URLs to the approval letters, labels and review packages.

name: openFDA — National Drug Code directory detail
description: DETAIL HOP: product_ndc, generic_name, labeler_name, brand_name and suffix, active_ingredients[], finished flag, packaging[] (package_ndc, description, marketing_start_date, sample flag), listing_expiration_date, marketing_category, dosage_form, route[], product_type, marketing_start/end_date, application_number, pharm_class[], dea_schedule. Resolves an NDC seen on a recall or adverse event back to its labeler.

name: openFDA — food recall enforcement detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP: recall_number, classification, status, recalling_firm with full address, event_id, product_type, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, more_code_info.

name: openFDA — CAERS food/supplement adverse events by industry
description: 54,906 matching CAERS reports for the dietary-supplement industry code. Each record: report_number, date_created, date_started, outcomes[] (Hospitalization, Death, Life Threatening…), reactions[] (MedDRA terms), consumer age/gender, and products[] with name_brand, industry_code, industry_name and role (Suspect/Concomitant). Pivots a supplement brand to the harm it is reported to have caused.

name: openFDA — device establishment registration & listing by registration number
description: DETAIL HOP: 209 listings under one registration. Returns registration{registration_number, fei_number, name, owner_operator{firm_name, owner_operator_number, official_correspondent, contact_address}, address, us_agent, status_code, initial_importer_flag, reg_expiry_date_year}, proprietary_name[], products[] (product_code, created_date, owner_operator_number, exempt flag), establishment_type[] (manufacturer / contract sterilizer / repackager…), k_number and pma_number linkage. Turns a registered plant into everything it makes.

name: openFDA — FDA historical document archive
description: 8,858 documents. Per record: doc_type, title, text/body, num (document number) and date. Endpoint the tree does not currently carry; useful for archival FDA notices and regulatory correspondence.

name: openFDA — tobacco product problem reports (date-ranged)
description: 514 reports in the 2020-2026 window. Per record: report_id, date_submitted, tobacco_products[] (product category), reported_health_problems[] and reported_product_problems[] (device malfunction, overheating, explosion, burns), number_tobacco_products, number_health_problems, number_product_problems. Demonstrates the range-query syntax the tree's bare limit-only tobacco call lacks.

name: NHTSA — consumer safety complaints by vehicle
description: 345 complaints for one make/model/year. Each: odiNumber, manufacturer, crash and fire booleans, numberOfInjuries, numberOfDeaths, dateOfIncident, dateComplaintFiled, partial VIN, components (POWER TRAIN, ENGINE, FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM…), and the free-text summary written by the owner. This is the raw defect-signal layer under a recall.

name: NHTSA — recall detail by campaign number
description: DETAIL HOP: expands one NHTSA recall campaign into all affected model rows. Per row: Manufacturer, NHTSACampaignNumber, parkIt / parkOutSide / overTheAirUpdate flags, ReportReceivedDate, Component, PotentialNumberofUnitsAffected (5,376 in the observed record), Summary, Consequence, Remedy, Notes, ModelYear/Make/Model. 'recall → affected units' exactly as required.

name: NHTSA — makes with complaints for a model year
description: 109 makes with complaint records for MY2024 (issueType=c; the tree only carries issueType=r for recalls). Each row: modelYear, make. The enumeration entry point for a full complaint crawl.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NHTSA — models with complaints for a make/year
description: 29 models. Rows of modelYear, make, model — the second enumeration hop that feeds complaintsByVehicle. Completes make → model → complaints without guessing model strings.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NHTSA NCAP — safety rating vehicle lookup
description: Resolves a year/make/model to VehicleDescription and VehicleId — the id required for the crash-test detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NHTSA NCAP — crash test result detail by VehicleId
description: DETAIL HOP: OverallRating, OverallFrontCrashRating, FrontCrashDriverside/PassengersideRating, OverallSideCrashRating and its sub-ratings, RolloverRating and RolloverPossibility, plus direct static.nhtsa.gov URLs to the crash-test photographs and videos. Government-run destructive test evidence per vehicle.

name: NHTSA vPIC — all registered vehicle manufacturers
description: 100 manufacturers per page. Per row: Mfr_ID, Mfr_Name, Mfr_CommonName, Country, VehicleTypes[] with IsPrimary flag. The enumeration list whose Mfr_Name feeds the manufacturer-detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NHTSA vPIC — manufacturer corporate detail
description: DETAIL HOP: 14 registered entities matching 'honda'. Per entity: Mfr_ID, Mfr_Name, Mfr_CommonName, Address, Address2, City, State/PostalCode, Country, ContactEmail, ContactPhone, ContactFax, DBAs, PrincipalFirstName/LastName, ManufacturerTypes[], VehicleTypes[], EquipmentItems[], LastUpdated. Named contacts and addresses for every vehicle/equipment manufacturer registered with NHTSA.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall detail by RecallID
description: DETAIL HOP: RecallID, RecallNumber, RecallDate, Description, URL, Title, ConsumerContact, LastPublishDate, plus nested arrays Products[] (Name, Description, Model, Type, CategoryID, NumberOfUnits), Inconjunctions[], Images[], Injuries[], ManufacturerCountries[], ProductUPCs[], Hazards[] (HazardType, Name), Remedies[], RemedyOptions[], Retailers[], Distributors[], Importers[], Manufacturers[] (company name + country). Recall → affected units, hazards, and the whole supply chain named.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall lookup by recall number
description: Same full recall envelope as RecallID but keyed on the public RecallNumber string as printed on notices (dashes are optional: 24-001 resolves to RecallNumber '24001'). Useful when pivoting from a press release or a retailer notice.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall search by product name
description: 85 recalls matching 'helmet', each a complete recall record (not a stub) with Products/Hazards/Injuries/Manufacturers/Importers/Retailers arrays. Free-text product pivot the tree lacks — the tree only carries the RecallDateStart form.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recalls in a date window
description: 902 KB covering H1-2026 recalls with the full nested envelope per recall (Products, Hazards, Injuries, Remedies, Manufacturers, Importers, Retailers, Distributors, ManufacturerCountries, ProductUPCs). The bounded-window form for incremental crawling; RecallDateEnd is the parameter the tree's existing open-ended call omits.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OSHA IMIS — establishment inspection search
description: Keyless replacement for the dead data.dol.gov OSHA feed. Search inspections by employer name, state, area office, site zip, case type and whether violations exist, over an explicit date range. Result table gives, per inspection: Activity Nr (the id, format 1910693.015), inspection date, establishment name and site address, RID/area office, inspection type, scope, SIC/NAICS, and violation counts — each row linking to the inspection detail page.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OSHA IMIS — inspection detail with violation items
description: DETAIL HOP (50 KB): the full inspection record — establishment name and address, inspection type/scope, opened/closed conference dates, case status, safety/health designation, union status, SIC/NAICS, ownership type, and the Violation Items table: citation ID, citation type (Serious / Willful / Repeat / Other), OSHA Standard cited, issuance date, abatement due date, current penalty, initial penalty, FTA penalty, contest status and final order date. 'Facility → its violations and fines.'

name: MSHA — mine master file (bulk)
description: 7.3 MB zip containing Mines.txt, a pipe-delimited extract of every mine MSHA regulates: MINE_ID (the join key for all other MSHA files), CURRENT_MINE_NAME, operator name and id, controller name and id (corporate parent), state/county/FIPS, mine type (Underground/Surface/Facility), coal-or-metal flag, current status and status date, primary SIC/commodity, number of employees, portal/office address. Keyless recovery of the MSHA layer that now sits behind an API key on apiprod.dol.gov.

name: MSHA — mine inspections (bulk)
description: Zip (verified PK header, full body served) of every MSHA mine inspection: EVENT_NO, MINE_ID, inspection begin/end dates, inspection activity codes, inspector hours on site, number of violations issued, and the district/field office. Joins to Violations.zip on EVENT_NO and to Mines.zip on MINE_ID — the mine → its inspections → its citations chain.

name: MSHA — mine safety violations (bulk)
description: Zip of every citation and order MSHA has issued: VIOLATION_NO, MINE_ID, EVENT_NO, CONTRACTOR_ID, violation occur date, CFR standard cited, section of act, citation type (104(a) citation, 104(d) order, imminent danger 107(a)), S&S (significant and substantial) flag, negligence and likelihood, injury/illness severity, persons affected, proposed and current penalty, termination date, and final order date.

name: MSHA — mine accidents, injuries and fatalities (bulk)
description: Zip of MSHA accident/injury/illness reports: MINE_ID, CONTRACTOR_ID, accident date and time, degree of injury (including fatalities), UG location, mining equipment involved, occupation and experience of the injured person, days lost/restricted, classification and accident type, narrative description, and the return-to-work date.

name: MSHA — assessed violation penalties (bulk)
description: Zip of the money side of MSHA enforcement: VIOLATION_NO, MINE_ID, CONTRACTOR_ID, assessment case number, proposed penalty, contested flag, penalty points by criterion (history, size, negligence, gravity, good faith), current assessment amount, amount paid and outstanding balance, and delinquency status.

name: MSHA — quarterly mine employment and production (bulk)
description: Zip of quarterly operator reports: MINE_ID, calendar year and quarter, subunit, average employee count, employee hours worked, coal production. Provides the denominator (hours worked) that turns raw violation counts into a comparable injury/violation rate per mine.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home health deficiencies
description: Every health-survey citation against every US nursing home. Per row: cms_certification_number_ccn, provider_name and address, survey_date, survey_type, deficiency_prefix (F-tag), deficiency_category, deficiency_tag_number, deficiency_description, scope_severity_code, complaint/standard/infection-control flags, correction date, citation_id. Filterable to one facility with conditions[0][property]=cms_certification_number_ccn.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home penalties and fines
description: Federal penalties imposed on nursing homes. Per row: cms_certification_number_ccn, provider_name and address, penalty_date, penalty_type ('Fine' or 'Payment Denial'), fine_id, fine_amount (observed $182,968), payment_denial_start_date, payment_denial_length_in_days, location, processing_date. The money layer that pairs with the deficiency citations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home ownership
description: BENEFICIAL OWNERSHIP behind every nursing home. Per row: cms_certification_number_ccn, provider_name/address, role_played_by_owner_or_manager_in_facility ('5% OR GREATER DIRECT OWNERSHIP INTEREST', 'OPERATIONAL/MANAGERIAL CONTROL', 'PARTNERSHIP INTEREST'), owner_type (Individual/Organization), owner_name, ownership_percentage, association_date, processing_date. Filterable by CCN — this is the 'who actually owns the facility that was fined' hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home fire safety deficiencies
description: Life-safety-code citations: cms_certification_number_ccn, provider_name/address, survey_date, survey_type 'Fire Safety', deficiency_prefix 'K', deficiency_category (e.g. Smoke Deficiencies), deficiency_tag_number, tag_version, deficiency_description, scope/severity, correction date. Same CCN filter as the health deficiencies.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home survey summary
description: Per-facility inspection-cycle roll-up: cms_certification_number_ccn, provider identity, inspection_cycle, health_survey_date, fire_safety_survey_date, total_number_of_health_deficiencies, total_number_of_fire_safety_deficiencies, counts by scope/severity letter (including substandard-quality-of-care and immediate-jeopardy counts), and the weighted health survey score used for the star rating.

name: CMS Care Compare — nursing home provider information
description: The facility master (24 KB for 2 rows — ~100 fields). cms_certification_number_ccn, provider_name/address/telephone, provider_ssa_county_code, countyparish, urban flag, ownership_type ('For profit - Corporation'), number_of_certified_beds, average_number_of_residents_per_day, special_focus_status, abuse_icon, most_recent_health_inspection_more_than_2_years_ago, provider_changed_ownership_in_last_12_months, staffing hours per resident day, turnover rates, total_weighted_health_survey_score, number_of_facility_reported_incidents, number_of_substantiated_complaints, number_of_citations_from_infection_control_inspections, total_number_of_penalties, total_amount_of_fines_in_dollars, number_of_payment_denials, and all five-star ratings.

name: CMS Care Compare — hospital general information
description: Every Medicare-certified hospital: facility_id (CCN), facility_name, address, citytown, state, zip_code, countyparish, telephone_number, hospital_type ('Acute Care Hospitals'), hospital_ownership, emergency_services flag, meets_criteria_for_birthing_friendly_designation, hospital_overall_rating and its footnote, and the summary comparison flags for mortality, safety of care, readmission, patient experience and timely-and-effective care. facility_id is the join key to the infection and complication datasets.

name: CMS Care Compare — hospital healthcare-associated infections
description: Per-hospital infection measures: facility_id, facility_name and address, measure_id (HAI_1 CLABSI, HAI_2 CAUTI, HAI_3 SSI colon, HAI_4 SSI hysterectomy, HAI_5 MRSA, HAI_6 C.diff, with _CILOWER/_CIUPPER/_SIR/_DOPC variants), measure_name, compared_to_national, score, footnote, start_date and end_date. The measurable-harm layer for hospitals.

name: CMS Care Compare — hospital complications and deaths
description: Per-hospital outcome measures: facility_id, facility_name/address/telephone, measure_id (COMP_HIP_KNEE, PSI_90_SAFETY, MORT_30_AMI/HF/PN/COPD/CABG/STK, and the individual PSI patient-safety indicators), measure_name, compared_to_national, denominator, score, lower_estimate, higher_estimate, footnote, start_date, end_date.

name: CMS Care Compare — hospice provider quality data
description: cms_certification_number_ccn, facility_name, address_line_1/2, citytown, state, zip_code, countyparish, telephone, ownership type, certification date, measure_code and measure_name (Hospice Item Set process measures, HVLDL visits in last days of life, HCI Hospice Care Index components), score, footnote, start/end date.

name: CMS Care Compare — dialysis facility listing
description: 37 KB for 2 rows. cms_certification_number_ccn, ESRD network, facility_name, five_star rating and data-availability code, address, city/state/zip/county, phone, profit_or_non_profit status, chain_owned flag and chain_organization, late_shift availability, number_of_dialysis_stations, offers in-center hemodialysis / peritoneal / home training, plus dozens of clinical outcome measures (standardized mortality, hospitalization and transfusion ratios with confidence intervals and comparison-to-national flags). Chain ownership plus mortality outcomes in one row.

name: CMS Care Compare — dataset catalogue (DKAN metastore)
description: 550 KB DCAT catalogue of every Care Compare dataset with identifier (the 4x4 used by /datastore/query/{id}/0), title, description, theme, keyword[], modified/released/nextUpdateDate, publisher, contactPoint and distribution downloadURL. This is how you discover the nursing-home, hospital, hospice, home-health and dialysis enforcement tables without hardcoding ids.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — single dataset metadata
description: DETAIL HOP on the catalogue: accessLevel, landingPage, bureauCode, issued/modified/released/nextUpdateDate, keyword[] with identifiers ('Complaints', 'Deficiencies'), publisher, contactPoint, describedBy (data dictionary), temporal coverage and distribution[] with the CSV downloadURL and the datastore resource identifier.

name: CMS Open Data — DCAT catalogue
description: 3 MB Project Open Data catalogue for data.cms.gov. Per dataset: title, description, accrualPeriodicity, contactPoint, describedBy (data dictionary URL), and distribution[] where the entry carrying description:'latest' holds the STABLE accessURL https://data.cms.gov/data-api/v1/dataset/{uuid}/data. This is the authoritative way to resolve the provider-enrollment, ownership, change-of-ownership and revalidation dataset uuids used below.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS — Medicare Fee-For-Service public provider enrollment
description: 2,978,925 rows (confirmed via the /data/stats endpoint). Per provider: NPI, MULTIPLE_NPI_FLAG, PECOS_ASCT_CNTL_ID (the PECOS associate id that links individuals to organisations), ENRLMT_ID, PROVIDER_TYPE_CD and PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC, STATE_CD, FIRST_NAME/MDL_NAME/LAST_NAME, ORG_NAME. Server-side filtering works: ?filter[NPI]=... returns the single record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS data-api — dataset row-count stats
description: Returns {found_rows, total_rows} for any CMS data-api dataset (2,978,925 for provider enrollment). Essential for honest 'showing N of M' bounded views and for driving complete pagination rather than silently truncating.

name: CMS — Medicare opt-out affidavits
description: Clinicians who have formally opted out of Medicare. Fields: First Name, Last Name, NPI, Specialty, Optout Effective Date, Optout End Date, First Line Street Address, Second Line Street Address, City Name, State Code, Zip code, 'Eligible to Order and Refer' flag, Last updated. Addresses and dates for every opted-out practitioner.

name: CMS — Medicare order-and-referring eligibility
description: Which clinicians are legally eligible to order/refer, by programme: NPI, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, and Y/N flags for PARTB, DME, HHA, PMD, HOSPICE. Refreshed every 3.5 days. A clinician who loses a flag has effectively been cut off — a direct enforcement signal.

name: CMS — hospital change of ownership transactions
description: Every hospital ownership change since 2016, with BOTH sides named: 'ENROLLMENT ID - BUYER', 'ENROLLMENT STATE - BUYER', 'PROVIDER TYPE CODE/TEXT - BUYER', 'NPI - BUYER', 'CCN - BUYER', 'ASSOCIATE ID - BUYER', 'ORGANIZATION NAME - BUYER', 'DOING BUSINESS AS NAME - BUYER', and the identical block for the SELLER, plus change-of-ownership type (CHOW / Acquisition-Merger / Consolidation) and effective date. M&A of US hospitals as a queryable table.

name: CMS — hospital change-of-ownership owner detail
description: DETAIL HOP behind a hospital CHOW: ENROLLMENT ID, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, then per owner — 'ASSOCIATE ID - OWNER', 'TYPE - OWNER' (I=individual, O=organisation), 'ROLE CODE/TEXT - OWNER' ('CORPORATE OFFICER', '5% OR GREATER DIRECT OWNERSHIP INTEREST', 'OPERATIONAL/MANAGERIAL CONTROL'), 'ASSOCIATION DATE - OWNER', FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST NAME - OWNER, 'TITLE - OWNER' ('PRESIDENT/BOARD MEMBER'), organisation-owner name, DBA, and percentage. Named officers behind every hospital transaction.

name: CMS — skilled nursing facility change of ownership
description: Nursing-home M&A with both counterparties: buyer and seller ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE CODE/TEXT ('PART A PROVIDER - SKILLED NURSING FACILITY'), NPI, MULTIPLE NPI FLAG, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DOING BUSINESS AS NAME, plus CHOW type and effective date. Pairs with the Care Compare penalties table via CCN.

name: CMS — SNF change-of-ownership owner detail
description: DETAIL HOP: ENROLLMENT ID, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, and per owner the ASSOCIATE ID - OWNER, TYPE - OWNER, ROLE CODE/TEXT - OWNER, ASSOCIATION DATE - OWNER, individual name fields, TITLE - OWNER, organisation-owner name/DBA and percentage. Chains a fined nursing home to the corporate entity and individuals that bought it.

name: CMS — hospital Medicare enrollments
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE CODE/TEXT, NPI, MULTIPLE NPI FLAG, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DOING BUSINESS AS NAME, INCORPORATION DATE, INCORPORATION STATE, ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE, address and subgroup flags. Verified server-side filter ?filter[CCN]=440058 returns the single hospital — the CCN detail hop that ties this to the deficiency/penalty tables.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS — skilled nursing facility Medicare enrollments
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE ('PART A PROVIDER - SKILLED NURSING FACILITY'), NPI, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DOING BUSINESS AS NAME, INCORPORATION DATE and STATE, ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE (LLC / corporation / partnership). Corporate identity for every Medicare nursing home; filter[CCN] works.

name: CMS — home health agency Medicare enrollments
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE 'PART A PROVIDER - HOME HEALTH AGENCY', NPI, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DBA, incorporation details and structure. Home health is the highest-fraud-risk Medicare segment; ASSOCIATE ID joins to the all-owners table.

name: CMS — home health agency all owners
description: Every declared owner of every Medicare home health agency: ENROLLMENT ID, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME (with DBA), ASSOCIATE ID - OWNER, TYPE - OWNER (I/O), ROLE CODE/TEXT - OWNER ('5% OR GREATER DIRECT OWNERSHIP INTEREST'), ASSOCIATION DATE - OWNER, FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST NAME - OWNER, TITLE - OWNER, organisation-owner name/DBA, percentage owned. Beneficial ownership behind the agency.

name: CMS — hospice Medicare enrollments
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE 'PART A PROVIDER - HOSPICE', NPI, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DBA, incorporation date/state and organisation structure. ASSOCIATE ID pivots to the hospice all-owners table.

name: CMS — hospice all owners
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, ASSOCIATE ID - OWNER, TYPE - OWNER, ROLE CODE/TEXT - OWNER ('OPERATIONAL/MANAGERIAL CONTROL'), ASSOCIATION DATE - OWNER, individual name and title fields, organisation-owner name, percentage. Ownership graph for the hospice sector.

name: CMS — rural health clinic Medicare enrollments
description: ENROLLMENT ID, ENROLLMENT STATE, PROVIDER TYPE 'PART A PROVIDER - RURAL HEALTH CLINIC', NPI, CCN, ASSOCIATE ID, ORGANIZATION NAME, DBA, incorporation and structure fields for every Medicare-enrolled rural health clinic.

name: CMS — provider revalidation due date list
description: Enrollment ID, National Provider Identifier, First/Last Name, Organization Name, Enrollment State Code, Enrollment Type, Provider Type Text, Enrollment Specialty, Revalidation Due Date, Adjusted Due Date, Individual Total Reassign To, Receiving Benefits Reassignment count. A missed revalidation is how providers get deactivated — the leading indicator of removal from Medicare.

name: CMS — revalidation clinic group practice reassignment
description: The individual-to-group affiliation graph: Group PAC ID, Group Enrollment ID, Group Legal Business Name, Group State Code, Group Due Date, Group Reassignments and Physician Assistants count, Record Type ('Reassignment'), Individual Enrollment ID, Individual NPI, Individual First/Last Name, Individual specialty, state and due date. Shows exactly which clinicians bill under which practice entity.

name: CMS — revalidation reassignment list
description: Group PAC ID, Group Enrollment ID, Group Legal Business Name, Group State Code, Group Due Date, Group Reassignments and Physician Assistants, Record Type, Individual PAC ID, Individual Enrollment ID, Individual NPI and name, Individual Specialty Description, Individual State Code and Due Date. Second view of the billing-reassignment network.

name: CMS — Provider of Services file (iQIES)
description: 12 KB for 2 rows — the full certification record for every non-hospital Medicare provider: prvdr_num (CCN), fac_name, prvdr_sbtyp_id, mdcd_vndr_num, orgnl_prtcptn_dt (original participation date), prvdr_type_id, st_adr, city_name, ssa_cnty_cd, zip_cd, phne_num, crtfctn_dt, TRMNTN_EXPRTN_DT (termination/expiration date — i.e. when CMS cut them off), state_cd, ssa_state_cd, plus scores of certification, bed-count and service-offering fields.

name: CMS Open Payments — dataset catalogue
description: 127 KB DKAN catalogue of all 65 Open Payments datasets (general, research and ownership payment detail per reporting year 2013-2025, plus profile files). Each record's distribution[0].identifier is the id used by /api/1/datastore/query/{id}. The tree carries only the bare /datastore/query/ path with no dataset id — this resolves them.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Open Payments — general payment detail 2025
description: 20 KB per record — industry payments to clinicians. change_type, covered_recipient_type, teaching_hospital_ccn/id/name, covered_recipient_profile_id, covered_recipient_npi, recipient first/middle/last name and suffix, full practice address, specialty, licence states, applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_id/name/state/country, total_amount_of_payment_usdollars, date_of_payment, number_of_payments, form_of_payment, nature_of_payment, travel city/state/country, physician_ownership_indicator, third_party_payment_recipient_indicator, contextual_information, and the associated drug/device/biological name, NDC and product type for up to five products. Verified conditions[] filtering on covered_recipient_npi.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Open Payments — physician ownership/investment interest 2025
description: Physicians who hold an OWNERSHIP or investment stake in the manufacturer paying them: change_type, physician_profile_id, physician_npi, physician first/middle/last name and suffix, practice address, specialty, licence state, the applicable manufacturer or GPO id/name/state/country, dollar amount invested, value of interest, terms of interest, and interest_held_by_physician_or_an_immediate_family_member. The clearest conflict-of-interest disclosure in US healthcare.

name: CMS Open Payments — research payment detail 2025
description: 54 KB per record. Research funding flowing from manufacturers to teaching hospitals, entities and named principal investigators: covered_recipient_type, teaching_hospital_ccn/id/name, noncovered_recipient_entity_name, covered recipient identity block, applicable manufacturer/GPO id and name, total_amount_of_payment_usdollars, date_of_payment, form and nature of payment, name_of_study, clinicaltrials_gov_identifier, research_information_link, context_of_research, plus up to five principal_investigator blocks each with NPI, name, address, specialty and licence state.

name: CMS Open Payments — covered recipient profile supplement
description: 33-column identity file for every clinician appearing in Open Payments: covered_recipient_profile_type, covered_recipient_profile_id, associated_covered_recipient_profile_id_1/2 (profile de-duplication links), covered_recipient_npi, first/middle/last name and suffix, alternate names, practice address, primary type, specialty and licence state codes. Verified conditions[] filter by NPI — the join that turns an NPI into every payment received.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Open Payments — datastore column schema
description: Returns numOfColumns and the columns{} map with each field's storage type, mysql_type and human description for any Open Payments distribution id. Lets a collector discover every available column instead of hardcoding a subset (and so avoid silently dropping fields).

name: FMCSA — motor carrier census (SAFER replacement)
description: Keyless substitute for the 403-blocked QCMobile/SAFER APIs. Per carrier: dot_number, status_code, add_date, mcs150_date, mcs150_mileage and year, dun_bradstreet_no, carrier_operation (interstate/intrastate), business_org_id, phy_omc_region, safety_inv_terr, legal and DBA name, physical and mailing address, phone, power units, driver count, hazmat flags, cargo-carried flags, and the safety rating with its rating date. Verified server-side filter ?dot_number=162845.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — motor carrier crash file
description: CARRIER → ITS CRASHES, the exact detail hop required. Per crash: crash_id, dot_number, report_state, report_number, report_date and time, report_seq_no, ci_status_code, final_status_date, location, state, county, fatalities, injuries, tow_away flag, vehicle configuration, hazmat released flag, weather and light conditions, road access control, trafficway description, and citation issued. Verified filter ?dot_number=728630.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — roadside vehicle inspection file
description: CARRIER → ITS ROADSIDE INSPECTIONS. Per inspection: inspection_id, dot_number, report_state, report_number, insp_date, insp_start_time/insp_end_time, region, ci_status_code, location_desc, inspection level, driver and vehicle out-of-service counts and OOS totals, hazmat inspection flag, unsafe-driving and fatigued-driving violation counts, and the vehicle/licence-plate identifiers. Verified filter ?dot_number=728630.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — SMS crash input (safety measurement system)
description: The crash records that actually feed a carrier's SMS/CSA safety score: report_number, report_seq_no, dot_number, report_date, report_state, fatalities, injuries, tow_away boolean, trafficway_desc, access_control_desc, weather and light condition, vehicle configuration, hazmat involvement and the crash severity weight applied. Filterable by dot_number.

name: FMCSA — operating authority revocations (all with history)
description: Every revocation of interstate operating authority: docket_number (MC/MX/FF), dot_number, type_license (COMMON/CONTRACT/BROKER), order1_serve_date, order2_type_desc ('INVOLUNTARY REVOCATION'), order2_effective_date. A carrier being put out of business, as a table.

name: FMCSA — current revocation and suspension notices (MOTUS)
description: The live suspension/revocation docket: docket_number, usdot_number, op_auth_type ('Motor Carrier of Property (Except Household Goods)'), order1_serve_date, order1_type_desc ('Operating Authority Involuntary Suspension Notice'), order1_effective_date. More current than the legacy revocation file.

name: FMCSA — operating authority status history (MOTUS)
description: Full lifecycle of a carrier's authority: docket_number, usdot_number, op_auth_type, op_auth_status (Active/Inactive/Revoked), reason (GRANTED, DISMISSED, REVOKED, REINSTATED), status_change_date. Reconstructs when a carrier gained, lost and regained the right to operate.

name: FMCSA — legacy authority history (AuthHist)
description: docket_number, dot_number, authority category ('PROPERTY FREIGHT FORWARDER', broker, common/contract carrier) and original_action_desc (GRANTED / DISMISSED / DENIED). The archival authority-application record behind each docket.

name: FMCSA — current insurance filings
description: Financial-responsibility filings a carrier must maintain to operate: prefix_docket_number, ins_type_code, ins_class_code, max_cov_amount, underl_lim_amount, policy_no, effective_date, ins_form_code, name_company (the insurer). Lapsed coverage is a direct trigger for authority revocation.

name: FMCSA — insurance filing history (InsHist)
description: docket_number, dot_number, ins_form_code, filing status ('Cancelled'), ins_cancl_form, coverage type ('BIPD'), policy_no, min_cov_amount, effective_date, cancl_effective_date and cancellation method, insurer name. Shows every time a carrier's insurance was cancelled and by whom.

name: FMCSA — rejected insurance filings
description: docket_number, dot_number, ins_form_code, coverage type, policy_no, recv_date, ins_class_code, coverage amounts, rej_date (rejection date), inser_branch, name_company. A rejected filing means the carrier believed it was covered and was not.

name: FMCSA — carrier authority status (all with history)
description: Per docket: docket_number, dot_number, common_stat / contract_stat / broker_stat (A=active, I=inactive, N=none), common_app_pend / contract_app_pend / broker_app_pend (pending applications), common_rev_pend / contract_rev_pend / broker_rev_pend (PENDING REVOCATIONS), property_chk, passenger/household-goods/enterprise flags. Live view of which authorities a carrier holds and which are being revoked.

name: FRA — highway-rail grade crossing incidents (Form 57)
description: Every railroad grade-crossing collision reported to the Federal Railroad Administration. Per incident: railroadcode, railroadname, year, incidentnumber, incidentyear/month, maintenancerailroadcode and name, crossing id, location, train speed, vehicle type and speed, warning devices present, driver action, weather and visibility, killed and injured counts, hazmat involvement and release. Railroad → its crossing casualties.

name: US DOJ — press release API (enforcement announcements)
description: 270,751 records. Per release: title, body (full HTML text), date, uuid, url, teaser, component[] (which DOJ component or US Attorney's Office), topic[] (Health Care Fraud, FCPA, Environmental Crimes, Antitrust…), changed date, attachment. Paged with ?page= and ?pagesize=. The narrative enforcement layer that names defendants, penalties and pleas before structured datasets catch up. metadata.resultset gives count/pagesize/page for honest bounded views.

name: FAA — aircraft registry N-number inquiry
description: Detail page for one US-registered aircraft: N-number, serial number, manufacturer and model, year of manufacture, type of aircraft and engine, registered owner name and address, registrant type, certificate issue date and expiration, airworthiness classification and date, status, mode S code (hex and octal), fractional-ownership flag, and the engine manufacturer/model. Sibling routes exist for serial-number, make/model and owner-name searches.

name: NTSB — aviation accident database download index
description: 228 KB directory listing with 51 downloadable Microsoft Access database files: the cumulative pre-1982 and post-1982 NTSB aviation accident/incident databases plus monthly update files. Each contains the events, aircraft, findings, injury, narratives and sequence-of-events tables. This is the only NTSB surface I could get data from — the CAROL JSON query API (data.ntsb.gov/carol-main-public/api/Query/Main) is POST-only and returns HTTP 500 for every payload shape I tried.

name: CourtListener RECAP — federal docket search (anonymous-accessible)
description: Federal PACER/RECAP dockets. count 98124 dockets / document_count 520436 for one query. Each row carries docketNumber, caseName, court, assignedTo judge name + assigned_to_id, referredTo, dateFiled, dateTerminated, cause, natureOfSuit, juryDemand, and a nested recap_documents[] array with entry_number, description, is_available, filepath_local and page_count. This is the deep RECAP hop that works WITHOUT a token (the REST /dockets/ endpoint is 401 anonymously).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener RECAP — docket-entry/document search
description: Individual RECAP docket ENTRIES and their PDFs, count 5,056,495 for one term. Each row: absolute_url to /docket/{id}/{entry}/, entry_number, description of the filed paper, short_description, document_number, attachment_number, is_available, filepath_local, page_count, docket_id, court and caseName. Turns a name into the actual filings against it.

name: CourtListener — docket-level search (type=d)
description: Docket-header view: count 11853 for one party name. Fields include assignedTo (judge), assigned_to_id, docketNumber, court_id, caseName, dateFiled, dateTerminated, chapter (bankruptcy), trustee_str, suitNature. Deduplicated per docket, so it is the right entry point for 'every case this company is in'.

name: CourtListener — opinion / case-law search
description: Published opinions across 3,359 courts, count 1,097,566 for one term. Rows carry cluster id, caseName, court, dateFiled, citation strings, judge, status (Published/Unpublished), snippet text and absolute_url. Cursor-paginated.

name: CourtListener — judge search (type=p)
description: Federal and state judges, count 664 for one surname. Rows carry id, name_full, absolute_url, court list, appointer, selection_method, aba_rating array, political_affiliation, school, date_start/date_termination. The id feeds every judge detail hop below.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — oral argument audio search
description: Oral-argument recordings, count 1624 for one term. Rows give absolute_url to /audio/{id}/, caseName, court, dateArgued, docketNumber, duration and the mp3 local path.

name: CourtListener — judges database (list)
description: The Free Law Project judge database, cursor-paginated. Each person: id, name_first/middle/last/suffix, date_of_birth, place_of_birth, gender, race[], religion, ftm_eid / ftm_total_received (Follow-the-Money campaign totals), plus embedded aba_ratings[] and links to positions, educations, political_affiliations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — judge detail record
description: One judge, fully expanded: race[], sources[], nested aba_ratings[] with year_rated and rating, dates of birth/death and granularity, gender, religion, has_photo, fjc_id, and hyperlinks out to positions/educations/political-affiliations. Verified detail hop from any list row's id.

name: CourtListener — judicial positions held by a person
description: Every seat a judge has held: position_type, court, organization_name, job_title, date_nominated, date_elected, date_confirmation, date_start, date_termination, termination_reason, how_selected, appointer (link to the appointing person), supervisor, predecessor, voice_vote / votes_yes / votes_no on confirmation, and nested retention_events[]. The appointer field makes this a person->person graph.

name: CourtListener — judge education history
description: Degrees held by a judge: nested school object (name, EIN, is_alias_of), degree_level, degree_detail, degree_year. Detail hop off a person id.

name: CourtListener — judge political affiliation history
description: Party affiliation records for a judge with political_party, source (ballot/appointer/bar/other), date_start, date_end and granularity. Detail hop off a person id.

name: CourtListener — ABA judicial nominee ratings
description: American Bar Association ratings of a judicial nominee: year_rated and rating (Well Qualified / Qualified / Not Qualified), keyed to the person. Detail hop off a person id.

name: CourtListener — federal judge financial disclosure filings
description: Annual EIGA financial-disclosure reports filed by federal judges: id, year, page_count, filepath (scanned PDF), thumbnail, has_been_extracted, is_amended, addendum_content_raw, plus report_type. The id is the parent key for the seven line-item endpoints below (investments, gifts, debts, agreements, reimbursements, spouse income, outside positions).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: investments / assets
description: Line-item holdings from a judge's financial disclosure: page_number, description of the asset, redacted flag, income_during_reporting_period_code and _type, gross_value_code and _method, transaction_during_reporting_period, transaction_date, transaction_value_code, transaction_gain_code, transaction_partner. This is the conflict-of-interest layer behind a judge.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: gifts received
description: Gifts reported by a federal judge: source (who gave it), description, value, redacted flag, tied to the parent financial_disclosure id and thence to the judge.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: reimbursed travel
description: Paid-for trips and seminars: source organisation, date_raw, location, purpose, items_paid_or_provided, redacted. The classic judicial-junket record, joined to a judge via financial_disclosure.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: agreements
description: Continuing agreements a judge has with former employers/partnerships (pensions, of-counsel arrangements, deferred comp): date_raw, parties_and_terms, redacted, financial_disclosure link. Filterable by ?financial_disclosure={id}.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: non-investment income
description: Outside earned income of a federal judge: date_raw, source, income_amount, redacted, linked to the parent financial_disclosure. Filterable by ?financial_disclosure={id}.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: outside positions
description: Non-judicial positions a judge holds (trustee, director, officer, teaching): position, organization_name, redacted, linked to financial_disclosure. Filterable by ?financial_disclosure={id}.

name: CourtListener — oral argument audio records
description: Oral-argument recordings with case_name, case_name_full, docket link, judges string, sha1, download_url (the court's original mp3), local_path_mp3, duration, date_argued, stt_status and machine transcript fields. Filterable by court via docket__court.

name: CourtListener — judge lookup by surname
description: Name-filtered judge lookup (name_last, name_first also supported) returning the full person record incl. embedded aba_ratings. The entity-pivot form: feed a surname, get the person id, then walk positions/educations/disclosures.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — law school registry
description: Law schools with id, name, ein and is_alias_of. Join table behind the judge education records.

name: US Supreme Court — full docket record (JSON)
description: The complete SCOTUS docket for one case number, straight from supremecourt.gov and completely keyless. Contains CaseNumber, term, case type (Paid/IFP/Application), PetitionerTitle, RespondentTitle, DocketedDate, LowerCourt + lower-court docket numbers and decision date, RelatedCaseNumber[], Petitioner[] and Respondent[] arrays of counsel (name, firm, address, phone, party represented), Other[] (amici counsel), and ProceedingsandOrder[] — 53 dated docket entries here — each with Date, Text and a Links[] array of DocumentUrl PDFs on supremecourt.gov/DocketPDF/. Docket -> entries -> documents in a single hop. Works for merits dockets (24-1234) and applications (24A1012).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Supreme Court — slip opinions feed
description: Newest SCOTUS slip opinions with title, link to the PDF on supremecourt.gov and pubDate. The docket numbers in the titles feed straight into the SCOTUS docket JSON endpoint above.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — Supreme Court cases by term
description: Keyless SCOTUS case index. Each case: ID, name, href (api.oyez.org/cases/{term}/{docket}), docket_number, additional_docket_numbers, timeline[] of events (Granted/Argued/Decided with unix dates), lower_court, facts_of_the_case, question, conclusion, term, and labelled issue areas.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — Supreme Court case full record
description: Full expanded SCOTUS case: facts, question presented, conclusion, lower court and its ruling, plus hrefs into every sub-resource — case_advocate/{id} (the arguing lawyers), case_citation/{id}, case_decision/{id}, case_document/written_opinion/{id}, case_media/oral_argument_audio/{id}, case_media/opinion_announcement_audio/{id}, case_timeline/{id}, decision_vote/{id} (per-justice vote), and courts/{natural-court}. Every one of those hrefs is itself a live keyless endpoint.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — advocate appearance in a case
description: Which lawyer argued which side: nested advocate object (ID, name, href to /people/{identifier}, last_name, identifier) plus advocate_role with the value/label of the side represented. Detail hop from a case record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — case decision with per-justice votes
description: The holding text plus votes[]: every justice (ID, name, href to their person record, roles with appointing_president and date_start/date_end) with their vote, whether they wrote the majority/concurrence/dissent, and the majority/minority vote tallies. The vote-level breakdown behind a SCOTUS ruling.

name: Oyez — single justice vote record
description: One justice's vote in one case: nested member object with ID, full name, href, last_name and roles[] (type scotus_justice, date_start, date_end, appointing_president, role_title), plus the vote value, opinion_type and joining information.

name: Oyez — written opinion document
description: An individual opinion attached to a case: id, title (Majority/Concurring/Dissenting), author, type value+label, justia_opinion_id and justia_opinion_url, media_files and opinion_body. Third hop: case -> case_document href -> this record.

name: Oyez — oral argument audio + transcript
description: An argument session: id, title with the argument date, media_file[] (mime, size, direct S3 mp3/ogg href on oyez.case-media.mp3), plus the aligned speaker-by-speaker transcript sections used to attribute statements to named justices and advocates.

name: Oyez — natural court composition
description: A 'natural court' (a stable bench composition, e.g. roberts13 = Roberts Court 2022-): ID, name, date range, and members[] — every sitting justice with ID, name, href to their person record, roles and service dates. Lets you resolve who was on the Court on any date.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — justice / advocate biography
description: Person record for a justice or advocate: ID, full name parts and suffix, date_of_birth and place_of_birth (unix + string), date_of_death, gender, roles[] with appointing_president, seat, date_start/date_end, plus thumbnail and identifier slug.

name: Oyez — advocate roster
description: Every lawyer who has argued before the Supreme Court in Oyez's coverage: ID, name, href to /people/{identifier}, last_name, length_of_service, identifier. Paginated list; the entry point for 'which cases did this lawyer argue'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — full case index (paginated)
description: The whole Oyez SCOTUS case corpus back to the 1950s, paginated: ID, name, href, docket_number, timeline[] with decided/argued dates, and term. Feed each href to the case-detail hop.

name: US Tax Court (DAWSON) — full public case record
description: Keyless full docket for a Tax Court case: caseCaption, docketNumber(+suffix), createdAt, partyType, judge, and three deep arrays — docketEntries[] (index, filingDate, receivedAt, documentTitle, documentType, eventCode, filedBy, filedByRole, servedAt, servedPartiesCode, numberOfPages, isFileAttached, isSealed, isStricken, attachments, objections, lodged, signedJudgeName, docketEntryId), petitioners[] (name, state, contactId, serviceIndicator), irsPractitioners[] and privatePractitioners[] (name, barNumber, originalBarState, practiceType, practitionerType, admissionsDate, admissionsStatus). Case -> entries -> parties -> counsel in one request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Tax Court (DAWSON) — order full-text search
description: Full-text search across Tax Court orders. Each result: caseCaption, docketNumber(+suffix), documentTitle, documentType, eventCode, filingDate, signedJudgeName and docketEntryId. The docketNumber pivots straight to the case-detail endpoint and the docketEntryId to the signed PDF URL endpoint. Supports dateRange=customDates&startDate=&endDate= and judge filters.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Tax Court (DAWSON) — signed document download URL
description: Given a docketNumber and a docketEntryId, returns {"url": ...} — a pre-signed S3 link to the actual filed PDF. This is the terminal hop of case -> docket entry -> document for the US Tax Court.

name: Caselaw Access Project — reporter volume index
description: Harvard CAP's full static corpus (api.case.law is retired; this R2 bucket replaces it and is keyless). One reporter (a2d = Atlantic Reporter 2d) lists 967 volumes with volume_number, title, publisher, publication_year, start_year/end_year and jurisdictions[] (id, name, name_long, slug). The bucket root https://static.case.law/ lists every reporter slug.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Caselaw Access Project — cases in a volume
description: Every case in one reporter volume: id, name, name_abbreviation, decision_date, docket_number, first_page/last_page, citations[] (type official/parallel, cite), court object, jurisdiction, and the file_name that forms the case-detail path. Second hop of the CAP chain.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Caselaw Access Project — full case text (JSON)
description: The complete adjudicated opinion: id, name, name_abbreviation, decision_date, docket_number, citations[], court, jurisdiction, judges, attorneys, parties, and casebody with the full structured opinion text and per-opinion author. Terminal hop of reporter -> volume -> case.

name: Caselaw Access Project — full case text (HTML)
description: Same case as marked-up HTML: section.casebody with head-matter (parties, docketnumber, court, decisiondate, attorneys, judges) and the opinion body, each element carrying data-blocks page coordinates back to the scanned reporter page.

name: GovTrack — legislator detail record
description: Keyless member-of-Congress record: bioguideid, birthday, cspanid, firstname/middlename/lastname/namemod, gender, twitterid, youtubeid, osid (OpenSecrets), pvsid (VoteSmart), fediverse_webfinger, and link to the GovTrack profile. Detail hop from any /role or /vote_voter row's person id. (Only /role, /bill and /vote are already in the tree — this one is not.)

name: GovTrack — per-member roll-call votes
description: The individual votes inside a roll call (total_count 432 for one vote): option object (key +/-/0/P, value Aye/Nay/Not Voting), the full nested person record (bioguideid, birthday, cspanid, name, party), the person_role (state, district, party, title, congress numbers) and created timestamp. This is the roll-call -> member detail hop that the tree's bare /vote endpoint does not reach.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GovTrack — congressional committees and subcommittees
description: 355 committees/subcommittees: code, abbrev, name, committee_type (house/senate/joint), jurisdiction text, url, and the parent committee object for subcommittees.

name: GovTrack — committee membership roster
description: 3,891 committee assignments: nested committee (code, abbrev, type, jurisdiction), the person, the role (Chairman/Ranking Member/Member) and the congress. Turns a committee into its members and a member into their committees.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GovInfo bulk data — bill status XML (KEYLESS)
description: The complete BILLSTATUS XML for a bill with NO API KEY at all: <bill> with number, updateDate, originChamber, type, introducedDate, policyArea, <sponsors>, <cosponsors>, <actions> (every dated action with actionCode and committee), <committees> with activities, <relatedBills>, <subjects>, <summaries>, <titles>, <textVersions>, <amendments>, <laws>. Everything the keyed Congress.gov API charges rate limit for, free. Pattern: /bulkdata/BILLSTATUS/{congress}/{hr|hres|hjres|hconres|s|sres|sjres|sconres}/BILLSTATUS-{congress}{type}{num}.xml

name: GovInfo Link Service — citation resolver (KEYLESS)
description: Keyless citation-to-document resolver: /link/fr/{volume}/{page} returns the actual Federal Register PDF (verified: served a real %PDF-1.7 body). /link/bills/{congress}/{type}/{number}?link-type=xml returns the enrolled bill XML (verified separately). Turns a legal citation directly into the primary document with no lookup table.

name: GovInfo Link Service — bill text XML by citation (KEYLESS)
description: Resolves congress+bill type+number straight to the full enrolled bill XML (verified: <bill bill-stage="Enrolled-Bill" ...> with the complete legislative text and DTD). No key, no package id lookup needed.

name: GovInfo — US Courts opinion browse tree (KEYLESS)
description: The undocumented site API behind govinfo's browse UI, keyless. Returns childNodes[] with nodeValue objects: navigator (courttypenav), displayValue (Appellate/District/Bankruptcy), value (CourtType1...), docCount (701,417 appellate opinions), browsePath, hasChildren. Drill down by appending the browsePath to walk court type -> circuit -> court -> year -> packages of USCOURTS opinions.

name: GovInfo bulk data — full eCFR title XML (KEYLESS)
description: The entire text of one CFR title as a single keyless XML document (DLPSTEXTCLASS/HEADER/TEXT structure; title 40 streams >22MB). Pattern /bulkdata/ECFR/title-{n}/ECFR-title{n}.xml for all 50 titles. Use for offline regulation corpora.

name: eCFR — CFR title index and currency
description: All 50 CFR titles, keyless: number, name, latest_amended_on, latest_issue_date, up_to_date_as_of, reserved. The freshness ledger for the whole Code of Federal Regulations and the entry point for the versioner endpoints.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: eCFR — agency registry with CFR references
description: 316 federal agencies: name, short_name, display_name, sortable_name, slug, children[] (sub-agencies), and cfr_references[] giving the exact title/chapter each agency owns. Maps an agency to the regulations it writes.

name: eCFR — full-text regulation search
description: Full-text search of every current CFR section. Each hit: starts_on/ends_on validity window, type (Section/Appendix/Part), hierarchy object (title, subtitle, chapter, subchapter, part, subpart, subject_group, section, appendix), hierarchy_headings, headings, full_text_excerpt and score. Supports agency_slugs[], date and last_modified filters.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: eCFR — full structural tree of a CFR title at a date
description: The complete nested hierarchy of a CFR title as it stood on a given date: identifier, label, label_level, label_description, reserved, type, size (bytes) and recursive children[] down to individual sections. Lets you enumerate every regulation in a title without downloading the text.

name: eCFR — ancestry of a CFR node
description: Given a title plus part/subpart/section, returns the full chain of ancestors (title -> chapter -> subchapter -> part) with identifier, label, label_level, label_description and size. Resolves a bare CFR citation into its regulatory context.

name: eCFR — official corrections to the CFR
description: Published corrections against a CFR title: id, cfr_references[] with the exact cfr_reference string and full hierarchy, corrective_action text, error_corrected and error_occurred dates, fr_citation, position, display_in_toc, year, last_modified. The errata trail on federal regulation.

name: eCFR — search hit counts by CFR hierarchy
description: Aggregates a full-text query across the CFR tree: total count (1,418 for asbestos) with recursive children[] per level (title/subtitle/chapter/part) giving level, hierarchy, hierarchy_heading, heading, structure_index, count and max_score. Shows which regulators actually govern a topic.

name: eCFR — search hit counts by effective date
description: Histogram of a query's CFR hits by the date the text took effect ({"2016-12-19":1198, ...}). Surfaces when a regulatory regime was actually written, useful for timeline reconstruction.

name: Federal Register — document detail record
description: The full FR document behind a document_number: abstract, action, agencies[], body_html_url, cfr_references, comments_close_on, dates, docket_ids[], document_number, effective_on, excerpts, full_text_xml_url, html_url, json_url, page ranges, pdf_url, president, publication_date, raw_text_url, regulation_id_numbers (RINs), regulations_dot_gov_info, significant, signing_date, subtype, title, topics[], type. The tree has the LIST endpoint but not this detail hop.

name: Federal Register — agency detail record
description: One agency expanded: id, name, short_name, slug, description, agency_url, url, json_url, parent_id, child_ids[], child_slugs[], recent_articles_url. Detail hop from any agency id embedded in a document record.

name: Federal Register — documents filtered by agency docket id
description: Pulls every FR notice/rule filed under a specific agency docket number, optionally narrowed by document type. Returns title, type, publication_date, document_number, html_url, abstract. The bridge between a Regulations.gov docket and its Federal Register publications.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — documents affecting a CFR part
description: Every FR document that amends a given CFR title/part (count 1,532 for 40 CFR 63). Gives the rulemaking history of a specific regulation, with next_page_url cursor. Joins directly to the eCFR endpoints above.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — presidential documents / executive orders
description: Executive orders, proclamations, memoranda and notices (count 1,556 EOs). Each row: title, executive_order_number, signing_date, publication_date, president, document_number, html_url, pdf_url, disposition_notes. Swap presidential_document_type for proclamation/memorandum/notice/determination.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — public inspection documents by date
description: Documents on public inspection on a given day — 24 to 72 hours BEFORE they publish (88 rows for one date). agencies[], title, type, document_number, filed_at, publication_date, pdf_url, html_url, raw_text_url, docket_numbers. The early-warning feed; the tree only has /current.json.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — public inspection document detail
description: One on-deposit document: agencies[] with raw_name/name/id/url/json_url, document_number, editorial_note, filed_at, filing_type, html_url, pdf_url, publication_date, raw_text_url, title, toc_subject, type. Detail hop from the public-inspection list.

name: Federal Register — daily hit-count facets
description: Per-day counts of documents matching a query going back to 1994 ({"1994-01-05":{"count":1,"name":"01/05/1994"}}). Also available at /facets/weekly, /monthly, /quarterly, /yearly and /agency. Cheap way to detect regulatory attention spikes on a term or company name.

name: Federal Register — curated search definitions
description: FR's own editor-curated topic searches per section (environment, money, world, science-and-technology, business-and-industry, health-and-public-welfare): slug, title, description and the exact search conditions to replay. Ready-made high-signal queries.

name: congress-legislators — current members of Congress
description: 537 sitting legislators, keyless. The id block is the crosswalk that makes every other congressional source joinable: bioguide, thomas, lis, govtrack, opensecrets, votesmart, fec[] (campaign committee ids), cspan, icpsr, wikipedia, wikidata, ballotpedia, maplight. Plus name, bio (birthday, gender), and terms[] with type, start/end, state, district, party, class, url, address, phone, office, rss_url.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: congress-legislators — every historical member since 1789
description: All former members of Congress back to the First Congress, with the same id crosswalk (bioguide, govtrack, icpsr, wikipedia, wikidata, google_entity_id), name, bio and full terms[] history. Resolves any historical bioguide id appearing in GovInfo/Congress.gov data.

name: congress-legislators — current committees and subcommittees
description: 230 committees/subcommittees: type (house/senate/joint), name, url, minority_url, thomas_id, house_committee_id / senate_committee_id, jurisdiction, address, phone, rss_url, and nested subcommittees[]. Keyed by thomas_id to the membership file.

name: congress-legislators — committee membership roster
description: Keyed by committee code (SSAF, HSAG, ...) to an array of members: name, party (majority/minority), rank, title (Chairman/Ranking Member) and bioguide id. Committee -> people and people -> committee in one file.

name: congress-legislators — official social media accounts
description: 518 members' verified official accounts joined by bioguide/thomas/govtrack ids: twitter handle and twitter_id, facebook, youtube and youtube_id, instagram and instagram_id. The identity bridge from a legislator to their public posting.

name: congress-legislators — district office locations
description: Physical district offices for 535 members: office id, address, suite, building, city, state, zip, latitude, longitude, phone, fax, hours. Geocoded ground presence for every member of Congress.

name: congress-legislators — presidents and vice presidents
description: 67 executive-branch officeholders since Washington with id (bioguide, govtrack, icpsr_prez), name, bio and terms[] giving type (prez/viceprez), start/end dates and party. Completes the federal-officeholder identity graph.

name: US House Clerk — official member roster XML
description: The Clerk of the House's authoritative roster (441 <member> records for the 119th Congress): publish-date, congress number and session, majority/minority, and per member the statedistrict, bioguideID, official name and formal name, party, caucus, elected date, sworn date, office room, phone, committee assignments with rank, and prior-congress service. Primary-source alternative to third-party rosters.

name: US House Clerk — roll call vote XML (per-member)
description: A single House roll call with 433 <recorded-vote> elements — every representative's individual vote. vote-metadata carries majority, congress, session, chamber, rollcall-num, legis-num, vote-question, vote-type, vote-result, action-date/time, vote-desc and the yea/nay/present/not-voting totals; each recorded-vote has legislator (name-id = bioguide, state, party, sort-field) plus their vote. Pattern /evs/{year}/roll{NNN}.xml. Note: the Senate equivalent on senate.gov is Akamai-403 from here.

name: US Department of Justice — blog/official statements API
description: 3,334 DOJ blog posts and official statements with title, body, date, author component, topic[] and url. Policy-level companion to the press-release feed.

name: US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit — opinions/orders feed
description: 100 items: precedential and nonprecedential Federal Circuit opinions and orders with title (case name + appeal number), link to the PDF, dc:creator, pubDate and content. The appellate court for all US patent, trade and government-contract appeals.

name: US Courts (AO) — judiciary news feed
description: Administrative Office of the US Courts news feed: title, link, description, dc:date. Low volume; carries judicial-vacancy, caseload-statistics and policy announcements for the federal judiciary.

name: PACER RSS — US District Court, N.D. New York

City and County of San Francisco'), link = DktRpt.pl?{pacer_caseid}, description = the docket-entry type in brackets plus an <a href> to the actual document at /doc1/{docid}?caseid=&de_seq_num=, guid = caseid+sequence, pubDate. Filing-level federal litigation intelligence. This district is NOT among the ~38 already in the tree.

name: Legistar — Seattle City Council legislation (matters)
description: Granicus Legistar municipal-legislature API, keyless, OData-queryable ($top/$skip/$filter/$orderby). Each matter: MatterId, MatterGuid, MatterFile (e.g. 'CB 121253'), MatterName, MatterTitle (the full ordinance text summary), MatterTypeName, MatterStatusName, MatterBodyId/Name, MatterIntroDate, MatterAgendaDate, MatterPassedDate, MatterEnactmentDate, MatterEnactmentNumber, MatterRequester, MatterNotes, MatterVersion, MatterLastModifiedUtc. MatterId opens four verified sub-resources (sponsors, histories, attachments, versions).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — matter detail record
description: One piece of municipal legislation fully expanded, including the complete MatterTitle text, type, status, sponsoring body, all lifecycle dates and the enactment number. Verified detail hop from a matters list row's MatterId.

name: Legistar — sponsors behind a matter
description: Who put the legislation forward: MatterSponsorId, MatterSponsorGuid, MatterSponsorMatterId, MatterSponsorMatterVersion, MatterSponsorNameId (the person id), MatterSponsorBodyId, MatterSponsorName, MatterSponsorSequence, MatterSponsorLastModifiedUtc. Legislation -> people hop.

name: Legistar — action history of a matter (with votes)
description: Every procedural action on a municipal bill: MatterHistoryId, MatterHistoryEventId (links to the meeting), MatterHistoryActionDate, MatterHistoryActionName, MatterHistoryActionText, MatterHistoryPassedFlag, MatterHistoryAgendaSequence/MinutesSequence, MatterHistoryVoteId, MatterHistoryTally and MatterHistoryMoverId/SeconderId. Bill -> committee action -> named vote.

name: Legistar — documents attached to a matter
description: The actual filed documents: MatterAttachmentId, MatterAttachmentName (e.g. 'Att A – CIP Project Additions'), MatterAttachmentHyperlink (direct download on legistar2.granicus.com), MatterAttachmentFileName, MatterAttachmentBinary flag, MatterAttachmentIsSupportingDocument, MatterAttachmentShowOnInternetPage, MatterAttachmentLastModifiedUtc. Terminal document hop.

name: Legistar — amendment versions of a matter
description: Key/Value pairs mapping each internal text id to its version number ([{"Key":"18624","Value":"1"},...]), letting you retrieve every successive draft of an ordinance and diff what changed between readings.

name: Legistar — council members and filers
description: Person registry for the jurisdiction: PersonId, PersonGuid, PersonFirstName/LastName/FullName, PersonActiveFlag, PersonCanViewFlag, PersonEmail, PersonWWW, PersonPhone, PersonAddress1/City1/State1/Zip1, PersonLastModifiedUtc. PersonId joins to MatterSponsorNameId and to vote records.

name: Legistar — council/committee meetings
description: Meetings: EventId, EventGuid, EventBodyId, EventBodyName (e.g. 'Parks, Seattle Center, Libraries, and Gender Pay Equity Committee'), EventDate, EventTime, EventLocation, EventAgendaFile, EventMinutesFile, EventVideoPath, EventInSiteURL, EventLastModifiedUtc. EventId opens the agenda-item hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — agenda items inside a meeting
description: What was actually taken up at a meeting: EventItemId, EventItemEventId, EventItemAgendaSequence, EventItemMinutesSequence, EventItemAgendaNumber, EventItemTitle, EventItemActionName, EventItemActionText, EventItemPassedFlag, EventItemMatterId (links back to the legislation), EventItemMover/Seconder, EventItemVideo, EventItemTally. Verified meeting -> item -> matter hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — legislative bodies and committees
description: Council, committees, boards and commissions: BodyId, BodyGuid, BodyName, BodyTypeId/Name, BodyMeetFlag, BodyActiveFlag, BodyDescription, BodyContactNameId, BodyLastModifiedUtc. The org chart above matters and events.

name: Norway Brreg Regnskapsregisteret (filed annual accounts)
description: Full filed annual accounts for a Norwegian org number: regnskapsperiode, currency, oppstillingsplan, audit flags (ikkeRevidertAarsregnskap, fravalgRevisjon), accounting rules, and the whole balance sheet + P&L tree (sumEgenkapitalGjeld, egenkapital, opptjentEgenkapital, gjeld, driftsresultat). One object per filed year. Direct second hop off any enheter/{orgnr} row.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Norway Brreg change feed (Enhetsregisteret updates)
description: Chronological change stream of the Norwegian company register: oppdateringsid, timestamp, organisasjonsnummer, endringstype (Endring/Ny/Sletting/Fjernet) plus a _links.enhet href to the full entity. Lets you watch every registry mutation nationwide and pull the changed record. Cursor via ?oppdateringsid= or ?dato=.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Norway Brreg sub-unit (establishment) detail record
description: Full record for a single Norwegian establishment/branch (underenhet): name, complete historiskeNavn array with fraDato/tilDato, organisasjonsform, beliggenhetsadresse and postadresse, kommune, naeringskode, antallAnsatte, registration and deletion dates, and overordnetEnhet pointing back at the parent company. This is the detail hop behind /api/underenheter?overordnetEnhet=.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Norway Brreg role-type codelist
description: The 27 officer/role codes used by the Brreg roller endpoint (DAGL managing director, LEDE chair, MEDL board member, BOBE bankruptcy trustee, BEST managing shipowner, REVI auditor, KOMP general partner, etc.) with code + Norwegian description. Required to decode the roller detail hop into readable officer positions.

name: Norway Brreg legal-form codelist
description: All 44 Norwegian legal forms (AS, ASA, ANS, DA, ENK, SPA sparebank, FLI association, BEDR sub-unit, ADOS public administrative unit, …) with code and description. Decodes organisasjonsform.kode on every enheter/underenheter record.

name: Norway Brreg Kunngjøringer (official register announcements)
description: Date-ranged official announcement search covering bankruptcies, compulsory liquidations, mergers, demergers and capital changes. Rows carry the announcement date, announcement type, company name and 9-digit organisasjonsnummer with a link to virksomhet.brreg.no/oppslag/enheter/{orgnr}, so each hit pivots straight into the Enhetsregisteret. id_niva1/id_niva2 select the announcement category (51/54 = bankruptcy, trustee work discontinued). Page is ISO-8859-1.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Czech ARES — RES (statistical business register) record
