description: Sub-register hop off an ICO: the Czech Statistical Office register record — obchodniJmeno, fully structured sidlo (kodObce/nazevObce, kodUlice, cisloDomovni, cisloOrientacni, kodAdresnihoMista, psc, standardised textovaAdresa), pravniForma, datumVzniku/datumZaniku, size class and NACE activity codes. Complements the base ekonomicke-subjekty record already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Czech ARES — RŽP (trade licence register) record
description: The trade-licensing register behind an ICO — 115 KB for a large company. Lists every živnost (trade licence) held: subject of business, licence type, valid-from/valid-to, issuing trade office, plus responsible representatives (odpovedni zastupci) and all registered business addresses. This is the Czech equivalent of a permits-and-authorisations dossier per company, far deeper than the base ARES record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPO — Register of Legal Entities (name search)
description: Keyless JSON search over the Slovak Register právnických osôb. Every hit is already a rich record: internal id, identifiers (ICO with validFrom), full name history with validFrom/validTo, address history, legalForms, establishment/termination dates, sourceRegister (Obchodný register / Živnostenský register), legalStatuses (e.g. 'Zaniknutá spoločnosť'), and empty-or-populated statutoryBodies and stakeholders arrays. The `id` is the key to the entity detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPO — legal entity detail (officers + stakeholders)
description: The detail hop behind an RPO search row. Returns identifiers, legalForms with validity ranges, activities, statutoryBodies (directors/officers with their own validity ranges), stakeholders (owners/partners), legalStatuses (dissolution reasons, e.g. 'Iný dôvod zrušenia spoločnosti', 'Zaniknutá spoločnosť') and termination date. This is the officers-behind-the-company hop for Slovakia.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPO — lookup by IČO
description: Same RPO record set but pivoted on the 8-digit IČO instead of a name, so a company number from any other Slovak source resolves straight to the full name history (e.g. SLOVTEL GSM → GLOBTEL GSM → Globtel → Orange Slovensko), address history, legal form and statutory bodies. The direct entity-number entry point into the Slovak register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — accounting-unit id search
description: Keyless id-search over the Slovak register of financial statements. Filter by ico=, zmenene-od= (changed since) and max-zaznamov=; returns {id:[…], existujeDalsieId:bool} — a paginated list of internal accounting-unit ids plus a has-more flag. Entry point of a four-level chain: accounting unit → financial statement → statement form → PDF attachment.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — accounting unit detail
description: Company dossier: ico, dic (tax number), nazovUJ, full address (ulica/mesto/psc/kraj/okres), datumZalozenia, pravnaForma, velkostOrganizacie, druhVlastnictva — plus idUctovnychZavierok[] (14 financial-statement ids) and idVyrocnychSprav[] (15 annual-report ids). Those two arrays are the ownership of the whole filing history for that company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — statements changed-since feed
description: Change feed of Slovak financial statements: give zmenene-od=YYYY-MM-DD and get the ids of every statement filed or amended since, with existujeDalsieId paging. Lets you sweep new filings nationwide and then pull each one.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — financial statement detail
description: A single filed statement: idUJ back-link to the company, obdobieOd/obdobieDo, datumZostaveniaK, datumPodania, datumZostavenia, datumSchvalenia, datumPrilozeniaSpravyAuditora (auditor report attached date), typ (Riadna/Mimoriadna), zdrojDat, and idUctovnychVykazov[] — the ids of the individual statement forms that make it up.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — statement form + attachments
description: Deepest level of the Slovak chain: the individual accounting form, with idUctovnejZavierky back-link, idSablony (template), kodDanovehoUradu (tax office code), pristupnostDat, and prilohy[] — the actual documents with id, filename, byte size, page count, language, mimeType and a SHA-256 digest for integrity checking.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — annual reports changed-since feed
description: Change feed of Slovak annual reports (výročné správy) by zmenene-od date, returning ids + existujeDalsieId. Companion feed to the financial-statements one; each id resolves to a report with its PDF attachments.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — annual report detail
description: Annual report record: idUJ back-link, obdobieOd/obdobieDo, datumZostaveniaK, datumPodania, typ (Individuálna/Konsolidovaná výročná správa), pristupnostDat, and prilohy[] with the real PDF filenames, byte sizes, language and SHA-256 digests.

name: Poland Ministry of Finance VAT White List — by NIP
description: The Polish 'biała lista podatników VAT'. For a NIP on a given date returns registered name, statusVat (Czynny/Zwolniony/Niezarejestrowany), regon, KRS number, residence/working address, representatives[], authorizedClerks[], partners[], registration/denial/restoration/removal dates AND accountNumbers[] — the company's declared bank accounts. The KRS field pivots straight into the KRS extract API.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland VAT White List — by REGON
description: Same white-list record (name, statusVat, nip, krs, addresses, representatives, partners, bank accountNumbers) but keyed on the 9/14-digit REGON statistical number, so a REGON from any Polish statistical dataset resolves to the tax and KRS identity.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland VAT White List — reverse lookup by bank account
description: Reverse pivot: give a 26-digit Polish bank account number and get every taxpayer that has declared it — name, NIP, REGON, KRS, statusVat, addresses, representatives, partners. An account-number-to-company resolver, which is rare and very high value for tracing payments.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland VAT White List — batch NIP lookup
description: Batch form of the white list: comma-separated NIPs in one request, response grouped as entries[].identifier + entries[].subjects[] with the same full payload (name, statusVat, regon, krs, addresses, representatives, partners, accountNumbers). Lets you resolve a whole list of Polish counterparties in a single request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland KRS — full (Pełny) extract, entrepreneurs register
description: 326 KB for a large company: the FULL historical KRS extract, not the current-state one already in the tree. naglowekP lists every wpis (entry) ever made — entry number, description, date, court case signature (sygnaturaAktSprawy) and the registering court — then the historical sections covering share capital changes, every past and present board member and supervisory board member, shareholders/partners, branches, mergers and PKD activity, each with its entry/deletion marker. This is the docket-level history behind a Polish company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland KRS — full (Pełny) extract, associations/foundations register
description: Same full historical extract but for rejestr=S — associations, foundations, social organisations, trade unions and other non-commercial legal persons. Gives the complete entry history with court signatures plus every past and present board member, statutory-body composition and purpose changes. The NGO-side counterpart to the rejestr=P extract.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BOE open-data API — daily gazette summary (JSON)
description: 186 KB JSON index of one day of the Boletín Oficial del Estado: diario → seccion → departamento → epigrafe → item, each item carrying its identificador (BOE-A-2026-NNNNN), titulo, and url_pdf/url_xml/url_html with byte sizes. Undocumented-in-tree machine-readable alternative to the HTML search; the identificador is the key to the per-document XML.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BOE — full document XML
description: The detail hop behind a BOE summary item: full structured act with metadatos (identificador, origen_legislativo, departamento + code, rango, fecha_disposicion, titulo, fecha_publicacion, page range, ELI/URL), the analisis block (materias, notas, references to modified/modifying acts) and the complete body text. Departmental appointment/dismissal resolutions name individuals directly.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BORME open-data API — company register gazette summary (JSON)
description: Machine-readable daily index of the Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil — the Spanish companies register gazette. Sections A (acts registered: incorporations, director appointments/dismissals, capital changes, mergers, dissolutions), B (balance-sheet deposits) and C (other announcements), broken down by mercantile registry province, each entry with identificador and PDF/XML URLs.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BORME — full company-register act XML
description: 164 KB per province-day. The actual registered corporate acts for one mercantile registry: company name, registry sheet number, and the specific act text — 'Nombramientos' with the named directors and their posts, 'Ceses/Dimisiones', capital increases, sole-shareholder declarations, mergers, dissolutions and liquidator appointments. This is the officer-appointment feed for Spain and it is fully keyless.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — subsidy calls search (648,255 records)
description: Base Nacional de Subvenciones, keyless JSON. Paged list of every subsidy call: id, numeroConvocatoria (BDNS code), descripcion in Spanish and co-official language, fechaRecepcion, and the granting body as nivel1 (STATE/AUTONOMICA/LOCAL) / nivel2 / nivel3. totalElements 648,255. numeroConvocatoria is the key to the call detail.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — subsidy call detail
description: Detail hop for a subsidy call: organo hierarchy, sedeElectronica URL, codigoBDNS, fechaRecepcion, instrumentos, tipoConvocatoria (e.g. 'Concesión directa - instrumental'), presupuestoTotal, MRR flag, full description and the regulatory-basis links. Pairs with the concesiones search to go call → who actually got the money.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — subsidy awards / beneficiaries (28,714,508 records)
description: Every individual subsidy award in Spain: codConcesion, fechaConcesion, beneficiario as '<NIF/CIF> <NAME>' (so the company tax ID is in the record), instrumento, importe, ayudaEquivalente, urlBR to the legal basis, plus numeroConvocatoria/idConvocatoria linking back to the call. 28.7 million rows. Direct money-to-named-entity trail.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — awards filtered by beneficiary NIF/CIF
description: Entity pivot into the 28.7M-row award table: pass nifCif=<Spanish tax ID> and get every grant that company or association has received — date, amount, instrument, granting body, call number and legal basis. Turns any Spanish CIF into a complete public-funding history. descripcionBeneficiario= also works for name search.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — subsidy fraud sanctions register
description: Enforcement actions for subsidy fraud: sancionado as '<CIF> <COMPANY NAME>', infraccion (the specific article breached, e.g. 'ART. 58.A obtención de una subvención falseando las condiciones requeridas'), importe, fechaSancion, fechaConcesion, and the convocatoria/granting body it relates to. Small table but it is a named-and-shamed debarment-style list keyed on company tax ID.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — State aid awards (6,493,593 records)
description: State-aid-classified awards: idConcesion, codConcesion, idPersona (internal beneficiary id), convocante (granting authority), reglamento (the exact EU block-exemption regulation invoked, e.g. REG (UE) 2022/2472), objetivo (the article of the regulation), amount and dates. Lets you profile which EU aid instruments a Spanish entity has drawn on.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — de minimis aid register (4,378,791 records)
description: De minimis aid awards under REG (UE) 2023/2831 and sectoral variants: idConcesion, idPersona, convocante, reglamento, sectorProducto, instrumento, fechaConcesion, fechaRegistro and beneficiario with its CIF. Used to test whether a company is near the de minimis ceiling — i.e. its full small-aid footprint.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — subsidies to political parties and associations (6,363 records)
description: Public money flowing to political parties, foundations and civic associations: beneficiario with CIF, fechaConcesion, importe, ayudaEquivalente, instrumento, urlBR to the awarding bulletin and the linked convocatoria. A small, high-signal table for political-finance work.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — large beneficiaries by year (147,704 records)
description: Per-year aggregate of the biggest recipients: idPersona, beneficiario with its identifier (Spanish CIF or foreign registration number), ejercicio and ayudaETotal (total aid equivalent). Gives you a ranked list of who takes the most Spanish public subsidy in a given year, and idPersona ties back into the award tables.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — granting-body hierarchy codelist
description: Tree of Spanish granting authorities (ministries → directorates-general → agencies) with descripcion, id and nested children[]. idAdmon selects the administration level (C central, A autonomic, L local). Needed to filter the award tables by authority and to resolve the nivel1/nivel2/nivel3 strings.

name: Spain Plataforma de Contratación del Estado — full tender syndication (Atom/CODICE)
description: Official Atom syndication of every Spanish public tender, with full CODICE/UBL payload inline (cbc/cac namespaces): contracting authority, procedure type, CPV, budget, deadlines, and — in award entries — the winning economic operator with its identification number. Feed is paged via next links; the single page I pulled hit my 6 MB fetch cap, so it is large and must be paged.

name: EU VIES VAT validation REST API (all member states)
description: Keyless REST replacement for the old VIES SOAP service. Path is /ms/{2-letter member state}/vat/{vat number}. Returns isValid, userError (VALID/INVALID/MS_UNAVAILABLE), and the officially registered name and address as held by that member state's tax administration — verified live for DK (GOOGLE DENMARK ApS), FR (SA SODIMAS), SE (SAAB AKTIEBOLAG), PL (ORANGE POLSKA SA), IE (GOOGLE IRELAND LIMITED). Also returns a viesApproximate block with per-field match scores. One EU-wide entity resolver for any VAT number.

name: ESMA registers — raw Solr, upreg core (101,959 docs)
description: The raw Solr index behind the ESMA register UI, far deeper than the searchRegister HTML endpoint already in the tree. Parent docs are entities (ae_entityName, ae_entityTypeCode MIF/CI/…, ae_lei, ae_headOfficeLei, ae_officeType Branch/Head office, ae_competentAuthority, ae_lastUpdate); child docs (type_s:child, _root_) are the individual authorised activities/services (ac_serviceName, ac_authorisationNotificationDateStr, ac_status). Supports full Solr syntax, e.g. q=ae_entityName:*Deutsche* → 46 hits.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ESMA — national securities-regulator sanctions register (1,378 docs)
description: Every sanction imposed by an EU national competent authority under MiFID/MAR/UCITS/AIFMD etc.: sn_entityName (with an embedded href to the entity's upreg detail page), sn_entityEsmaID, sn_sanctionLegalFrameworkName, sn_date, sn_ncaCodeFullName + sn_sanctioningNCACode (e.g. CZ_CNB Czech National Bank), sn_countryName, sn_nature/sn_natureFullName (ADSM administrative sanction and measure). The enforcement-actions layer sitting on top of the ESMA entity register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ESMA — MiFID share trading obligation / exemptions core (162,834 docs)
description: Instrument-level register: shs_isin, shs_name (issuer), shs_countryCode, shs_relevantAuthority (e.g. 'Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin)'), shs_status, shs_exemptionStartDateStr, shs_modificationDateStr. 162k rows mapping ISINs to issuers and their supervising national authority — useful for resolving a security back to a regulated issuer and its home regulator.

name: ESMA FIRDS file index (18,480 docs)
description: Index of the Financial Instruments Reference Data System delivery files — the bulk reference dataset covering every MiFIR-reportable instrument in the EU. Each doc points at a downloadable full/delta file with its publication date and checksum, which is the entry point to the complete EU instrument-to-issuer reference data.

name: EBA EUCLID register — entity search (POST, Mongo-style query)
description: POST application/json. The ONLY body shapes that return data are {"$and":[{"_payload.CA_OwnerID":"<NCA code>"}]} — 1,045 records for DE_BAFIN — and {"$and":[{"_payload.EntityCode":"<code>"}]} for a single entity. Each record: CA_OwnerID (supervising national authority), EntityCode, EntityType (CI credit institution, PSD_PI payment institution, EMI, …), Properties[] (ENT_AUT authorisation date, ENT_COD, ENT_COD_TYP LEI/NON_LEI, ENT_NAT_REF_COD national reference number, ENT_NAM, ENT_ADD, ENT_TOW_CIT_RES, ENT_POS_COD, ENT_COU_RES) and Services{} — the per-country passporting map listing exactly which PSD2 services (PS_010, PS_020, PS_03C…) the firm may provide in AT/DE/ES/FR/GR/IT/… That passporting matrix is the deep layer no HTML register exposes.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Germany Bundestag Lobbyregister — JSON search
description: Fully documented JSON export of the German federal lobby register ($schema + jsonDocumentationUrl are in the response). Each result carries registerEntryDetails.registerEntryId, detailsPageUrl (/suche/R######/#####), accountDetails.activeLobbyist, accountHasCodexViolations (code-of-conduct breaches), entrustedPersonsCount, membersCount, membershipsCount, fields of interest codes, regulatoryProjectsCount (which legislative files they lobbied), statementsCount and contractsCount. resultCount 17 for BASF.

name: Germany Marktstammdatenregister — electricity generation units + operators
description: Keyless Kendo-grid JSON over the German energy master data register. Per unit: Id, MaStRNummer (SEE…), AnlagenbetreiberId + AnlagenbetreiberMaStRNummer (ABR…) + AnlagenbetreiberName — i.e. the legal operator behind each asset — BetriebsStatusName, EinheitName, InbetriebnahmeDatum, EinheitMeldeDatum, Ort, Plz, Flurstueck (land parcel), Bruttoleistung, EnergietraegerName. The AnlagenbetreiberId is a stable operator key that links every asset owned by the same company. NOTE: the `filter=` parameter is mandatory — omitting it returns {"Error":true}.

name: Germany rechtsprechung-im-internet — full decision index (83,913 items)
description: 1.1 MB DTD-typed XML listing every federal court decision published by the German Federal Ministry of Justice: <gericht> (e.g. 'BVerwG 9. Senat'), <entsch-datum> YYYYMMDD, <aktenzeichen> (case number), <link> to a per-decision ZIP, and <modified>. The complete case index; each link is the detail hop to the full judgment.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Germany rechtsprechung-im-internet — single decision (ZIP of XML)
description: Detail hop behind an rii-toc.xml <link>. A ~3 KB ZIP containing one XML file with the full decision: court, senate, decision date, case number, norms applied, headnote (Leitsatz), Tenor, Tatbestand and Entscheidungsgründe. Verified fetch returns application/zip 200.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Netherlands Rechtspraak — full judgment content by ECLI
description: The missing detail hop for the Dutch case-law API whose /uitspraken/zoeken list endpoint is already in the tree. Given an ECLI it returns the complete open-rechtspraak XML: an RDF metadata block (identifier, creator court, date, procedure type, subject area, references to legislation and to related ECLIs, ECLI:NL and EU CELEX cross-links) followed by the full sectioned judgment text with parties, considerations and the ruling.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Netherlands overheid.nl SRU — official publications repository (6,612,875 records)
description: SRU 2.0 search over the whole Dutch official-publications repository (Staatscourant, Staatsblad, Tractatenblad, municipal/provincial gazettes, parliamentary papers). Response is sru:searchRetrieveResponse with sru:numberOfRecords and gzd-wrapped records carrying dcterms metadata and direct XML/HTML/PDF item links. CQL supports field filters (c.product-area==, dt.type==, dt.creator==, dt.date within …). Note: dt.type=="Faillissement" returned 0 records, so bankruptcy notices are not indexed under that type here.

name: Belgium CBE/KBO — registered entity detail page
description: Detail hop behind the KBO name searches already in the tree (only the search forms are there). 33 KB page keyed on the 10-digit enterprise number: general data (status, legal situation with start date, name history with dates, legal form, address history), Functions (the officers — role, name and start date), authorisations/capacities, NACEBEL activity codes for the 2008 and 2025 versions with their validity dates, financial data and links to establishment units and published acts. Available in EN/NL/FR via lang=.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Belgium CBE/KBO — establishment units of an entity
description: Second hop off the entity page: the list of all establishment units (vestigingen) belonging to a Belgian enterprise number, each with its own 10-digit vestigingsnummer, name and address. Those vestiging numbers in turn resolve via toonvestigingps.html to per-site activity and start/stop dates — the branch-network layer under a Belgian company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Denmark CVR — full company record (datacvr gateway)
description: The JSON gateway behind the official Danish CVR web UI, keyless. 9 KB per company: aktiveEjerforholdDto (active ownership relations), antalAnsatte.kvartalsbeskaeftigelse (quarterly employee and FTE bands per year/quarter), name and address history, industry codes, status and legal form. Deeper than the third-party cvrapi.dk wrapper already in the tree. WARNING: Cloudflare rate-limits this host aggressively — subsequent gateway calls in my session returned 403 'Just a moment'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Denmark ERST — filed annual reports Elasticsearch (6,422,525 filings)
description: Open, unauthenticated Elasticsearch endpoint over every annual report filed in Denmark: 6,422,525 hits total, 20 for one CVR. Each _source has cvrNummer, sagsNummer, regnskab.regnskabsperiode.startDato/slutDato, sidstOpdateret and dokumenter[] with dokumentType (AARSRAPPORT), dokumentMimeType and dokumentUrl pointing at the actual PDF and machine-readable XBRL. Supports both q= Lucene syntax and full POST DSL. NOTE: HTTP only, no TLS.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Lithuania Registrų centras — register of active legal entities (233,021 rows)
description: Full national dump of registered Lithuanian legal entities, pipe-delimited, keyless. Columns: ja_kodas (entity code), ja_pavadinimas, adresas, ja_reg_data, form_kodas/form_pavadinimas (legal form), stat_kodas/stat_pavadinimas (legal status), stat_data_nuo, formavimo_data. 7.4 MB, 233,021 rows verified by full download.

name: Lithuania Registrų centras — deregistered legal entities (314,966 rows)
description: Companion dump of every struck-off Lithuanian legal entity: ja_kodas, ja_pavadinimas, adresas, ja_reg_data, form_kodas/form_pavadinimas, isreg_data (deregistration date), formavimo_data. 314,966 rows verified by full download. Together with JAR_IREGISTRUOTI this gives complete live + dead coverage of the Lithuanian register.

name: Latvia Uzņēmumu reģistrs — master entity register (487,067 rows)
description: Semicolon-delimited national register dump, keyless. Columns: regcode, sepa (the entity's SEPA identifier), name plus a decomposed name (name_before_quotes/name_in_quotes/name_after_quotes), regtype/regtype_text (Komercreģistrs etc.), type/type_text (legal form), registered, terminated, closed, address, index, addressid, region, city, atvk, reregistration_term. regcode is the join key for the entire Latvian family below.

name: Latvia Uzņēmumu reģistrs — officers / governing bodies (281,523 rows)
description: Every registered officer of every Latvian legal entity. Columns: at_legal_entity_registration_number (the company), entity_type (NATURAL_PERSON/LEGAL_ENTITY), position, governing_body (EXECUTIVE_BOARD, COUNCIL, …), name, latvian_identity_number_masked, birth_date, legal_entity_registration_number (when the officer is itself a company — corporate-officer chains), rights_of_representation_type, representation_with_at_least, registered_on, last_modified_at. This is the officers-behind-the-company table, in bulk, for free.

name: Latvia Uzņēmumu reģistrs — beneficial owners (198,390 rows)
description: Latvia's public UBO register as a plain CSV. Columns: id, legal_entity_registration_number, forename, surname, latvian_identity_number_masked, birth_date, nationality, residence, registered_on, last_modified_at. 198,390 rows verified by full download. One of the very few genuinely open beneficial-ownership registers left in the EU after the 2022 CJEU ruling — this is the beneficial-owners-behind-the-officers layer the brief asks for.

name: Latvia Uzņēmumu reģistrs — members / shareholders of SIAs (184,210 rows)
description: Shareholding table for Latvian limited companies: at_legal_entity_registration_number, entity_type, name, latvian_identity_number_masked, birth_date, legal_entity_registration_number (corporate shareholder — chains upward), number_of_shares, share_nominal_value, share_currency, date_from, registered_on. Joins to register.csv and officers.csv on the registration number to build a full ownership graph.

name: Latvia Uzņēmumu reģistrs — stockholders of AS companies (22,533 rows)
description: Joint-stock company shareholders: at_legal_entity_registration_number, entity_type (incl. DEPOSITORY), name, masked ID, birth_date, legal_entity_registration_number, number_of_shares, share_nominal_value, share_currency, votes, stock_type, depository_registration_number and depository_name, date_from. Captures nominee/depository holdings explicitly, which is exactly what you need to spot custody-obscured ownership.

name: Latvia — legal-person insolvency proceedings (17,973 rows)
description: Every Latvian corporate insolvency case: proceeding_id, debtor_name, debtor_registration_number, debtor_cleaned_name, debtor_address, proceeding_started_on, proceeding_ended_on, proceeding_form, proceeding_type, proceeding_subtype, proceeding_resolution_type/name, entry_created_on, court_case_initial_number, court_code, court_name, creditor_applications_deadline. The insolvency-case hop keyed on the same regcode as the company register.

name: Latvia — liquidations (9,706 rows)
description: Liquidation and activity-termination records: legal_entity_registration_number, liquidation_type + liquidation_type_text (e.g. ACTIVITY_TERMINATED / Darbības izbeigšana), date_from, grounds_for_liquidation (the actual cited decision of the state notary with its number and date), registered_on, last_modified_at.

name: Latvia — sanctioned persons linked to registered entities (64 rows)
description: Small but high-signal: links sanctions listings to Latvian register entries. Columns: entity_type, name, birth_date, latvian_identity_number_masked, nationality, legal_form_code, legal_entity_registration_number and legal_entity_name (the Latvian company the sanctioned party is tied to), legal_entity_country, position with LV/EN text, sanctions_subject_legal_form_code / registration_number / name, list and list_text (which sanctions programme). A ready-made sanctions-to-corporate-control mapping.

name: Latvia — registered and paid-up share capital (142,614 rows)
description: Capital history per entity: legal_entity_registration_number, equity_capital_type + text (PAID_UP_EQUITY / Apmaksātais pamatkapitāls, registered capital, …), amount, currency, date_from, last_modified_at. Lets you track capital increases and reductions over time for any Latvian company.

name: Latvia — mergers, acquisitions and demergers (10,837 rows)
description: Corporate reorganisation edges: id, reorganization_type + text (ACQUISITION / Apvienošanas ceļā pievienota pie, division, transformation), source_entity_regcode, final_entity_regcode, registered. Directly usable as a graph of which Latvian entity absorbed which, with dates.

name: Latvia — securing measures / prohibitions on entities (33,086 rows)
description: Court- and authority-imposed restrictions recorded against Latvian companies: legal_entity_registration_number, securing_measure_type + text (PROHIBITION / Aizliegums, seizure, …), type_details describing the specific restriction (e.g. prohibition on reducing share capital), date_from, case_number, institution_identifier, institution_registration_number and institution_name (which court or bailiff imposed it). This is the liens-and-charges-against-the-company layer.

name: Latvia — filed financial statements index (1,980,826 rows)
description: Index of every annual financial statement filed in Latvia: id (statement_id), file_id, legal_entity_registration_number, source_schema, source_type, year, year_started_on, year_ended_on, employees, rounded_to_nearest, currency, created_at. The statement_id joins to the balance-sheet and income-statement tables below, giving free full financials for ~2M company-years.

name: Latvia — balance sheets keyed to filed statements
description: Line-item balance sheets joined by statement_id to financial_statements.csv. Columns: statement_id, file_id, cash, marketable_securities, accounts_receivable, inventories, total_current_assets, investments, fixed_assets, intangible_assets, total_non_current_assets, total_assets, future_housing_repairs_payments, current_liabilities, non_current_liabilities, provisions, equity, total_equities. items=3 because I only streamed the header and first rows (very large file); HTTP 200 and header shape confirmed.

name: Latvia — income statements keyed to filed statements
description: P&L line items joined by statement_id: net_turnover, by_nature_inventory_change, by_nature_long_term_investment_expenses, by_nature_other_operating_revenues, by_nature_material_expenses, by_nature_labour_expenses, by_nature_depreciation_expenses, by_function_cost_of_goods_sold, by_function_gross_profit, by_function_selling_expenses and the rest of both presentation formats. items=3 because I only streamed the header and first rows; HTTP 200 and header shape confirmed.

name: Estonia e-Business Register — beneficial owners (27.5 MB ZIP of JSON)
description: Downloaded (27,548,523 bytes) and unzipped to verify. JSON array, one object per company: ariregistri_kood, nimi, and kasusaajad[] — each beneficial owner with kirje_id, algus_kpv/lopp_kpv (start/end of the UBO relationship), eesnimi, nimi, isikukood, valis_kood + valis_kood_riik (foreign ID and its country), synniaeg. Estonia's public UBO register in bulk, keyless. items=3 = objects inspected after unzip; the file covers the whole register.

name: Estonia e-Business Register — registry-card persons / officers (45.6 MB ZIP of JSON)
description: Downloaded (45,638,484 bytes) and unzipped to verify. Per company (ariregistri_kood, nimi) an array kaardile_kantud_isikud[] of every person entered on the registry card: kirje_id, kaardi_piirkond/kaardi_nr/kaardi_tyyp, kande_nr, isiku_tyyp (F natural / J legal), isiku_roll + isiku_roll_tekstina (e.g. JUHL = Juhatuse liige, board member), eesnimi, nimi_arinimi, isikukood_hash (stable pseudonymous person key that lets you link the same director across companies), isikukood_registrikood, valis_kood + country. The Estonian officers table in bulk.

name: Estonia e-Business Register — commercial pledges (951 KB ZIP of JSON)
description: Downloaded (951,762 bytes) and unzipped to verify. Per company: ariregistri_kood, nimi and kommertspandiandmed[] — each commercial pledge with kirje_id, kaardi_piirkond, kaardi_nr, kaardi_tyyp, kande_nr, pandi_id, pandi_number, pandi_olek (pledge status) plus amount and pledgee details. This is the charges/liens-filed-against-the-company layer for Estonia.

name: Sweden Finansinspektionen — Insynsregistret (managers' transactions) CSV export
description: Direct CSV export from the Swedish FSA's insider-transaction register, no key, date-rangeable. Columns: Publiceringsdatum, Emittent (issuer), LEI-kod, Anmälningsskyldig (the notifying party), Person i ledande ställning, Befattning (position), Närstående (closely-associated-person flag), Korrigering + description, first-time-reporting flag, share-programme flag, Karaktär (acquisition/disposal), Instrumenttyp, Instrumentnamn, ISIN, Transaktionsdatum, volume, price and currency. 227 transaction rows for a 16-day window. Directly ties named executives to issuers by LEI. NOTE: the file is UTF-16LE encoded.

name: Iceland Skatturinn — company register lookup by kennitala
description: Iceland's company register (fyrirtækjaskrá) detail page keyed on the 10-digit kennitala. Returns registered name, VAT (VSK) registration numbers with their valid-from dates, ISAT activity classification, address, and a table of the years for which annual accounts (ársreikningar) have been filed together with the filing date and the name used in each year. Title tag carries 'Name (kennitala)' so the record is trivially parseable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: France INSEE — Sirene 'avis de situation' by SIRET (keyless PDF)
description: Keyless INSEE endpoint (the api.insee.fr Sirene REST API already in the tree needs an OAuth key; this one does not). Given a 14-digit SIRET it returns the official establishment situation notice as a 180 KB tagged PDF: SIREN, SIRET, denomination, legal form, full establishment address, APE/NAF activity code and label, employee band, creation date and headquarters flag. Useful as a keyless fallback when the Sirene credential is missing.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Rechtspraak Open Data - uitspraken changed-since feed
description: Atom feed of Dutch court rulings filtered by last-modified date (incremental harvest). Each entry: ECLI as <id>, court name, decision date, case number, plain-text summary, updated timestamp, alternate HTML link. The ECLI feeds the content detail hop which returns the ENTIRE ruling: RDF metadata block (court, jurisdiction, procedure type, subject area, references to legislation and cited case law) plus the full section-by-section judgment text.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Rechtspraak - court/tribunal authority list
description: 261 Dutch judicial bodies: PSI identifier URI, full name, abbreviation, institution type (court, tribunal, disciplinary body), begin date and end date. Decodes the court component of every ECLI and lets you enumerate rulings per court.

name: Rechtspraak - legal subject-area taxonomy
description: 32 legal-domain identifiers (criminal, civil, administrative, tax, European law, etc.) with URIs and Dutch labels; these are the facet values accepted by the uitspraken/zoeken subject filter.

name: Overheid.nl SRU - Dutch professional disciplinary rulings
description: 48,119 disciplinary decisions against named lawyers, doctors, dentists, notaries, accountants and vets (Raad van Discipline, Tuchtcollege voor de Gezondheidszorg, etc.). Per record: ECLI, title with tribunal + date + case number, tribunal name, creator body, modified/available dates, complaint-outcome summary, subject classification, and gzd:enrichedData carrying the PDF and XML manifestation URLs. The XML manifestation is the detail hop and holds the full anonymised decision text and sanction imposed.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Overheid.nl SRU - official Dutch government publications
description: 6,612,875 records: Staatsblad, Staatscourant, parliamentary papers, agency decisions, permits and notices. Each record carries dcterms identifier/title/creator/date plus gzd:enrichedData with preferredUrl and per-format itemUrl (pdf/xml/html) for the full document. CQL supports filtering by dt.type, creator, date range.

name: Overheid.nl SRU - local government official notices
description: 6,201 municipal/provincial/water-board notices (permits, enforcement orders, zoning decisions) with identifier, title, issuing authority, date and manifestation URLs.

name: Overheid.nl SRU explain (index catalogue)
description: SRU explain document enumerating the searchable index sets (c, cd, dt, gzd, ot, w, t, v, manifest, sitemap, short) and every supported CQL index name - the machine-readable map of what can be queried across all 6.6M Dutch official records.

name: Austria RIS - Datenschutzbehoerde (DPA) decisions
description: 347 hits for this query. Decisions of the Austrian Data Protection Authority - the only working national GDPR enforcement decision API I found. Per record: document ID, issuing organ, publication and amendment dates, business/case number (Geschaeftszahl), decision date, legal norms applied, headnote/Rechtssatz, and DokumentUrl. Detail hop returns the full reasoned decision incl. the controller named and the fine or order imposed.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Austria RIS - ordinary courts case law (OGH/OLG)
description: Supreme Court and appellate court decisions, full-text searchable. Per record: document ID, court (Organ), decision date, case reference, norms cited, legal principle text, and DokumentUrl to the full judgment.

name: Austria RIS - Supreme Administrative Court (VwGH)
description: Administrative supreme court rulings - the appellate layer over regulatory and licensing enforcement. Document ID, decision date, case number, norms, legal principle, DokumentUrl.

name: Austria RIS - Constitutional Court (VfGH)
description: 411 hits for this query. Constitutional Court decisions incl. review of statutes and of administrative enforcement acts. Same record shape: ID, organ, date, case number, norms, principle, DokumentUrl.

name: Austria RIS - Federal Administrative Court (BVwG)
description: First-instance federal administrative court decisions - asylum, telecoms, environment, procurement review. ID, senate, decision date, case number, norms, principle, DokumentUrl.

name: Austria RIS - regional administrative courts (LVwG)
description: 12,355 hits for this query. State-level administrative court rulings, dominated by appeals against administrative PENALTIES (Verwaltungsstrafen) issued by regulators. ID, court, date, case number, norms, principle, DokumentUrl.

name: Austria RIS - Equal Treatment Commission findings
description: 1,000 hits for this query. Findings of the Gleichbehandlungskommission on workplace and service discrimination complaints: senate, date, case number, grounds, reasoning, DokumentUrl.

name: Austria RIS - consolidated federal law
description: Consolidated Austrian federal statutes/ordinances searchable by title and text: document ID, short title, section number, version dates, amendment chain, and DokumentUrl to the consolidated text - the norm layer behind every enforcement decision above.

name: Austria RIS - authentic Federal Law Gazette (BGBl)
description: 9,937 hits for this query. Authentic PDF gazette issues: BGBl number, part, publication date, title, and DokumentUrl/PDF - the primary publication record for Austrian regulations and sanctions ordinances.

name: Austria RIS - consolidated state (Land) law
description: 769 hits for this query. Per-Bundesland consolidated statutes and ordinances (building, environment, trade licensing) with document ID, title, section, validity dates and DokumentUrl.

name: SAOS - Polish court judgments search
description: Polish common/supreme/administrative/constitutional court rulings. List row: numeric id, court type, case number(s), judgment type, named judges with their roles (presiding/reporting), judgment date, division. The detail hop /api/judgments/{id} adds the FULL judgment text, the legal bases (referenced statute articles), referenced regulations, keywords and the court division/chamber object.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SAOS - full judgment bulk dump
description: Bulk pagination over every SAOS judgment with the complete record inline (~50 KB/page for 10): full text, judges + roles, legal bases, referenced regulations, court chamber/division ids, source URL and publication date. This is the exhaustive harvest path, no per-record second request needed.

name: SAOS - Polish common courts registry
description: Court entities with id, name, court type/level, parent court and the nested list of divisions (each with its own id, name and type). Resolves the court/division ids that appear on every judgment record.

name: SAOS - Supreme Court chambers and divisions
description: Polish Supreme Court chambers (Izba Karna, Cywilna, etc.) each with id, name and nested divisions - 21 id/name pairs total. Decodes the chamber references on Supreme Court judgments.

name: entscheidsuche.ch - all Swiss court decisions (Elasticsearch proxy)
description: Open Elasticsearch proxy over 53 shards covering federal and all cantonal Swiss courts; 10,000+ hits on a single keyword. Each hit's _source gives: date, court hierarchy array (canton/court/collection), multilingual abstract (de/fr/it), multilingual title, reference/keywords array, source id, AND an attachment object containing content_type, language, the decision PDF content_url and - critically - the ENTIRE extracted PDF text inline. One request yields both the index row and the full decision body; the content_url is the verified PDF detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Gesetze im Internet - full TOC of German federal legislation
description: 6,127 German federal statutes and ordinances: short title, full title, and link to the per-law XML/ZIP. The norm layer that the federal case-law corpus above cites.

name: Open Legal Data DE - single case full record
description: Detail hop for the 423,944-case German corpus (the bare list endpoint is already in the tree; this per-id record is not). Returns id, slug, nested court object (id, name, slug, city, state, jurisdiction, level_of_appeal), file_number, decision date, created/updated timestamps, decision type (Urteil/Beschluss/Endurteil), ECLI, source_url and the full decision CONTENT field.

name: Open Legal Data DE - court registry
description: German court entities with id, name, slug, city id, federal state id, jurisdiction branch (Ordentliche/Verwaltungs/Finanz/Arbeits/Sozial-gerichtsbarkeit) and level_of_appeal. Resolves the court ids on every case record and lets you enumerate cases per court.

name: EU Financial Sanctions Database - full consolidated list (XML)
description: 3.3 MB authoritative EU consolidated sanctions file, 6,234 sanctionEntity records (the tree only has the flattened CSV). Per entity: EU reference number, UN id, logical id, remark, one or more regulation blocks (type, publication date, entry-into-force date, OJ number/title, programme code, EUR-Lex publicationUrl), subject type (person/enterprise), and repeated nameAlias, birthdate, citizenship, address, identification-document and contact sub-records. The regulation publicationUrl links each designation to its legal instrument.

name: EU CELLAR SPARQL endpoint (EUR-Lex / CJEU knowledge graph)
description: Keyless public SPARQL over the Publications Office CDM graph - the machine-readable substrate under EUR-Lex and CJEU case law. The example query enumerates Court of Justice judgments (CELEX 62022CJ*) returning the cellar work URI, CELEX id and document date. The same endpoint reaches parties, ECLI, subject matter, procedure type, national referring court, cited case law and legal basis via other CDM predicates. Each returned work URI is the detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EU CELLAR - full RDF notice by CELEX number
description: 502 KB RDF/XML notice for a single CJEU judgment (here C-311/19) keyed by CELEX: ECLI, case number, parties, date, procedure, judge-rapporteur and advocate-general references, subject-matter classification, EuroVoc descriptors, cited legislation and case law, and every language manifestation with its download URI. The canonical detail hop for any CELEX id found in EUR-Lex or a sanctions regulation reference.

name: EU CELLAR - object notice by cellar UUID
description: 55 KB structured NOTICE (type=object) for a cellar work UUID as returned by the SPARQL endpoint: WORK block with URI/identifier/type, SAMEAS alternate identifiers (CELEX, ELI, OJ reference), expression and manifestation trees. Sending Accept: application/xml;notice=object selects this view. This is the hop that turns a SPARQL result row into a full record.

name: ESMA registers - raw Solr core: investment firms register
description: 101,959 documents. Raw Solr behind the ESMA MiFID investment-firm register (the tree only has the HTML searchRegister wrapper). Parent docs are authorised entities; child docs (entity_type=aeActivity, type_s=child, _root_ pointing at the parent) are the individual authorised services with authorisation/notification dates, end dates and status - i.e. the firm-to-permission detail hop is inside the same index via _root_.

name: ESMA registers - raw Solr core: benchmark administrators
description: 28,134 documents. Benchmark Regulation register entities with ESMA id, full legal name, LEI, country, SUPERVISING NATIONAL AUTHORITY (e.g. BaFin - DEBA), EU/EEA relevant authority, EU/EEA status and registration article, and contact URL. Direct LEI-keyed link from a company to its EU supervisor.

name: ESMA FIRDS - reference-data file index
description: 18,480 published FIRDS instrument-reference files: publication id, file name (FULINS/DLTINS type, date, part-of-N), file type, publication date and download link. The index you page through to bulk-harvest EU instrument reference data.

name: ESMA FIRDS - instrument reference data (raw Solr)
description: 276,183,161 documents. Per instrument: ISIN, MIC of the trading venue, issuer LEI, full instrument name, CFI code, commodity-derivative flag, relevant competent authority, validity from/to dates and the underlying issuer ISIN. Pivot from an ISIN or an issuer LEI to every EU venue the instrument trades on and its supervising authority.

name: ECHA chem - substance search
description: ECHA's chemicals dissemination API. Per item a substanceIndex with rmlId (the ECHA 100.xxx.xxx key), rmlName, EC number, CAS number(s) incl. obsolete ones, IUPAC/InChI/SMILES/molecular formula, CN and HS customs codes, EC index number, and multilingual trade/process-related names, plus a provenance map showing which regulatory source (CNL_NOTIFIED, ECHA_CHEMOINFORMATICS) asserted each identifier. Detail hop by rmlId returns the full substance record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ECHA - REACH registration dossiers for a substance
description: Second-hop from a substance to its regulatory filings: per dossier the assetExternalId, legislation (REACH/CLP/BPR), rootKey, rmlId, last-updated date, REGISTRATION NUMBER (01-2119xxxxxx-xx-nnnn), registration date, registration status and status-change date, dossier subtype (Article 10 full / Article 17 intermediate) and registration ROLE (Lead vs Member of the joint submission). This is how you enumerate who has registered a chemical in the EU and in what capacity.

name: EUDAMED - EU medical device UDI/DI registry
description: 3,153,523 registered devices. Per row: basicUdi, primaryDi, uuid/ulid, risk class, trade name, MANUFACTURER name + SRN (e.g. GB-MF-000008558) + status, AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVE name + SRN, device market status (on-the-market / no-longer-on-the-market), version number and internal reference. Detail hop by uuid returns the full UDI-DI record (packaging, sterility, clinical sizes, storage, applicable legislation, market history).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EUDAMED - notified-body certificates
description: 4,414 MDR/IVDR certificates. Per row: NOTIFIED BODY SRN, manufacturer actorSrn + name (multilingual) + status, certificate number, certificate type (e.g. quality-management-system), issue date, expiry date, starting validity date, certificate status (issued/suspended/withdrawn), revision and version number. Ties a manufacturer to the notified body that certified it and to suspensions/withdrawals. Detail hop by uuid verified.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EUDAMED - registered economic operators (actors)
description: 48,893 EU-registered manufacturers, authorised representatives, importers and system/procedure-pack producers. Per row: uuid/ulid, name (multilingual), actor type + SRN code + category, actor status, role name, country, date of registration, EUDAMED identifier (SRN), ELECTRONIC MAIL, TELEPHONE, full geographical address with street/building/postbox/postal zone/city. The SRN links straight to the device and certificate registries above.

name: EU Clinical Trials Register (EudraCT) - trial summary export
description: Keyless bulk text export of the EU clinical trials register. Per trial: EudraCT number, sponsor protocol number, SPONSOR NAME, full title, start date, medical condition, coded MedDRA disease terms, population age/gender, trial phase, and per-member-state authorisation records. Pivot from a pharma sponsor to every EU trial it ran.

name: EU Clinical Trials Register (EudraCT) - full trial export
description: 637 KB deep export for the same page of trials: everything in the summary plus sponsor legal contact details, funder, IMP names/INN/ATC codes, inclusion and exclusion criteria, endpoints, per-member-state competent-authority and ethics-committee decision dates, and trial status per country. The detail-depth companion to the summary export.

name: ECHR HUDOC - judgments query with resolved field set
description: 29,213 judgments for this filter (211,368 documents in the whole collection). The tree has the bare endpoint; this is the working select= field list, which is what actually makes it parse: itemid, docname (CASE OF X v. STATE), appno (application numbers), extractedappno (every cited application), respondent state code, CONCLUSION (the article-by-article violation findings), ECLI, kpdate, doctypebranch (CHAMBER/GRANDCHAMBER/COMMITTEE), originatingbody, importance level, documentcollectionid2 and languageisocode. Detail hop by itemid returns the complete judgment text as HTML.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ECHR HUDOC - judgment PDF conversion
description: 223 KB official PDF of a single ECtHR judgment keyed by the HUDOC itemid - the authoritative document behind each row of the query endpoint, useful when the HTML body conversion loses annexes or tables.

name: BOE Spain - Official State Gazette daily summary API
description: 269 KB JSON (send Accept: application/json). Full structured index of one BOE issue: issue number, sections and departments, and 210 item entries each with BOE-A-YYYY-NNNN identifier, title, department, rank/instrument type, page range, url_html, url_xml and url_pdf. BOE section V carries court summonses, insolvency notices, debarments and administrative sanction publications. The url_xml is the verified detail hop and returns the full act with metadata (identificador, origen_legislativo, departamento with code, rango, fecha_disposicion, titulo) plus the complete text.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: BORME Spain - Mercantile Registry Gazette daily summary API
description: Daily index of the Spanish commercial register gazette (Accept: application/json): per entry BORME-A-YYYY-NN-PP identifier, province section, title, and url_xml/url_html/url_pdf. The XML detail hop returns the structured per-province act listing incorporations, director appointments/removals, capital changes, mergers and dissolutions for named companies.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: BOE Spain - consolidated legislation API
description: 213 KB consolidated text of a Spanish statute by BOE id (requires Accept: application/xml). Metadata block with identificador, ambito, departamento, rango, dates, plus the full article-by-article consolidated text and the amendment/derogation chain (analisis references to modifying and modified acts).

name: Diavgeia Greece - transparency decisions with luminapi detail hop
description: Every Greek public-body act (Greek transparency law): protocol number, subject, issue date, organizationId, signerIds, unitIds, decisionType id, thematic categories, ADA (the unique act code), publish/submission timestamps, version id, status, related-decision and co-competent-body references. Includes fines, disciplinary decisions, procurement awards and appointments. The tree has the search endpoint but resolves details via the HTML /decision/view page; the JSON detail hop https://diavgeia.gov.gr/luminapi/api/decisions/{ada} is what returns the machine-readable record and is verified here.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPVS - public-sector partners with parent entity expanded
description: Slovak Register of Public Sector Partners (mandatory beneficial-ownership register for anyone taking public money). This $expand form returns each registered partner - person name/surname/date of birth or company ObchodneMeno + ICO, legal-person flag, validity from/to - together with its parent Partner record. The tree has the bare list; the expand form and the id detail hop below are the deep path.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPVS - qualified complaints / enforcement proceedings
description: Enforcement proceedings opened against registered partners for false beneficial-ownership declarations: proceeding id, date proceedings started, date ended, date the decision became final, decision-outcome code, and the COURT FILE NUMBER (SpisovaZnackaKonania, e.g. 43PExre/1/2017). This is the sanction layer of the register - the record that says a partner was investigated and struck off.

name: Slovakia RPVS - OData service document
description: Lists the seven entity sets of the register: Partneri, PartneriVerejnehoSektora, OpravneneOsoby (authorised verifying persons), KonecniUzivateliaVyhod (ULTIMATE BENEFICIAL OWNERS), VerejniFunkcionari (public officials among the owners), VerifikacneDokumenty (verification documents), KvalifikovanePodnety. Needed to drive $expand and $filter correctly - note there is no PartnerId property, traversal must go through Partneri({id})?$expand=.

name: UK Food Standards Agency - food/allergy alerts (linked-data API)
description: UK FSA product recall and allergy alerts as linked data. Per alert: notation (FSA-AA-NN-YYYY), title, type (Allergy Alert / Product Recall / Product Withdrawal), created and modified timestamps, the RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS/company, affected product list with pack size, batch codes and best-before dates, hazard/allergen classification, action taken, and related-alert links. Detail hop by notation returns the single full alert. NOTE: country field should read GB - the FSA is the UK food regulator.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - CMA competition and merger cases
description: 2,573 Competition and Markets Authority cases (mergers, cartels, market investigations, consumer enforcement). Per row: title naming the parties, link, description of the transaction/conduct, case_type, case_state (open/closed), opened_date, closed_date, market_sector. Detail hop via the GOV.UK Content API returns the full case page including every published document (decision notices, provisional findings, undertakings, penalty notices) with dates and file URLs. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Employment Tribunal decisions
description: Employment Tribunal judgments, title carries claimant v respondent employer and case number (e.g. 2600557/2024), plus decision categories and decision date. Detail hop via the Content API yields the full decision page with the downloadable judgment documents. Names employers found liable for discrimination, unfair dismissal, whistleblowing detriment. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Upper Tribunal (Administrative Appeals) decisions
description: Upper Tribunal AAC decisions with neutral citation ([2026] UKUT 276 (AAC)), parties, subject categories, decision date and the judges. Content API detail hop returns the full decision document. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Tax and Chancery Tribunal decisions
description: Upper Tribunal Tax and Chancery decisions - HMRC v taxpayer, financial-services regulatory references, VAT and avoidance-scheme litigation. Neutral citation, parties, category and decision date; Content API detail hop returns the full judgment. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - MHRA medical device / drug safety alerts
description: MHRA device safety information and national patient safety alerts, e.g. devices supplied without valid UKCA/CE conformity marking ordered removed from use. Per row: title with alert reference (DSI/2026/007), alert_type, issued_date, medical specialism. Content API detail hop returns the full alert naming the manufacturer, affected models and required action. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Rail Accident Investigation Branch reports
description: RAIB investigation reports: report number, incident description, date_of_occurrence, railway type. Content API detail hop returns the full report page with the PDF, findings, causal factors and safety recommendations addressed to named operators and infrastructure managers. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Marine Accident Investigation Branch reports
description: MAIB reports naming the vessel and its registration (e.g. fishing vessel Silver Cloud II WK 80), date_of_occurrence and vessel type. Content API detail hop returns the full investigation report with owner/operator, causal analysis and recommendations. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - MHRA Drug Safety Update
description: MHRA monthly drug safety bulletins - product-level warnings, restrictions and label changes (e.g. botulinum toxin type A iatrogenic botulism warning). Title, link, summary, first_published_at; Content API detail hop returns the full article with the affected products and the regulatory action taken. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Find Case Law (TNA) - judgment feed with Akoma Ntoso XML detail hop
description: National Archives Find Case Law, 8,124 pages of judgments. Each entry: document id (d-uuid), case name, court, date, and alternate links to the HTML page, the PDF on assets.caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk, and - the part the tree does not have - the /data.xml Akoma Ntoso representation. That XML carries structured FRBR metadata, neutral citation, court, judges, PARTIES and their counsel, and the fully marked-up judgment body with numbered paragraphs. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DILA open data - Cour de cassation bulk archives (CASS)
description: Apache index of 51 dated .tar.gz incremental archives of the French Court of Cassation decision database, refreshed roughly weekly. Each archive holds per-decision XML with formation, decision date, pourvoi number, ECLI, solution, cited texts and the full text. The only keyless route to French supreme-court case law (Judilibre/Legifrance both require a PISTE key).

name: DILA open data - Conseil d'Etat / administrative courts (JADE)
description: Apache index of 301 dated .tar.gz archives of the JADE database - Conseil d'Etat and administrative appeal court decisions, i.e. the French judicial review of regulatory and enforcement action. Per-decision XML with jurisdiction, date, requete number, ECLI, and full text.

name: DILA open data - Cour de cassation unpublished decisions (INCA)
description: Apache index of 56 dated .tar.gz archives of INCA - Cour de cassation decisions not selected for the official bulletin. Same per-decision XML structure as CASS.

name: DILA open data - courts of appeal decisions (CAPP)
description: Apache index of 20 dated .tar.gz archives of CAPP - French courts of appeal decisions, per-decision XML with court, chamber, date, RG number and full text.

name: Retsinformation Denmark - legal document search API
description: Keyless JSON search over the Danish official legal information system; this filter (dt=10, Acts) returns 2,472 documents across 248 pages. Per document: numeric id, shortName (LOV nr 1618 af 16/12/2025), full title, popular title, RESSORT MINISTRY, document type + ELI type code, ELI retsinfoLink (/eli/lta/2025/1618), classification id, publication date and history flag. Changing dt selects other document types (ordinances, circulars, administrative guidance). I could not find a JSON detail endpoint - the /eli/ page is a client-rendered shell - so no detail hop is claimed.

name: TED — full notice XML (TED_EXPORT)
description: The complete TED notice as TED_EXPORT/eForms XML keyed on publication-number: contracting authority name+address+national ID, CPV codes, procedure type, lot structure, estimated and awarded values, award criteria, the winning contractor's name/address/national registration number, number of bids received, subcontracting share, and the appeal body. 115 KB for one notice, in every EU language. This is the detail hop behind api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search (already in tree, POST-only): take publication-number from a search row and land the whole record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TED — notice rendered PDF
description: Same TED notice rendered as a 108 KB PDF (%PDF-1.4 confirmed in the body). Useful as an evidence artefact to attach to a finding when the XML has been parsed; keyed on the same publication-number.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TenderNed (Netherlands) — publication feed
description: Dutch national procurement notices: publicatieId, publication date, notice type code (AAO/AAG/...), tender name, buying authority name, closing date and days remaining, full free-text scope description, procedure and directive, publication status, and an early-termination flag. Filterable by publicatieDatumVanaf so it can be polled daily.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TenderNed — tender document set
description: Second hop under a TenderNed publication: the actual tender-document manifest — documentId, document name (e.g. 'NVI_NSX_Perceel 3 - Intensief maaibestek'), giving the specification, award-criteria and contract annexes attached to a specific procurement. 26 documents returned for publication 430000.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia (Greece) — government decision search
description: Every published act of every Greek public body, including expenditure approvals, procurement awards and payment orders. Each row gives the ADA (unique decision id), protocol number, full Greek subject line, decision type, issuing organisation and unit, signer, and thematic categories. Queryable by organizationUid, decision type, date and free text — this is the single deepest 'who was paid by whom' feed in Greece.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia — organisational units of a public body
description: Sub-hop under a Diavgeia organisation: its internal directorates/units, which are the entities that actually sign expenditure decisions. Returned HTTP 200 with an empty units array for uid 15168 (a small municipal registry), so the endpoint is live but sparsely populated for that body — expect content on ministries.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia — official position register
description: 25,134 official post titles (uid + Greek label: Deputy Minister, Director-General, Special Secretary, ...) used to resolve the signer of an expenditure or award decision to a role. 1.6 MB.

name: Diavgeia — controlled-vocabulary index
description: Index of the 19 reference dictionaries Diavgeia records reference (CPV, CURRENCY, ADMIN_STRUCTURE_KALLIKRATIS administrative geography, and 16 more), each with uid and label. Each uid dereferences to the full vocabulary.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia — CPV code vocabulary (Greek)
description: The complete 10,357-entry CPV procurement classification with Greek labels and parent codes, as used to tag Greek award decisions. 1.2 MB. Lets a CPV filter be applied to Diavgeia decisions and cross-walked to TED.

name: BDNS Spain — grant call search
description: Spain's Base de Datos Nacional de Subvenciones: every public grant/subsidy call from state, autonomous-community and municipal level. Row gives internal id, BDNS call number (numeroConvocatoria), Spanish and co-official-language descriptions, receipt date, granting body hierarchy, MRR/recovery-fund flag. numeroConvocatoria is the join key into the concession (beneficiary) tables.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: BDNS Spain — individual grant awards (beneficiaries)
description: The payment level: one row per grant actually awarded to a named beneficiary. Gives concession id and code (SB…), award date, beneficiary string prefixed with the Spanish tax id (e.g. 'G57393050 FEDERACIO D'ESPORTS ADAPTATS…'), aid instrument, amount in euros, aid-equivalent amount, and the URL of the official bulletin publishing the award. This is the canonical Spanish 'who was paid by whom, how much, on what date'.

name: BDNS Spain — strategic subsidy plans
description: The strategic plans that legally authorise Spanish subsidy programmes: id, description, co-official-language description, plan type, validity years (from/to) and the administrative scope (e.g. 'COMUNIDAD DE MADRID'). Upstream policy context for any grant found in the concession tables.

name: BDNS Spain — NUTS region tree
description: Nested NUTS geography used to filter Spanish grant data (ES11 GALICIA -> ES111 A Coruña, ES112 Lugo, ...) with the internal numeric ids the search API expects.

name: BDNS Spain — policy-purpose codes
description: 21 policy purposes a Spanish subsidy can be classified under (housing, agriculture/fisheries/food, trade/tourism/SMEs, international cooperation, culture...) with ids, used to slice grant spending by policy area.

name: BDNS Spain — aid instrument codes
description: The six aid instruments (outright grant, loan, guarantee, tax advantage, risk-finance contribution, other) with ids. Distinguishes cash transfers from contingent liabilities in the concession rows.

name: BDNS Spain — beneficiary economic-activity codes
description: 22 NACE-style economic activity sectors (agriculture/livestock/forestry/fishing, extractive industries, manufacturing, electricity supply...) with ids, used to filter grant beneficiaries by industry.

name: BDNS Spain — State aid regulation codes
description: The nine EU legal bases under which Spanish aid is granted (no regulation/prior notification, General Block Exemption REG 651/2014, primary agricultural production REG 2022/2472, ...) with ids — the legal-basis filter for state-aid and de minimis queries.

name: BDNS Spain — State aid objective codes
description: 185 GBER article-level aid objectives ('ART. 13 innovation aid', 'ART. 14 investment in agricultural holdings', ...) with ids. The finest-grained legal classifier available on a Spanish aid award.

name: BDNS Spain — agricultural product-sector codes
description: 24 CMO product sectors (cereals part I, rice part II, sugar part III, dried fodder part IV, ...) with ids, used to classify CAP-adjacent Spanish aid awards by commodity.

name: Bekanntmachungsservice (Germany) — daily eForms notice export
description: Germany's federal notice service. One request returns a 4.1 MB ZIP containing 943 individual eForms XML notices published on that day (verified by listing the archive: 943 files, 24.3 MB uncompressed), each a full German procurement notice — buyer identity and national ID, CPV, procedure, lot structure, values, deadlines, and for award notices the winning contractor. Requires pubDay=YYYY-MM-DD or pubMonth=YYYY-MM (pubMonth=2026-07 returned 60 MB). Content negotiation is supported: Accept: application/vnd.bekanntmachungsservice.ocds.zip+zip yields OCDS JSON, .csv.zip+zip yields CSV, .eforms.zip+zip yields raw eForms.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: eZamówienia / BZP (Poland) — public notice board search
description: Poland's Biuletyn Zamowien Publicznych. Undocumented but keyless; I recovered the gateway from /mo-board/api/v1/Config (apiUrlQuery=/mo-board/api). Each row: noticeType, BZP notice number (2024/BZP 00104588/01), publication date, full order description, multi-line CPV list with Polish labels, offer-submission deadline, procedure result, buying organisation name/city/NUTS province/country, organizationNationalId (the Polish NIP — a hard join key to company data), organizationId, OCDS tenderId (ocds-148610-...), a contractors field, and objectId.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SICAP / e-licitatie (Romania) — contract award notice list
description: POST-ONLY, AND REQUIRES A REFERER HEADER — GET returns 405 and POST without Referer returns 403 'Referrer cannot be null'. Drive it as: POST with Content-Type: application/json, Referer: https://e-licitatie.ro/pub/notices/contract-notices/list/0/0, body {"pageSize":5,"pageIndex":0,"sysNoticeTypeIds":[],"sortColumnsList":[]}. Returns total:3000 with rows carrying caNoticeId, noticeId, procedureId, notice number (CAN1065826), notice state, procedure state ('Atribuita' = awarded), the contracting authority as fiscal-code + name ('2843299 - Spitalul Orasenesc Sinaia'), contract title, acquisition contract type and procedure type. I could not find a working per-notice detail route (eight candidate paths under /api-pub all 404).

name: Registr smluv (Czechia) — contract register dump index
description: 1.26 MB XML index (namespace portal.gov.cz/rejstriky/ISRS/1.2) listing 3,853 monthly dump descriptors of the Czech Central Register of Contracts from 2017 onward — each with month, year, SHA-1 hash, byte size and generation timestamp. The dumps behind it contain every public contract concluded by a Czech public body including the counterparty, the amount and the contract document itself, which makes this the entry point to the deepest contract-text corpus in the EU.

name: Kohesio (EU) — cohesion-policy project list
description: EU structural/cohesion fund projects as linked data.
