Each row: linkedopendata.eu entity URI and Q-id, multilingual labels and original label, HTML description, plus budget/co-financing attributes. Covers named infrastructure investments (e.g. 'Section 3 of the Sibiu-Pitesti Motorway (A1)'). The tree only had the HTML search page.

name: Kohesio (EU) — cohesion-fund beneficiary list
description: Who actually receives EU cohesion money: beneficiary label (e.g. GENERALNA DYREKCJA DROG KRAJOWYCH I AUTOSTRAD), linkedopendata.eu entity id, country and country code, total budget, EU budget share, co-financing rate, and the number of projects that beneficiary holds. Ranked by size, so it is a direct top-recipient league table across all member states.

name: CORDIS (EU) — research project search
description: 58,915 EU-funded research projects. Rows give grant agreement reference/id, acronym, title, framework programme with code and rcn, start/end dates, coordinating country, objective teaser and last-update date. The tree had the cordis host but not this search API. Supports arbitrary field queries (e.g. AND /project/rcn=193159) so it doubles as a lookup.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CORDIS (EU) — full project record
description: 12.7 MB JSON for a single EU research grant (verified on EUROfusion, grant 633053): full objective text plus the participant organisations, their roles (coordinator/participant), countries, EC contribution and total cost breakdowns, work-programme linkage, deliverables and publications. This is the beneficiary hop that turns an EU research grant into a list of paid organisations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CORDIS (EU) — research result/deliverable search
description: 884,143 research outputs (deliverables, publications, reports) produced under EU grants, each linkable back to the funding project. Same query grammar and pagination (searchAfter cursor) as the project search.

name: CORDIS (EU) — funding programme hierarchy
description: 8,678 EU funding programme/sub-programme nodes (FP7, H2020, Horizon Europe, Euratom branches) with codes and rcns — the budget-line tree that every CORDIS project attaches to.

name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal — full grants and tenders reference dump
description: 91.4 MB single-file dump of every call for proposals and call for tenders published on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. Each GrantTenderObj carries type, ccm2Id, call identifier (e.g. AGRIP-MULTI-2021-IM), title, publication date (epoch ms), deadlines, budget, programme and status. Large but keyless and complete; the identifier is the detail key.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal — call/topic full record
description: 20.9 KB detail record for one EU call: ccm2Id, identifier, full title, description, budget and deadline model, eligibility and admissibility conditions, evaluation procedure and the supporting document set. Reached by lowercasing the identifier from grantsTenders.json — verified end to end.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: European Investment Bank — financed project list
description: Every EIB loan/financing operation back to 1959. Rows give project id, description of the works financed, status and signature date plus signed and disbursed amounts in additionalInformation, and primaryTags carrying the country (label + ISO code) and sector (label + code). The url field is the numeric project id used for the detail page.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro (Ukraine) — tender change feed
description: Chronological change feed of every Ukrainian public tender (id + dateModified, cursor-paginated) on the production public API host — distinct from the public.api.openprocurement.org sandbox host already in the tree. Each id dereferences to the full OCDS-style tender: procurement method, tender period, description, items with DK021 classification, value, procuring entity with its EDRPOU code, and the full document set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — awards under a tender
description: The award hop: for a given tender, the qualification decisions naming the winning supplier, award status, value, and the signed award documents with direct public.docs.openprocurement.org download URLs. This is where 'notice' becomes 'contractor'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — bids submitted to a tender
description: 12.4 KB of the actual bids on a tender: bidder identity, bid status, offered value, and every submitted PDF with a working document URL. Losing bidders are exposed too, which is what makes collusion and single-bid patterns detectable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — contracts signed under a tender
description: Contracts concluded from a tender: status, itemised deliverables with descriptions and quantities, contract value and period, and the link back to the award.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — clarification questions on a tender
description: The clarification thread on a tender: each question's author, text, date asked and the buyer's answer. Tailored-specification complaints surface here before any formal challenge exists.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — contract change feed
description: Feed of all Ukrainian public contracts by id + dateModified. Dereferencing an id returns a 24.7 KB record with awardID, tender_id (back-pointer to the originating tender), itemised scope, value, contract period, supplier identity and the signed documents.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — procurement plans feed
description: Pre-tender procurement plans (id + dateModified). Plans reveal intended purchases and budgets before any notice is published, which is where budget-to-award divergence is measurable.

name: ProZorro — framework agreements feed
description: Framework agreements (id + dateModified) — the multi-supplier vehicles that later call-offs are drawn against.

name: ProZorro — qualification frameworks feed
description: Dynamic purchasing / qualification frameworks (id + dateModified), the register of pre-qualified suppliers admitted to restricted procurement channels.

name: ANAC (Italy) — open data dataset catalogue
description: The 70 dataset names ANAC publishes, which are the Italian procurement backbone: aggiudicatari (contract winners), aggiudicazioni (awards), avvio-contratto (contract commencement), bandi-cig-* (notice/CIG dimension tables), attestazioni-soa (contractor qualification certificates), categorie, and more. The tree only had package_search and the HTML dataset page; this enumerates the whole catalogue so nothing is missed.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANAC (Italy) — dataset detail with resource file list
description: 20.3 KB detail record for an ANAC dataset (verified on 'aggiudicazioni' = contract awards): licence, maintainer, creator, and 19 downloadable resources with their direct file URLs, formats and per-year descriptions. This is the hop that turns a dataset name into the actual award-level CSV/JSON files containing CIG, contracting station, winning economic operator and awarded amount.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANAC (Italy) — resource-level search
description: Searches ANAC's 19 award-data resources directly by name, returning each file's description, URL and format without going through the dataset layer. Useful for pulling a specific year's award file in one hop.

name: 裁判所 裁判例検索 — 全裁判例 全文検索 (Courts of Japan, all case-law full-text search)
description: Server-rendered full-text search over every published Japanese court decision. Each result row carries case number (事件番号), case name, court and division, judgment date, case type and result, and an anchor ./../{id}/detail{n}/index.html. 30 rows per page; filter[searchText] takes any keyword, so a company or person name pivots straight into the judgments naming them. Verified with 破産 (bankruptcy).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 裁判所 裁判例 詳細 (Courts of Japan — full judgment record)
description: The detail hop behind every 裁判例検索 row: 53 KB page holding the full judgment metadata plus, in <meta name="pdf_url">, the direct link to the judgment PDF. Fields include 事件番号, 事件名, 裁判年月日, 法廷名/裁判所名, 裁判種別, 結果, 判例集等巻・号・頁, 原審裁判所名, 原審事件番号, 原審裁判年月日, 判示事項, 裁判要旨, 参照法条. detail2..detail7 are the same page under the different case-type collections.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 裁判所 判決全文 PDF (Courts of Japan — judgment full text PDF)
description: The actual judgment document, 93 KB application/pdf, addressable purely by the hanrei id taken from any search-result row. This is the deepest hop in the courts chain: search hit -> detail record -> full opinion text naming the parties.

name: 裁判所 最高裁判所判例集 (Supreme Court reported cases, recent)
description: The 最高裁判所判例集 collection. filter[recent]=1 returns the latest additions (12 rows observed); swapping in filter[searchText]=<kw> gives 30 rows per page. Same row fields and same ./../{id}/detail2/index.html hop as the all-cases search.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 裁判所 高等裁判所判例集 (High Court reported cases)
description: High Court reported-case collection, full-text searchable via filter[searchText]. 30 result rows per page, each with 事件番号 / 裁判年月日 / 裁判所 / 事件名 and the detail-page anchor. Verified with 会社 (company).

name: 裁判所 下級裁判所裁判例速報 (Lower court decisions, latest)
description: Rolling feed of newly published district/family/high court decisions — the fastest-moving of the courts collections and the one where corporate litigation and insolvency rulings surface first. 30 rows, each linking to the full record and PDF.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 裁判所 行政事件裁判例集 (Administrative-litigation case collection)
description: Judgments in suits against the state and regulators — tax assessments, licence revocations, disclosure refusals, procurement disputes. Full-text searchable, 30 rows per page with the standard detail hop.

name: 裁判所 労働事件裁判例集 (Labour-litigation case collection)
description: Employment-law judgments: dismissals, unpaid overtime, harassment, union disputes — searchable by employer name via filter[searchText]. 30 rows per page plus detail hop to the full opinion.

name: 裁判所 知的財産裁判例集 (Intellectual-property case collection)
description: IP High Court and district IP-division judgments — patent, trademark, design, trade-secret and unfair-competition cases. Rows carry 事件番号, 裁判年月日, 裁判所, 事件名 and the extra 知財 facets; 30 per page with the detail/PDF hop. Verified with 特許 (patent).

name: 官報 当日全記事一覧 (Kanpo — all articles for one issue date)
description: Every article published on one gazette date across all issues of that day, as 54 anchors of the form {issue}/{article}f.html, each labelled with its section heading (公告, 会社その他, 裁判所公告, 官庁報告, 叙位・叙勾, 省令, 告示 ...). This is the hop that turns a date into the individual bankruptcy/dissolution notices.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 官報 号 目次 (Kanpo — table of contents for a single issue)
description: Per-issue table of contents: 42 article anchors for issue h01768 of 2026-08-14, ordered by page, each an individually addressable notice. Lets a collector walk one issue exhaustively instead of sampling.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 官報 記事 (Kanpo — single gazette article)
description: A single gazette notice. The wrapper page carries prev/next article links; the notice body itself is the sibling page without the trailing 'f' (…0002.html) referenced as the frame source. This is where the named party of a bankruptcy, dissolution or licence revocation actually appears.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 官報 政府調達公告 (Kanpo — government procurement notice issue, class c)
description: The 政府調達公告 class of the gazette: WTO-threshold tender notices and award notices published by ministries and agencies, one article per notice, addressable by the same {date}/{date}c{issue}/{article}f.html pattern.

name: 官報 過去の官報 月別索引 (Kanpo — monthly archive index beyond the 90-day window)
description: Monthly archive index (YYYYMM.html) giving 99 anchors into gazette issues older than the 90-day live window, so a collector can back-fill history rather than only tracking the rolling front page.

name: TDnet 適時開示情報閲覧サービス — 開示情報一覧 (Tokyo Stock Exchange timely disclosure, page 1)
description: Every timely disclosure filed by TSE-listed issuers on one date. 100 rows per page, each row: disclosure time, 4-digit securities code, company name, disclosure title, the PDF filename and (for financial results) the XBRL zip filename, plus the market. Page number increments as I_list_002_, I_list_003_ ... for the same date.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TDnet 開示情報一覧 2ページ目 (TSE timely disclosure, page 2)
description: Second page of the same date's disclosures — proves the pagination scheme so a collector can drain a whole trading day instead of taking the first 100. Same row shape as page 1.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TDnet 開示資料 PDF (TSE disclosure document)
description: The disclosure document itself — 470 KB application/pdf — addressable by the filename in any list row. Contains the full text of the earnings release, share-buyback resolution, revision of forecast, M&A announcement or governance notice.

name: TDnet 決算短信 XBRL (TSE earnings summary XBRL archive)
description: 117 KB application/zip containing the machine-readable XBRL of an earnings summary (observed member XBRLData/Summary/tse-acedjpsm-87980-20260814387980.xsd — the filename embeds the 5-digit issuer code and date). This is the structured-financials hop behind the disclosure list: revenue, profit, EPS, dividends and forecasts as tagged facts rather than PDF text.

name: TDnet JSON mirror — 最新の適時開示一覧 (live third-party mirror)
description: Keyless JSON mirror of TDnet, current to the minute (newest record observed 2026-08-14 23:55). Records under items[].Tdnet: id, pubdate, company_code (5-digit), company_name, title, document_url, url_report_type_summary / _fs_consolidated / _fs_non_consolidated / _earnings_forecast / _expected_dividends, url_xbrl, markets_string, update_history. Useful because the official TDnet list is per-date HTML only.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TDnet JSON mirror — 銘柄別 適時開示履歴 (per-issuer disclosure history)
description: The per-company detail hop of the mirror: pass a 4-digit securities code and get that issuer's disclosure history with the same item fields (id, pubdate, company_code, company_name, title, document_url, per-report-type URLs, url_xbrl, markets_string). Verified against 7203 (Toyota Motor).

name: EDINET コードリスト (FSA EDINET filer master list)
description: 570 KB zip containing EdinetcodeDlInfo.csv, 11,379 lines: the master register of every entity that files with EDINET. Maps EDINET code to filer name (JP and EN), filer type, listing status, consolidation flag, capital, fiscal-year end, industry, securities code and — critically — the 13-digit corporate number (法人番号), which is the join key to NTA / gBizINFO. No key required, unlike the EDINET API itself.

name: EDINET ファンドコードリスト (FSA EDINET fund code master)
description: 241 KB zip containing FundcodeDlInfo.csv — the companion master list for investment funds/trusts that file with EDINET, mapping fund code to fund name and to the filer's EDINET code. Keyless.

name: EDINET 書類閲覧 (FSA EDINET public viewer)
description: The keyless public viewer for EDINET filings (有価証券報告書, 大量保有報告書, 公開買付届出書 etc). Reachable without the API subscription key; the tree already uses WEEK0010.aspx?docID={id} as the human-readable landing page for a document id obtained elsewhere.

name: JPX 東証上場銘柄一覧 (Tokyo Stock Exchange listed-company master)
description: 830 KB application/vnd.ms-excel workbook, the official master list of every company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange: date, 4-digit code, company name, market/segment (プライム/スタンダード/グロース/TOKYO PRO), 33-sector and 17-sector industry codes and names, and scale category. The join key between securities code and issuer for everything TDnet/EDINET returns.

name: 国税庁 適格請求書発行事業者公表サイト 全件データ (NTA qualified-invoice issuer bulk download index)
description: Index of the 33 downloadable full-dataset files of Japan's qualified-invoice (consumption-tax) issuer register, split by CSV / XML / JSON and by 法人 vs 個人. Each is exposed as a plain GET on /download/zenken/dlfile with a file-management number — no application id needed (unlike the invoice Web-API).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 国税庁 適格請求書発行事業者 全件CSV(法人) (NTA invoice-issuer full corporate dataset)
description: 17.2 MB application/octet-stream, Content-Disposition filename h_all_20260731_csv_001.zip containing h_all_20260731_001.csv — every corporate qualified-invoice issuer in Japan. Because the invoice registration number is literally 'T' + the 13-digit corporate number, this file is a keyless, complete corporate-number-to-name-and-address index plus registration and de-registration dates (i.e. which companies dropped out of the register).

name: 国税庁 法人番号公表サイト 基本3情報 全件ダウンロード索引 (NTA corporate-number bulk download index)
description: 282 KB index of the full corporate-number dataset (基本3情報: corporate number, name, address) in CSV/Shift_JIS, CSV/Unicode and XML/Unicode, broken down per prefecture, dated 令和8年7月31日. NOTE: the files themselves are fetched by POST to /download/zenken/index.html with a CSRF token (selDlFileNo + CNSFWTokenProcessor.request.token), so only the index is a GET.

name: 官公需情報ポータルサイト API (Kankojyu — nationwide public-procurement notice search API)
description: Keyless XML search API over public-procurement notices from every Japanese national ministry, agency and local government. Observed 322,373 hits for 工事. Records at Results/SearchResults/SearchResult with: ResultId, Key, ExternalDocumentURI (direct link to the tender PDF), ProjectName, Date, FileType, FileSize, LgCode, PrefectureName, CityCode, CityName, OrganizationName, CftIssueDate and ProjectDescription containing the full extracted tender text (qualification requirements, deadlines, contact officer, contracting authority). Querying a vendor name pivots to that vendor's tenders/awards.

name: 官公需情報ポータルサイト API — Count パラメータ (paged variant)
description: Same API with the Count parameter honoured (5 requested, 5 SearchResult elements returned; SearchHits 1,526 for the vendor name トヨタ). Confirms the endpoint can be drained exhaustively rather than only returning the default 10.

name: 官公需 調達公告 原本PDF (Kankojyu tender document, detail hop)
description: Example of the ExternalDocumentURI detail hop actually resolving: 970 KB application/pdf, the Hyogo Prefectural Police tender notice referenced by the first API record. Proves the API's document link is live and fetchable, so a collector can go notice -> full original document.

name: e-Gov 法令API v2 — 法令本文取得 (e-Gov Laws API v2, full statute text)
description: Detail hop behind /api/2/laws (which the tree already has but never follows). Returns 162 KB of JSON for one law_id: law_info (law_type, law_id, law_num, era/year/type/num, promulgation_date), revision_info, and the complete structured law body article by article. Verified on 129AC0000000089 (民法, Civil Code). This is what turns a statute listing into citable text.

name: e-Gov 法令API v2 — 法令改正履歴 (e-Gov Laws API v2, amendment history)
description: Second detail hop on the same law_id: the amendment history of a statute — each revision's id, amendment law number, promulgation and enforcement dates. Lets a collector show which version of a law applied on a given date.

name: 消費者庁 リコール情報サイト (Consumer Affairs Agency recall database)
description: The CAA's consolidated product-recall database. The front page lists the most recent recalls, each linking to /result/detail.php?rcl={11-digit id}&screenkbn=06. Keyword search is a POST to /result/index.php with search=<term>&screenkbn=01&category=0, which I verified returns matching recall rows for a manufacturer name (トヨタ) — i.e. the database is pivotable by company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 消費者庁 リコール情報 商品情報詳細 (CAA recall — product detail record)
description: The detail hop: full record for one recall — recalling company, product name and model, defect description, hazard, remedy (repair/exchange/refund), announcement date, contact details and product image. Directly addressable by recall id, so recalls can be attached to a company entity.

name: 金融庁 免許・登録等を受けている業者一覧 (FSA index of all licensed/registered financial firms)
description: Index page linking 55 official FSA register workbooks (.xlsx, each with a .pdf twin) covering every category of licensed or registered financial business in Japan. I fetched all 55 and every one returned HTTP 200 with real xlsx bytes. Sampled schema (kasi.xlsx): 所管 (supervising Local Finance Bureau) / 登録番号 / 登録年月日 / 業者名 / 法人番号 (13-digit corporate number) / 郵便番号 / 本店等所在地 / 代表等電話番号 — i.e. these registers carry the corporate number, making them directly joinable to NTA and gBizINFO.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 金融庁 貸金業者登録一覧（財務局長登録） (FSA register of moneylenders)
description: 51 KB xlsx, 254 data rows verified by unzipping the workbook. Columns confirmed from sharedStrings: 所管 / 登録番号 / 登録年月日 / 貸金業者名 / 法人番号 / 郵便番号 / 本店等所在地 / 代表等電話番号. The nationally-registered consumer- and business-lending firms; the brief's 'FSA moneylenders' target.

name: 金融庁 金融商品取引業者登録一覧 (FSA register of Financial Instruments Business Operators)
description: 371 KB xlsx, 2,110 data rows verified by unzipping. Covers 第一種金融商品取引業 (broker-dealers), 第二種, 投資助言・代理業 and 投資運用業, with 所管 finance bureau, registration number and date, firm name and corporate number. The single most useful FSA register for securities-industry due diligence.

name: 金融庁 暗号資産交換業者登録一覧 (FSA register of crypto-asset exchange service providers)
description: 39 KB official FSA workbook listing every crypto-asset exchange licensed to operate in Japan, with supervising finance bureau, registration number and date, firm name, corporate number and head-office address. Same schema family as the other menkyo registers.

name: 金融庁 銀行 免許一覧 (FSA register of licensed banks)
description: 61 KB FSA workbook of every bank licensed under the Banking Act, with supervising bureau, licence number/date, name, corporate number and head-office address.

name: 金融庁 銀行持株会社 一覧 (FSA register of bank holding companies)
description: 34 KB FSA workbook of authorised bank holding companies — the parent layer above the licensed banks, useful for group-structure work.

name: 金融庁 信用金庫 一覧 (FSA register of shinkin banks)
description: 41 KB FSA workbook of every shinkin (cooperative regional) bank, with supervising bureau, name, corporate number and address.

name: 金融庁 信用組合 一覧 (FSA register of credit cooperatives)
description: 34 KB FSA workbook of credit cooperatives (信用組合) with supervising bureau, name, corporate number and address.

name: 金融庁 労働金庫 一覧 (FSA register of labour banks)
description: 16 KB FSA workbook of labour banks (労働金庫) and their supervising bureaux.

name: 金融庁 系統金融機関 一覧（農林中央金庫・信農連・信漁連）
description: 19 KB FSA workbook of the agricultural/fishery cooperative financial system institutions (Norinchukin, prefectural credit federations of agricultural and fishery cooperatives).

name: 金融庁 信託兼営金融機関 一覧 (FSA register of trust-business-authorised banks)
description: 23 KB FSA workbook of banks additionally authorised to conduct trust business.

name: 金融庁 信託会社（運用型・管理型）一覧 (FSA register of trust companies)
description: 18 KB FSA workbook of licensed/registered trust companies, split into management-type and administration-type. Trust companies are frequent nominee holders, so this register matters for beneficial-ownership work.

name: 金融庁 自己信託会社 一覧 (FSA register of self-declared trust companies)
description: 13 KB FSA workbook of firms registered to conduct self-declared trusts (自己信託) — a structure used to ring-fence assets.

name: 金融庁 信託契約代理店 一覧 (FSA register of trust-contract agents)
description: 77 KB FSA workbook of registered trust-contract agency businesses.

name: 金融庁 登録金融機関 一覧 (FSA register of Registered Financial Institutions)
description: 107 KB FSA workbook of banks and other institutions registered to conduct securities-related business under FIEA art.33-2 — the brief's 'registered financial institutions' target.

name: 金融庁 金融商品仲介業者 一覧 (FSA register of financial-instruments intermediaries)
description: 116 KB FSA workbook of registered securities intermediaries (IFA-type firms) with registration number, date, name, corporate number and address.

name: 金融庁 金融サービス仲介業者等 一覧 (FSA register of Financial Service Intermediaries)
description: 94 KB FSA workbook of firms registered under the Financial Services Provision Act as cross-sector financial service intermediaries.

description: 13 KB FSA workbook of designated parent companies of securities groups subject to consolidated supervision — a direct group-structure signal.

description: 12 KB FSA workbook of foreign securities firms permitted to trade on Japanese exchanges without a full branch licence.

description: 13 KB FSA workbook of licensed securities finance companies (margin-loan providers).

description: 33 KB FSA workbook of registered investment corporations — the legal vehicles behind J-REITs and infrastructure funds, with registration number, date, name and corporate number.

description: 12 KB FSA workbook of registered credit rating agencies operating in Japan.

description: 21 KB FSA workbook of firms registered to conduct high-frequency/high-speed trading in Japan, including foreign proprietary trading houses.

name: 金融庁 投資運用関係業務受託業者 一覧 (FSA register of investment-management outsourcing providers)
description: 15 KB FSA workbook of firms registered to accept outsourced investment-management middle/back-office functions.

description: 21 KB FSA workbook of licensed life insurers.

description: 21 KB FSA workbook of licensed property & casualty insurers, including foreign insurers' Japan branches.

name: 金融庁 保険持株会社 一覧 (FSA register of insurance holding companies)
description: 16 KB FSA workbook of authorised insurance holding companies — the parent layer of the insurance groups.

name: 金融庁 保険仲立人 一覧 (FSA register of insurance brokers)
description: 23 KB FSA workbook of registered insurance brokers (as distinct from tied agents).

description: 40 KB FSA workbook of firms permitted to act as banking agents on behalf of licensed banks.

description: 787 KB FSA workbook — the largest of the menkyo registers — listing every post office acting as a banking agent for Japan Post Bank, address by address.

description: 42 KB FSA workbook of registered shinkin-bank agency businesses.

name: 金融庁 信用組合代理業者 一覧 (FSA register of credit-cooperative agency providers)
description: 29 KB FSA workbook of registered credit-cooperative agency businesses.

description: 14 KB FSA workbook of registered labour-bank agency businesses.

description: 54 KB FSA workbook of banks in Japan acting as agents for foreign banks — a direct cross-border banking-relationship map.

description: 82 KB FSA workbook of registered open-banking/API aggregators and payment-initiation providers.

description: 61 KB FSA workbook of registered electronic-payment agency providers operating against shinkin banks.

description: 70 KB FSA workbook of notified (rather than registered) shinkin electronic-payment agency providers.

description: 36 KB FSA workbook of registered money-remittance operators (types I/II/III), the register that covers most Japanese fintech wallets and remittance firms.

name: 金融庁 前払式支払手段（第三者型）発行者 一覧
description: 120 KB FSA workbook of registered third-party-type prepaid payment instrument issuers (gift cards, e-money usable at other merchants).

name: 金融庁 前払式支払手段（自家型）発行者 一覧
description: 167 KB FSA workbook of notified in-house-type prepaid payment instrument issuers — a long tail of retailers and operators that must report outstanding balances.

name: 金融庁 特定目的会社 一覧 (FSA register of Special Purpose Companies / TMK)
description: 122 KB FSA workbook of notified 特定目的会社 (TMK) securitisation vehicles — the SPV register, high value for tracing structured real-estate and receivables deals to their sponsors.

name: 金融庁 特定金融会社等 一覧 (FSA register of Specified Finance Companies)
description: 24 KB FSA workbook of notified specified finance companies (leasing/credit-type entities subject to disclosure obligations).

description: 31 KB FSA workbook of firms registered to handle electronic payment instruments (Japan's stablecoin regime) — the newest and smallest of the payments registers.

description: 26 KB FSA workbook of designated electronic receivables recording institutions (でんさい network operators).

description: 14 KB FSA workbook of firms licensed to perform outsourced AML/sanctions screening of remittance traffic — a small but revealing compliance-infrastructure register.

description: 13 KB FSA workbook of the remaining licensed mujin (rotating mutual finance) companies.

description: 11 KB FSA workbook of licensed domestic CCPs.

description: 11 KB FSA workbook of foreign central counterparties licensed to clear for Japanese participants.

description: 11 KB FSA workbook of licensed interbank funds clearing organisations (e.g. Zengin system operator).

description: 11 KB FSA workbook of designated book-entry transfer institutions (Japan's central securities depositories).

description: 22 KB FSA workbook of registered limited-liability audit firms — the auditors signing off Japanese listed-company accounts.

name: 金融庁 外国監査法人等 一覧 (FSA register of Foreign Audit Firms)
description: 57 KB FSA workbook of foreign audit firms notified to the FSA because they audit issuers listed in Japan.

name: 金融庁 企業価値担保権信託会社 一覧 (FSA register of Enterprise-Value Security Trust Companies)
description: 37 KB FSA workbook of trust companies licensed under Japan's new enterprise-value security interest regime — i.e. who can hold an all-asset floating charge over a Japanese company.

name: 金融庁 担保付社債信託会社 一覧 (FSA register of Secured Bond Trust Companies)
description: 30 KB FSA workbook of companies licensed to act as trustee for secured corporate bonds — the counterpart to a charges register for Japanese bond collateral.

name: 証券取引等監視委員会 勧告等 (SESC recommendations and actions)
description: Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission action index — recommendations for administrative monetary penalties (insider dealing, market manipulation, disclosure fraud) and criminal referrals, each naming the firm or individual.

name: 金融庁 無登録業者に関する注意喚起 (FSA warning list of unregistered operators)
description: FSA public warning list naming firms soliciting financial business in Japan without registration — the Japanese equivalent of an FCA/SEC warning list, and a direct negative-screening source.

name: 国土交通省 自動車運送事業者に対する行政処分検索 (MLIT road-transport operator sanction search)
description: MLIT's search front-end for administrative dispositions against bus, taxi and trucking operators (operating-vehicle suspensions, licence revocations). Returns 200 with the query form (EUC-JP); I could not get result rows out of it with GET or POST, so it is reported as the form endpoint only, not as a data endpoint.

name: 国土交通省 ネガティブ情報等検索サイト 不動産業者 (MLIT negative-information search, real-estate sector)
description: One of 23 sector front-ends (hudousangyousya, kensetugyousya, takuti, koukuu, senpaku, tetudou, sokuryou, mansyon, juutaku, kentikukijun, kouzoukeisan, siteikakunin, tisitu, tintai, hosyou, ikkyuu, jidousyaseibi, kenchikuchosakensa, kensetukonsaru, shimeiteishi, siteikouzou, tourokujuutaku) of MLIT's sanctions register. Returns 200 with the query form (事業者名 / period / prefecture / disposition type) but I never obtained result rows — reported as the form endpoint, with the sector list documented so a collector can enumerate them.

name: e-Gov Law API v2 - full law text by law id
description: Complete structured text of one Japanese law: law_info (law_type, law_id, law_num, era/year/number, promulgation_date), revision_info (law_revision_id, title, kana reading, abbreviation, category, amendment_promulgate_date, amendment_enforcement_date, enforcement comment, repeal status), attached_files_info, and law_full_text as a nested tag tree of TOC / Chapter / Article / Paragraph / Sentence nodes. 74 Article nodes for the Administrative Procedure Act. This is the article-level detail hop behind the /api/2/laws list already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v2 - amendment history of a law
description: Every revision of one law: law_revision_id, law_title, abbrev, category, updated timestamp, amendment_promulgate_date, amendment_enforcement_date, amendment_enforcement_comment (naming the amending act), amendment_scope, repeal_status and mission. Lets you walk a statute backwards and forwards through the acts that changed it, including future-dated enforcement (2028 entries present).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v1 - all Acts (category 2)
description: XML list of 2,104 Japanese Acts: LawId, LawName, LawNo (Japanese-era law number), PromulgationDate. Each LawId feeds the v1 lawdata full-text endpoint. Category 1 is already in the tree; 2 (Acts) and 3 (Cabinet/Ministerial orders) are not.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v1 - all orders and ordinances (category 3)
description: XML list of 2,373 Cabinet Orders, Ministerial Ordinances and Imperial-era proclamations: LawId, LawName, LawNo, PromulgationDate. Oldest entry is an 1872 Dajokan proclamation. Feeds the same v1 lawdata full-text hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v1 - full law XML
description: 155 KB of raw statutory XML for one law id: <Law> element with Lang/Era/Year/Num/PromulgateMonth/PromulgateDay/LawType attributes, LawNum, LawTitle (with Kana and Abbrev), full TOC tree, and 74 <Article> elements each with ArticleCaption, ArticleTitle, Paragraph, ParagraphSentence and Sentence (with WritingMode). The plain-XML alternative to the v2 JSON tag tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v1 - single article extraction
description: Pulls one article (or paragraph, or appended table) out of a law without downloading the whole statute: LawId, Article number, Paragraph, AppdxTable, then LawContents with the Article's caption, title and each Paragraph's Sentence text. Matrix-style path syntax (;lawId=..;article=..). Useful for citation resolution.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: e-Gov Law API v2 - laws filtered by era and year
description: Enumerates every statute enacted in a given Japanese era-year (126 total for Reiwa 7). Each row is law_info (law_type, law_id, law_num, era/year/type/number, promulgation_date) plus revision_info. The era/year filter is the practical way to sweep newly enacted law; total_count and next_offset give full pagination.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Search SRU (CQL) with DC-NDL records and facets
description: SRU 1.2 search over the National Diet Library union catalogue. numberOfRecords was 146,794 for one title query. Returns full DC-NDL RDF per record (title, transcription, creator, publisher, date, ISBN, NDC, holding institution, item identifier) plus an extraResponseData facet block counting hits per REPOSITORY_NO - i.e. which of the ~500 contributing libraries/archives hold matching material. Far richer than the opensearch endpoint already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Search OAI-PMH - contributing repository list
description: 473 <set> entries, each a setSpec code (A00000, R100000136, ...) and setName naming a contributing institution or collection - national/prefectural libraries, museums, university archives, agency repositories. This is the directory that turns a repository id seen in an SRU facet or record into a named organisation.

name: NDL Search OAI-PMH GetRecord - single bibliographic record
description: One full DC-NDL record by OAI identifier: dcterms:title, creator, publisher, issued date, extent, subject headings, NDC/NDLC classifications, identifiers and the holding repository. Verified against a real identifier - returned a MHLW research grant report. The identifier format is oai:ndlsearch.ndl.go.jp:{repositoryNo}-{itemId}, both of which appear in SRU/opensearch results, so this is a clean second hop off the search endpoint already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Search OAI-PMH Identify
description: Repository descriptor: repositoryName, baseURL, protocolVersion, earliestDatestamp, deletedRecord policy, granularity, adminEmail. Cheap liveness/capability probe before running SRU or GetRecord sweeps.

name: Web NDL Authorities - person/corporate name authority record (JSON-LD)
description: Authority record for a named person or organisation: uri, primaryTopic with foaf:Person/foaf:Organization type, prefLabel literalForm plus transcription (kana reading), altLabel variant names and pseudonyms, birth/death dates, related authorities (owl:sameAs to VIAF/LCNAME), source citations and created/modified timestamps. The entity-resolution layer for Japanese personal and corporate names in library data.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Web NDL Authorities - name authority record (RDF/XML)
description: Same authority record as the .json form but as RDF/XML with skos, skos-xl, foaf, rdag1 and dcterms namespaces - includes xl:prefLabel/xl:altLabel literal nodes, rdag1 birth/death and field-of-activity properties, and owl:sameAs links out to external authority files.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Web NDL Authorities - subject heading (NDLSH) record
description: NDL subject heading as SKOS Concept: uri, prefLabel literalForm with kana transcription, altLabel synonyms, broader/narrower/related concept links, created (back to 1980) and modified dates. Lets you expand or normalise a topic before running an NDL Search query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Lab Next Digital Library - full-text book search
description: Full-text OCR search across NDL Digital Collections public-domain books. 5,426 hits for one keyword; each row carries id (NDL pid), version, title, volume, responsibility statement, publisher, published/publishyear, NDC class, bibId, callNo, leftopen flag, autoTOCFlag and an index array of OCR'd table-of-contents entries with .jp2 page anchors. Also returns an isClassic facet.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Lab Next Digital Library - single book record
description: Per-book record keyed on the NDL persistent id: title, volume, responsibility, publisher, published year, NDC, bibId, callNo, leftopen, and the full index array of OCR'd chapter headings each mapped to a scanned page (e.g. '第1章 都市と都市計畫/2 (0006.jp2)'). Verified detail hop off the book/search endpoint.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Digital Collections - IIIF Presentation manifest
description: IIIF 2.x manifest for a digitised NDL item: label, metadata array (Persistent ID info:ndljp/pid/NNNN, Title, Creator, Publisher, Date, call number, rights), attribution, license, and the sequence of canvases with per-page image service URLs. Turns any NDL pid seen in a search result into page-level scanned imagery.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Diet Minutes API - full meeting record (all speeches)
description: The verbatim-transcript endpoint, distinct from meeting_list and speech already in the tree. Each meetingRecord gives issueID, imageKind, session, nameOfHouse, nameOfMeeting, issue number, date, closing flag, plus a speechRecord array - here 18 speeches in one sitting - with speechID, speechOrder, speaker name, speakerYomi, speakerGroup (party), speakerPosition, speakerRole and the complete speech text. numberOfRecords was 321 sittings. This is the deepest hop into Japanese parliamentary proceedings: bill -> sitting -> named speaker -> full text.

name: Japan Search - single item record
description: Detail hop behind the jps-cross search already in the tree. Returns common{access, apiType, category, contentsAccess, contentsRightsType, contentsUrl, contributor, creator, dclass, id, lastUpdatedDate, linkUrl, ownerOrg, provider, subCategory, temporal, thumbnailUrl, title, titleYomi} plus the provider's own raw metadata block (e.g. a full dcndl:BibResource RDF tree with transcription, publisher foaf:Agent, seeAlso and rights). Item ids are of the form {provider}-{localId} and appear in every search row.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Statistics Dashboard API - actual time-series values
description: The value-bearing endpoint of the Statistics Dashboard; the tree only has getIndicatorInfo and getRegionInfo (metadata). 692 observations for one indicator/region: each DATA_OBJ.VALUE carries @indicator, @unit, @stat (source survey code), @regionCode, @time, @cycle and the numeric value, with RESULT_INF.TOTAL_NUMBER and TABLE_INF.STAT_NAME naming the underlying survey. Composable across ~5,000 indicators x prefecture/municipality region codes.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Statistics Dashboard API - survey catalogue
description: 109 source surveys behind the dashboard: @code (survey id, e.g. 00100401), @name, @agency (owning ministry - Cabinet Office, MIC, METI...), @kind (designated vs general statistic) and @summary describing scope and methodology. The lookup that resolves the @stat code appearing on every getData observation to a named survey and responsible ministry.

name: Statistical LOD of Japan - keyless SPARQL endpoint
description: Open SPARQL 1.1 endpoint (Oracle RDF Graph) over the whole e-Stat linked-data cube - no appId required, unlike the e-Stat REST API. Bindings come back as {type, value} pairs; observation URIs are of the form data.e-stat.go.jp/lod/dataset/{statId}/{tableId}/obs{hash} with ontology predicates per dataset dimension (e.g. .../ontology/g00200521/dimension/2010/...). Arbitrary joins across census, housing and economic cubes are possible in one request.

name: GSI elevation API (point lookup)
description: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan point elevation service. Returns {elevation: metres, hsrc: source DEM name} - hsrc tells you which survey product answered (here '1m (レーザ)', i.e. 1 m LiDAR), so you get provenance and implied accuracy alongside the height. Keyless, sub-second.

name: GSI reverse geocoder (lat/lon -> municipality code + oaza)
description: Official reverse geocoder: returns muniCd (5-digit local government code, e.g. 13101 Chiyoda-ku) and lv01Nm (the oaza/chome level place name). The muniCd is the join key to virtually every Japanese municipal statistical dataset. Complements the GSI AddressSearch forward geocoder already in the tree.

name: GSI DEM elevation tile (plain-text grid)
description: 256x256 comma-separated elevation grid for one XYZ tile (65,536 height values, 'e' for no-data). Directly usable for flood/terrain analysis over an area rather than a point, without any raster decoding. Standard slippy-map z/x/y addressing.

name: GSI landform classification vector tiles (disaster-risk terrain)
description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of classified landform polygons (natural levee, back marsh, reclaimed land, artificial fill, terrace...) per XYZ tile. This is the layer behind Japan's 'land condition / disaster-risk terrain' maps - it tells you whether a given address sits on liquefaction-prone fill. Keyless, tile-addressed so it can be swept over any bbox.

name: JMA AMeDAS latest observation timestamp
description: Single ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-17T01:40:00+09:00) giving the most recent AMeDAS observation slot. Required to construct the map/ and point/ data URLs, which are keyed on a YYYYMMDDHHMM00 stamp and 404 otherwise.

name: JMA AMeDAS nationwide 10-minute observations
description: All 1,286 AMeDAS stations for one 10-minute slot, keyed by station number. Per station: temp, humidity, pressure, normalPressure, precipitation10m/1h/3h/24h, snow1h/6h/12h/24h, sun10m/sun1h, windDirection, wind, visibility - each as [value, qualityFlag]. The tree only has the static amedastable.json station list; this is the live observation layer that station list keys into.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JMA AMeDAS single-station time series (detail hop)
description: Per-station history for a 3-hour block: object keyed by YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, each entry with prefNumber, observationNumber, pressure, normalPressure, temp, humidity, snow/snow1h/6h/12h/24h, sun10m/sun1h, precipitation10m/1h/3h/24h, windDirection, wind, plus maxTemp/minTemp/maxWind extremes with their times. Verified detail hop: station number comes from the nationwide map JSON. Path is /point/{stationNo}/{YYYYMMDD}_{3-hour block}.json.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JMA nationwide max-temperature ranking table
description: Shift-JIS CSV, 914 station rows: station number, prefecture, place name, observation-point number, current date/time to the minute, today's max temperature with quality flag, all-time record max with its year/month/day and flag, normal value, previous-day value, prefecture rank and national rank, plus flags for record-breaking and 10-year-extreme. One request gives a complete national heat picture with per-station historical context.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JMA nationwide 1-hour precipitation table
description: Shift-JIS CSV, 1,284 station rows: station number, prefecture, place name, point number, current datetime, current 1-hour rainfall (mm) with quality flag, today's max 1-hour value with its time and flag, and flags for all-time-record and 10-year-extreme updates. The real-time flash-flood signal at station granularity.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JMA nationwide 3-hour precipitation table
description: Same 1,284-station Shift-JIS CSV schema as the 1-hour table but accumulated over 3 hours: station number, prefecture, place, point number, datetime, current 3h total with flag, today's max 3h total with time, record/extreme update flags.

name: JMA nationwide 24-hour precipitation table
description: 1,284-station Shift-JIS CSV of 24-hour rainfall accumulation with current value, today's maximum and its time, quality flags and record-update flags. The landslide/river-flood accumulation window.

name: JMA nationwide 48-hour precipitation table
description: 1,284-station Shift-JIS CSV of 48-hour rainfall accumulation with record and 10-year-extreme update flags per station. Multi-day rainfall totals for prolonged-event monitoring.

name: JMA nationwide 72-hour precipitation table
description: 1,284-station Shift-JIS CSV of 72-hour rainfall accumulation, the longest of JMA's real-time accumulation windows, with per-station record-update flags. Used for saturated-ground / landslide risk.

name: JMA nationwide maximum wind-speed table
description: Shift-JIS CSV, 914 station rows: station number, prefecture, place, point number, datetime, current and today's maximum wind speed with direction and observation time, quality flags, and all-time-record / 10-year-extreme update flags. Typhoon and gust monitoring at station granularity.

name: JMA historical weather archive - daily values for one station
description: The per-station historical detail hop behind every JMA station table. HTML table of one calendar month for one observation station (prec_no = regional office, block_no = station): daily mean/max/min pressure, precipitation totals and max 1h/10min, mean/max/min temperature, humidity, mean and max wind speed with direction, sunshine hours, snowfall, weather summary. Archive goes back to the 19th century for principal stations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JMA observation database - hourly values for one station-day
description: Hourly (24-row) observation table for a single station and date: pressure at station and sea level, precipitation, temperature, dew point, vapour pressure, humidity, wind speed and direction, sunshine, global solar radiation, snowfall/depth, weather, cloud cover and visibility. The finest-grained public JMA archive, addressed by prec_no/block_no/year/month/day.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MOE heat-stress (WBGT) forecast - all 841 points
description: Ministry of the Environment heat-illness prevention service. CSV whose header row is 24 forecast timestamps (YYYYMMDDHH, 3-hourly out to 3 days) and whose 841 data rows are each an observation point code (matching AMeDAS station numbers, e.g. 11001), an update timestamp, and the forecast WBGT index x10 for each timestamp. Point codes are the join key into the per-point historical CSV.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MOE WBGT per-point hourly history (detail hop)
description: Verified detail hop off the forecast point list: hourly estimated WBGT for one observation point for one month. Columns Date, Time, and the WBGT value under the point code as header. URL pattern est15WG/dl/wbgt_{pointCode}_{YYYYMM}.csv, so any point x any month back through the archive is addressable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MOE WBGT per-point page (current + forecast + alert status)
description: HTML page for a single WBGT observation point addressed by region/prefecture/point: current measured and estimated WBGT, hourly forecast series, alert level, and the point's name and administrative location. The human-readable counterpart to the per-point CSV, and where the region/prefecture codes for a point can be read off.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MOE Soramame - air pollution alert-issuance area register
description: 1,650-row Shift-JIS CSV mapping every air-pollution alert zone in Japan: prefecture, prefecture code, alert-area major category, alert-area name, the constituent municipality/ward, and the contact authority responsible for issuing the alert. This is the administrative register behind the photochemical-oxidant and PM2.5 warnings - it resolves an alert to the exact wards affected and the office that issued it. Not in the tree (the tree has only the kyokuLatest station readings).

name: MOE Soramame - active PM2.5 public advisories
description: Live PM2.5 advisory feed. Columns: prefecture code, prefecture name, area code, advisory issue datetime, advisory lift datetime. Zero data rows at probe time (no advisory in force) - an honest empty, header confirmed. Joins to warningArea.csv on prefecture + area code.

name: MOE Soramame - monitoring station outage / maintenance log
description: Shift-JIS CSV of every planned and unplanned interruption to national air-quality monitoring: publication date, station prefecture, station scope/name, suspension status, works start and end datetime, cause (e.g. 'communications loss due to typhoon') and free-text remarks. Data-quality provenance - tells you exactly which stations were dark and why over any period.

name: MOE Soramame - national monitoring station instrument register
description: Per-page instrument inventory for the MOE-operated (kokusetsu) monitoring stations: for each measured item, the pollutant name (SO2, NOx, ...), the analytical method used (e.g. ultraviolet fluorescence) and the intake height in metres. Methodological metadata you need to compare readings across stations.

name: MOE Soramame - prefecture / region code master
description: All 47 prefectures as {code, name, area} where area is the Soramame regional grouping id. The join table between Soramame's per-prefecture station files (already in the tree) and its regional aggregates.

name: MOE Soramame - ambiguous station-name disambiguation table
description: Entity-resolution table for monitoring stations whose names collide: each entry gives code, name, pref and a duplicate array of the other station codes sharing that name. Essential to avoid mismatching readings when joining Soramame data by station name rather than code.

name: MOE Soramame - concentration archive coverage window
description: {latest, oldest, interval} for the nationwide concentration archive - at probe time latest 2026/08/17 01:00, oldest 2021/01/25 00:00, interval 3600 s. Tells a collector exactly how far back hourly air-quality data exists before it starts requesting timestamps.

name: JIHS Infectious Disease Weekly Report - year index
description: Successor to NIID. Index of all published epidemiological weeks for a year (32 so far in 2026), each linking to a week folder. The list endpoint of Japan's national notifiable-disease surveillance chain: year -> week -> per-week CSVs.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JIHS IDWR - single epidemiological week (data manifest)
description: Verified detail hop off the year index. Lists the seven machine-readable files published for that week: {year}-{week}-zensu.csv (all-case notifiable diseases), -teiten.csv (sentinel), -teiten-ruiseki.csv (cumulative sentinel), -teiten-tougai.csv (sentinel for the week), -ari.csv (acute respiratory infection), -animal.csv (animal-borne), and week{n}-trend.csv.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JIHS IDWR - all-case notifiable disease counts by prefecture
description: Shift-JIS CSV, ~50 rows (national total + 47 prefectures + headers), one column pair per notifiable disease giving weekly count and cumulative count for the year. Covers the full Category I-V notifiable list (from viral haemorrhagic fevers through measles, syphilis and Legionellosis). The authoritative Japanese outbreak signal at prefecture granularity, published weekly.

name: JIHS IDWR - sentinel-site disease counts by prefecture
description: Shift-JIS CSV of sentinel surveillance for one week: per prefecture, the reported case count and per-sentinel-site rate for each sentinel-reported disease (influenza, COVID-19, RS virus, pharyngoconjunctival fever, group A strep, gastroenteritis, chickenpox, hand-foot-mouth, erythema infectiosum, herpangina, mumps and others). Header carries the week's date range and the compilation date.

name: JIHS IDWR - acute respiratory infection sentinel counts
description: Shift-JIS CSV: national total plus all 47 prefectures, giving weekly acute respiratory infection case count and per-sentinel-site rate (e.g. national 167,420 cases / 44.96 per site at week 31 of 2026). The newest ARI surveillance stream introduced after the COVID reclassification.

name: JIHS IDWR - animal-associated infection counts by prefecture
description: Shift-JIS CSV of zoonotic / animal-associated notifiable infections for one epidemiological week, national total plus 47 prefectures. Same week-range header convention as the other IDWR files.

name: JIHS IDWR - multi-week trend series
description: 307-row Shift-JIS CSV giving the running week-by-week series behind the current report, so one request yields the trajectory rather than a single snapshot - the file you want for detecting an outbreak inflection rather than reading one week's level.

name: NPA - every road traffic accident in Japan, 2024 (main record)
description: 62 MB Shift-JIS CSV, roughly 290,000 rows - one per reported accident nationwide. ~60 columns: document type, prefecture code, police-station code, serial number, accident classification, deaths, injuries, road code, location code, municipality code, date and time to the minute, sunrise/sunset times, weather, terrain, road surface, road shape, signal type, road width, road alignment, collision type, vehicle types and ages of both parties, seatbelt/helmet use, airbag, zone-30, and latitude/longitude of the crash. Serial number + prefecture + police-station code is the key that joins to the supplementary and expressway files.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NPA - traffic accident supplementary record (per-party detail), 2024
description: Verified companion file to the main accident table: 59,963 rows keyed on the same prefecture/police-station/serial-number triple, carrying the per-involved-party detail that the main record omits - party classification, vehicle details, injury severity, licence and other case-level attributes. This is the second hop that turns an accident row into the people and vehicles in it.

name: NPA - expressway traffic accident record, 2024
description: 6,181-row Shift-JIS CSV of expressway-specific accident attributes (route, kilometre post, lane configuration, tunnel/bridge context), keyed on the same prefecture/station/serial triple as the main honhyo table. Third leg of the NPA accident record set.

name: NPA - every road traffic accident in Japan, 2023
description: 65.9 MB Shift-JIS CSV with 307,930 accident rows, identical ~60-column schema to the 2024 file (location, datetime, weather, road geometry, both parties' vehicle types and ages, protective equipment, lat/lon). Confirms the year-indexed URL pattern opendata/{year}/honhyo_{year}.csv, so the whole back-series is addressable.

name: NPA traffic accident open-data year index
description: Per-year index page listing the CSVs published for that year (honhyo / hojuhyo / kosokuhyo) together with the code-book definitions for the coded columns. The manifest you read before fetching 60 MB of accident data.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MEXT national school code register - active schools
description: 4.4 MB Shift-JIS CSV, 34,167 rows - the official register of every currently operating school in Japan. Columns: school code (13-char, e.g. A101110000012), school type, prefecture number, establishment category (national/public/private), main-vs-branch flag, school name, school address, postal code, establishment date, abolition date, university branch number, and the successor school code after a merger. The identity table for Japanese educational institutions; the school code is the join key across all MEXT statistics.

name: MEXT national school code register - closed/merged schools
description: 3.1 MB Shift-JIS CSV, 24,356 rows of schools that have been abolished or absorbed, same 12-column schema as the active register including abolition date and the successor school code. This is the file that lets you resolve a defunct school name in an old document to its current successor institution.

name: MEXT school code register - universities and colleges
description: 1,220-row Shift-JIS CSV covering universities, junior colleges and technical colleges (codes prefixed F1 etc.), with school code, type, prefecture, establishment category, main/branch flag, name, address, postal code, establishment and abolition dates and university branch number. Includes campus-level branch entries, not just headquarters.

name: Japanese Courts case-law search (Supreme + lower courts)
description: Official 裁判例検索. 30 judgments per page; each row carries case number, court and division, decision date, case name, case type, result, the referenced statutes and the gist of the holding, plus a link to the full judgment PDF. Query is GET with filter[searchText] and page; sibling paths search2 (recent Supreme Court), search4 (recent lower court) and search7 (IP High Court) exist. NOTE: send NO Accept-Encoding - the host intermittently returns a 0-byte body when gzip is requested.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Agency for Cultural Affairs - National Cultural Properties database (list)
description: The national register of designated cultural properties (National Treasures, Important Cultural Properties, historic sites, monuments, intangible and folk-cultural properties). Result list rows give designation category, property name, kana reading, prefecture/municipality, owner or custodian, designation date and the detail link /heritage/detail/{categoryCode}/{propertyId}. 155 KB page with 24 property links.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Agency for Cultural Affairs - cultural property detail record
description: Verified 48 KB detail record for one designated cultural property: official name and reading, designation category and sub-category, designation and registration dates, quantity, era/period, dimensions, structure, location down to the address, owner/custodian name, administering body and the descriptive designation rationale. URL pattern /heritage/detail/{categoryCode}/{propertyId}, both parts taken from a search-list row.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: National Archives of Japan - digital archive search
description: National Archives (国立公文書館) digital archive. 1.9 MB result page; each hit links to /fonds/{id} and shows title, holding/fonds classification, reference code, date of creation and the creating agency. The entry point to Japan's official government records - cabinet papers, ministerial files, imperial edicts.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: National Archives of Japan - fonds/item detail record
description: Verified 248 KB detail page for one archival unit: title, reference code, hierarchical fonds path (record group -> series -> file -> item), creating agency, date of creation, physical description, access conditions, and the list of digitised page images. The record-level hop behind the archive search.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JACAR - Japan Center for Asian Historical Records search
description: Cross-institution search over the digitised pre-1945 records of the National Archives, Diplomatic Archives (MOFA) and the National Institute for Defense Studies. 497 KB result page; each hit links to /das/meta/{referenceCode} and carries the document title, reference code, holding institution, creating body and date range.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: JACAR - archival item detail by reference code
description: Verified detail hop, 220 KB - fetching reference code A17110884400 returned the record titled 幣原内閣閣議書類（その３）昭和２１年１月４日～２月１５日 (Shidehara Cabinet meeting papers, Jan-Feb 1946). Page carries title, reference code, holding institution, creating agency, date range, item hierarchy, subject headings and the digitised page-image list. Reference codes are typed by holding body (A = National Archives, B = Diplomatic Archives, C = Defense Studies).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Board of Audit of Japan - annual audit report year index
description: Index of every Board of Audit annual report from FY1989 (Heisei 1) to the present, each linking to that year's table of contents at org/{era}/{yyyy}-{era}-mokuji.htm. The top of the chain that leads to individual audit findings against ministries, agencies, public corporations and their contractors.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Board of Audit - single-year report table of contents
description: Verified middle hop: 78 KB, ~589 lines listing every section and individual finding in one fiscal year's audit report, organised by audited ministry/agency/public corporation, each linking to its own report page. This is where named improper-expenditure and wasteful-contract findings are enumerated.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Board of Audit - individual audit report section (detail hop)
description: Verified leaf record: the full text of one section of an annual audit report - audit policy, the audited body, the finding, the amounts involved and the corrective action demanded. URL pattern org/{era-year}/{yyyy}-{eraYear}-{sectionId}-{sub}.htm, all components readable from the year table of contents.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: 官公需情報ポータルサイト API — national tender search (kkj.go.jp)
description: XML API aggregating tender/bid notices published by ALL Japanese national agencies, prefectures and municipalities. Each <SearchResult> carries: Key, ExternalDocumentURI (direct link to the actual PDF/Word bid notice on the issuing body's own server), ProjectName, Date, FileType, FileSize, LgCode, PrefectureName, CityCode, CityName, OrganizationName, CftIssueDate and ProjectDescription — the FULL extracted text of the tender notice (contracting officer's personal name, deadlines, qualification requirements, delivery site).
