name: PeeringDB carriers
description: Carrier/fabric operators: id, org_id, org_name, name, aka, website, social_media, notes, fac_count, created/updated. Not covered by net/ix/fac.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB carrier detail (depth=2)
description: One carrier with its owning org object inlined (legal address, lat/lon, all *_set id lists) and its facility footprint.

name: PeeringDB carrier facility presence
description: Which datacentres a carrier fabric reaches: carrier_id, fac_id, facility name, created/updated. Carrier -> building hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB campuses
description: Multi-building datacentre campuses: id, org_id, org_name, name, aka, website, social_media, country/city/state/zipcode.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB campus detail (depth=2)
description: One campus with owning org inlined including net_set/fac_set/ix_set id lists and the org's free-text notes (which often name the merged operators behind the campus).

name: PeeringDB facilities by country, depth=1
description: Facilities in a country with org fields already expanded one level: org_name, campus_id, CLLI/rencode/npanxx, sales and tech contact email/phone, available_voltage_services, net_count/ix_count/carrier_count. Different from the depth=0 country listing already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB ASN -> IRR AS-SET map
description: Single object mapping ~19,000 ASNs to their declared IRR as-set macro (e.g. "20940": "RIPE::AS-AKAMAI"). Feeds straight into IRR/RPKI expansion of a network's customer cone.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS IP lookup
description: IP -> network registration: handle (NET-8-8-8-0-2), name, startAddress/endAddress, netBlocks with CIDR length and type, registrationDate, orgRef/customerRef, parentNetRef, plus rdapRef and ref links to the next hop. Root of ARIN's org/POC tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS organisation
description: Registered org record: handle, name, canAllocate flag, street address lines, city, iso3166-1/iso3166-2, postalCode, registrationDate, updateDate, and pocLinks (abuse/admin/tech/NOC point-of-contact handles).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS org -> all networks
description: Every IP network handle registered to an organisation: handle, name, startAddress, endAddress, and self-link. 55 blocks for Google. The org -> full address-space inventory hop.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS org -> all ASNs
description: Every autonomous system handle registered to an organisation, with handle, name and self-link. Reveals shell/acquired ASNs held under one legal entity (GOGL holds AS13949 SLIDE-INC, AS15169 GOOGLE, AS19425 ...).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS ASN record
description: ASN registration: handle, name, startAsNumber/endAsNumber, registrationDate, updateDate, orgRef, rdapRef, and pocLinks. Direct ASN -> legal owner mapping.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS point-of-contact search by email domain
description: Every registered ARIN contact whose email is at a given domain: handle plus personal name ("Barkan, Ari"). Named-individual enumeration for a company from its mail domain alone.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS point-of-contact detail
description: A named contact: handle, companyName, first/last name, street address, city, iso3166, postalCode, emails, phones (with type), registrationDate, updateDate.

name: ARIN Whois-RWS customer search by name
description: Reassigned-customer records matching a name: handle (C-numbers) and customer name. These are downstream reassignments an org made, invisible in the org's own net list.

name: ARIN RDAP entity (org) with autnums + networks
description: RDAP entity for an org handle: full autnums[] array (each with handle, start/endAutnum, name, events for registration and last-changed) and networks[], plus nested entities with vCard contact blocks. 95 KB for GOGL.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN RDAP autnum
description: ASN RDAP object: start/endAutnum, name, status, events, and nested entities carrying abuse/tech/admin POC handles with vCard (org, address, phone, email) and links back to whois.arin.net.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: APNIC RDAP autnum (with JPNIC mirror notice)
description: APAC ASN RDAP record with nested entities (admin/tech/abuse handles, vCards) and a notices[] block naming the true source registry (JPNIC for Japanese ASNs) plus a link to the authoritative jpnic.rdap.apnic.net object.

name: RIPE RDAP entity (maintainer / role object)
description: RIPE entity by handle with vCardArray (fn, kind, org, postal label, voice/fax phone, email) and nested entities. Lets you pivot from a mnt-by or org-id seen on an inetnum to the people and department behind it.

name: IANA RDAP bootstrap for ASNs
description: Bootstrap redirector that resolves any ASN to the authoritative RIR and returns the full RDAP autnum: handle, start/endAutnum, name, status, entities with vCard contacts and roles. The tree has rdap.org/domain but not the autnum path.

name: LACNIC RDAP autnum
description: Latin-American ASN RDAP object: handle, start/endAutnum, country of registration, events, and entities with roles. Tree only had the LACNIC IP path.

name: RIPE DB REST organisation object
description: Full RPSL organisation object as attribute name/value pairs: organisation id, org-name, org-type (RIR/LIR/OTHER), address lines, phone, fax, e-mail, abuse-c, mnt-ref, mnt-by, created, last-modified.

name: RIPE DB REST aut-num object
description: Full RPSL aut-num: as-name, descr, org link, every import/export/mp-import policy line (i.e. the declared peering relationships, peer by peer), admin-c/tech-c handles, mnt-by, created/last-modified. 10 KB of routing policy per ASN.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: RIPE DB REST inetnum object
description: Allocation record: inetnum range, netname, descr, country, org, admin-c/tech-c, status (ASSIGNED PA / ALLOCATED PA), mnt-by/mnt-lower/mnt-routes, created and last-modified.

name: RIPE DB REST inverse lookup by org
description: Every RPSL object (inetnum, inet6num, aut-num) that references a given organisation id. Turns one org handle into that entity's complete RIPE-region resource holdings. Different from the plain search.json query already in the tree.

name: RIPE DB abuse-contact resolver
description: Authoritative abuse mailbox for any IP: the covering range, the abuse-c role handle, e-mail, a 'suspect' flag when the address looks stale, and the responsible org-id.

name: RIPEstat whois records
description: Normalised whois key/value record blocks for any prefix or ASN across all five RIRs (NetRange, CIDR, NetName, NetHandle, Parent, OrgName, contact blocks), each with an optional details_link for the next hop.

name: RIPEstat geolocation
description: Per-prefix geolocation with country, city, lat/lon, covered_percentage and unknown_percentage, plus result_time/earliest_time/latest_time. Split into sub-resources when a prefix spans locations.

name: RIPEstat country ASN inventory
description: For a country code: counts of registered vs routed ASNs plus the full explicit list of every routed and every non-routed ASN. Country -> complete AS inventory in one call.

name: RIPEstat routing status
description: first_seen and last_seen prefix+origin+timestamp for an ASN (AS3333 first seen 2000-08-18), announced space counts v4/v6, observed neighbour counts. Establishes when a network appeared in the DFZ.

name: RIPEstat RIS collector peers
description: Every BGP feed into every RIS route collector (rrc00..rrcNN): peer ASN, peer IP, v4_prefix_count, v6_prefix_count. Identifies which networks physically peer at which collector site.

name: RIPEstat reverse DNS for an IP
description: PTR result list for a single address with the query_time it was resolved at.

name: RIPEstat entity autocomplete
description: Free-text name -> candidate ASNs / prefixes / IPs, each with label, value and a human description ("AS15169 GOOGLE - Google LLC"). The name-to-ASN entry point for every other RIPEstat call.

name: RIPE Atlas probe detail
description: One measurement probe: public IPv4/IPv6 address, asn_v4/asn_v6, announced prefix_v4/prefix_v6, country, description, firmware version, first_connected/last_connected epochs, status history, geometry point, and tags. Tree only had the probe list.

name: RIPE Atlas measurement detail
description: One measurement definition: type, af, target, interval, packets, creation/start/stop times, is_public, credits_per_result, probes_requested/scheduled, status, and the result URL for the raw data hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: RIPE Atlas raw measurement results
description: Raw per-probe results: prb_id, src_addr, from (public IP), dst_addr, proto, ttl, per-packet rtt array, min/max/avg, sent/rcvd/dup, firmware, timestamp. 3 MB for one hour of one ping measurement. The deepest hop in Atlas.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: RIPE Atlas anchor detail
description: One anchor host: hostname, fqdn, linked probe id, ip_v4/ip_v6 with as_v4/as_v6, gateway/netmask, city, country, hosting company, nic_handle (RIPE contact), geometry, date_live / date_decommissioned.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NLNOG IRRexplorer prefixes by ASN
description: Per-prefix cross-check of BGP vs IRR vs RPKI for an ASN: prefix, RIR, rpkiRoutes with full RPSL text / maxLength / rpkiStatus (VALID|INVALID|NOT-FOUND), bgpOrigins seen, and irrRoutes grouped by IRR source (RIPE, RADB, ...). Surfaces route hijack and stale-object conditions.

name: RIPE full ASN -> name/country table
description: Plain-text line per allocated ASN worldwide: "<asn> <AS-NAME> - <legal org name>, <CC>". 122,096 lines, 2.3 MB. Offline resolver for every ASN on Earth, no per-query rate limit.

name: IIJ Internet Health Report network lookup
description: Resolves an AS number to IHR's canonical network name plus flags for which IHR datasets exist for it (hegemony, delay_forwarding, disco). The index hop before the heavier IHR calls.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IIJ IHR country-level AS hegemony
description: For a country, every transit AS ranked by hegemony score (dependency weight) with timebin, asn, asn_name, weight, weightscheme, transitonly flag. 1,488 rows for JP. Shows which foreign carriers a national internet depends on.

name: IIJ IHR per-prefix dependency + RPKI/IRR status
description: Per announced prefix of an ASN: transit ASN and hegemony score, visibility %, rpki_status, irr_status, delegated_prefix_status, delegated_asn_status, moas (multi-origin) flag, descr, and both ASN names. 786 rows for AS2497.

name: CAIDA AS Rank organisations
description: Global ranking of AS-owning organisations: rank, orgId, orgName, country, asnDegree (total/transit), customer cone size (numberAsns/numberPrefixes/numberAddresses) and the member ASNs of the org. The tree only had the per-ASN path.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CAIDA AS Rank organisation detail
description: One organisation with rank, orgName, country, full customer-cone metrics and the list of member ASN edges. Turns a CAIDA orgId seen in a ranking row into the corporate group behind many ASNs.

name: OONI raw measurement body
description: The full submitted probe report behind a measurement row: annotations (device architecture, OS version, platform, engine version, network_type, ooni_run_link_id), measurement_start_time, probe_asn/cc, probe_network_name, resolver_asn/resolver_ip/resolver_network_name, software name/version and the raw test_keys. The detail hop under the measurements list already in the tree.

name: OONI measurements list (country filtered)
description: Measurement rows with anomaly/confirmed/failure flags, input URL, probe_asn, probe_cc, report_id, blocking scores (general/global/country/isp/local) and, critically, measurement_url — the raw_measurement link used as the detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OONI test-name registry
description: Canonical id/name pairs for every OONI test (bridge_reachability, dnscheck, psiphon, riseupvpn, whatsapp, ...). Needed to enumerate the measurements API exhaustively per test.

name: OpenStreetMap way with all member nodes
description: A way plus every node it references, each with lat/lon, timestamp, version, changeset id, editing user name and uid. Turns one feature id into its full geometry and its complete edit provenance.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap relation with all members
description: A relation (e.g. an administrative boundary) recursively expanded into every member way and node with coordinates, versions, changesets and editor identities. 44 KB for the Manchester boundary.

name: OpenStreetMap element version history
description: Every historical version of one element: version number, timestamp, changeset id, user and uid, and the complete tag set as it stood at that version. Shows who changed what about a feature and when.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap relations containing an element
description: Every relation a node/way belongs to, with the relation's full member list, roles, tags, version, changeset and last editor. Upward hop from a point to the boundaries, routes and networks it is part of.

name: OpenStreetMap changeset with discussion
description: One changeset: created_at/closed_at, open flag, changes_count split into created/modified/deleted, bbox, uid and user, tags (comment, created_by editor + version, host, imagery_used, locale) and the full comment thread with commenter uid, name and date.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap changeset osmChange diff
description: The literal edit diff as osmChange XML: create/modify/delete blocks with every element, its members and every tag key/value written in that edit, with user and uid. The most granular attribution artefact OSM exposes.

name: OpenStreetMap changesets by user id
description: An individual mapper's edit stream: changeset id, created_at/closed_at, counts, bbox (min/max lat/lon — i.e. where they were editing), and tags naming the editor software, host and imagery used. Tree had bbox and display_name queries but not the uid query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap user profile
description: Public account record: id, display_name, account_created, description text, social_links, roles, contributor_terms agreement, total changeset count, GPS trace count and blocks received/active.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap raw map extract by bbox
description: Every node, way and relation inside a bounding box with full tags plus per-element version, timestamp, changeset, user and uid. 600 KB for a 1 km square — a full local feature inventory with edit provenance, without touching Overpass.

name: Nominatim structured address search
description: Field-by-field address query (street/city/county/state/postalcode/country) returning place_id, osm_type+osm_id, lat/lon, category/type, addresstype, parsed address components with ISO3166-2, extratags (height, building:levels, architect, operator, old descriptions) and namedetails in every language.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nominatim place details
description: Deepest Nominatim record: place_id and parent_place_id, all names including old_name, addresstags, calculated_postcode, indexed_date, importance, rank_address/rank_search, isarea, centroid, geometry, admin hierarchy and linked places. The genuine detail hop behind a search hit.

name: Nominatim batch OSM-id lookup
description: Resolve up to 50 OSM ids at once to place records with address components, extratags (ref:gss, ons_code, wikidata, wikipedia, council_name, admin_level) and multilingual namedetails. Batch hop from OSM ids found elsewhere.

name: Nominatim reverse geocode with extratags
description: Coordinate -> nearest OSM feature with osm_type/osm_id, category/type, full localised address chain (JP: 丸の内一丁目 / 千代田区 / 東京都 + postcode), ISO3166-2, extratags and namedetails, plus boundingbox.

name: Nominatim service status / data freshness
description: status code, message, data_updated timestamp (how current the OSM import is), software_version and database_version. Lets a collector report exactly how stale a geocode is.

name: OSM taginfo key statistics
description: Global usage of one tag key broken down by element type (all/nodes/ways/relations): count, count_fraction and number of distinct values, with data_until timestamp.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OSM taginfo values for a key
description: Ranked distinct values of a key with count, fraction, in_wiki flag and wiki description. For key=operator this is a global census of infrastructure operators (Enedis 1.62 M objects, RTE 345 k, SNCF Réseau 313 k, DB InfraGO 120 k) — a company-to-asset-count index. total=1,318,754 values, fully paginable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OSM taginfo key overview
description: Counts per element type, number of software projects using the key, number of distinct users who have applied it, and the prevalent_values list with fractions — in one call.

name: OSM taginfo tag statistics
description: How many nodes/ways/relations carry an exact key=value pair worldwide (power=plant: 160,686 objects). Sizes the OSM coverage of any asset class before you query for it.

name: OSM taginfo tag co-occurrence
description: Which other keys/values appear together with a given tag, with together_count, to_fraction and from_fraction. Reveals the attribute schema actually used on an asset class (operator:short, generator:source, plant:output:electricity ...).

name: OSM taginfo search by tag value
description: Free-text search across all tag values, returning key, value and count_all for each hit (46 matches for TEPCO across brand, name, name:en, name:ko, addr:suburb). Company name -> every OSM tag spelling that references it, which then drives targeted extraction.

name: TfL line -> all stop points
description: Every stop served by a line: naptanId, stationNaptan, hubNaptanCode, icsCode, stopType, modes, the lines and lineGroups served, lineModeGroups, lat/lon and additionalProperties. Line -> station roster hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL stop point detail
description: One station/interchange: naptanId, hubNaptanCode, stopType, all modes, every line calling there, lineGroup and lineModeGroups, children stops (platforms, entrances, bus stands) and additionalProperties (zone, WiFi, toilets, accessibility).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL live arrivals at a stop
description: Live vehicle predictions: prediction id, vehicleId, lineId/lineName, platformName, direction, bearing, currentLocation free text, towards, timeToStation seconds, expectedArrival, and timing provenance. The deepest live hop off a stop id.

name: TfL line route sequence with geometry
description: Ordered station sequence for a line and direction plus the lineStrings polyline geometry, orderedLineRoutes and per-station stationId/icsId/topMostParentId/zone/lat/lon. Physical route trace, not just a stop list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL per-line disruption
description: Active disruption records for a single line: category, type, categoryDescription, human description, closureText, and affectedRoutes / affectedStops arrays. Finer than the mode-level Status call already in the tree.

name: TfL / London Air quality forecast
description: Current and future London air pollution forecast: forecastID, forecastBand, forecastSummary, nO2Band, o3Band, pM10Band, pM25Band, sO2Band, forecastType and validity window, plus the disclaimer and source URL.

name: TfL stop point name search
description: Name -> stop ids with icsId, modes, fare zone, topMostParentId, lat/lon and total match count. The entry point that makes every other TfL id-based hop reachable from a plain place name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL car parks (Place API)
description: Every TfL car park as a Place: id, url, commonName, placeType, lat/lon and a long additionalProperties list (SmartParkingLocationCode, address lines, bay counts, charges, opening hours) each with sourceSystemKey and modified timestamp.

name: TfL transport mode registry
description: Every mode name with isTflService, isFarePaying and isScheduledService flags. Needed to enumerate the Line API exhaustively instead of hardcoding tube/bus.

name: TfL all lines with route sections
description: Every line in the network (82 KB) with id, name, modeName, created/modified, lineStatuses and routeSections giving each direction's name, originationName/destinationName, originator and destination Naptan codes and validFrom/validTo. Full network graph in one request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: VBB (Berlin-Brandenburg) location search
description: Stop name -> stop id with lat/lon, products served (suburban/subway/tram/bus/ferry/express/regional booleans), IFOPT id and stationDHID (the German national stop identifier). Entry hop for the departures API.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: BVG (Berlin) live departures
description: Live departures for a stop id: tripId, exact sub-stop with lat/lon and IFOPT, scheduled vs actual 'when', delay seconds, platform vs plannedPlatform, direction, line object and remarks. The tree only had bvg locations/nearby.

name: OVapi Netherlands national line registry
description: Every public transport line in the Netherlands keyed by DataOwnerCode_LinePlanningNumber_Direction: TransportType, LinePublicNumber, LineName, LineDirection, DestinationCode, DestinationName50 and wheelchair accessibility. 124 KB, keyless, no registration.

name: OVapi Netherlands timing point index
description: The complete index of Dutch timing point codes (stop identifiers), each of which can then be requested individually for live passes. 124 KB enumeration of the national stop namespace.

name: Transitous (MOTIS) stop times
description: Departures/arrivals at a stop across the community-run pan-European GTFS aggregation: place with stopId/parentId/lat/lon/level/timezone, scheduled vs realtime arrival and departure, scheduledTrack vs track, pickup/dropoff type, cancelled flag, mode, headsign and tripId. The tree only had the transitous geocode call.

name: Transitous stops in a bounding box
description: All transit stops inside a bbox with stopId, name, lat/lon, level, timezone, free-text description of the physical stop, vertexType and served modes. Geographic entry point into the aggregated feed set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Entur Norwegian national stop place register
description: NeTEx stop places: NSR id, centroid lat/lon, created/changed timestamps, version, full accessibilityAssessment (wheelchairAccess, stepFreeAccess, liftFreeAccess, audibleSignals, visualSigns) and keyList cross-references (jbvCode, uicCode, legacy grailsId).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Entur stop place detail
description: One stop place fully expanded with its accessibility limitations, centroid, keyList identifier cross-walk (UIC code, rail infrastructure code) and modification history.

name: Entur quays (platforms)
description: Individual platforms/quays under stop places: NSR:Quay id, centroid, accessibilityAssessment, placeEquipments (shelters, ticketing, sanitary), keyList with uicCode and imported-id from the legacy NSB register.

name: Swiss transport.opendata.ch journey connections
description: Full journeys with per-leg from/to station objects (id, name, WGS84 coordinate), departure and arrival timestamps, live delay minutes, platform, prognosis (platform/arrival/departure plus 1st and 2nd class capacity), products and duration. Tree had locations and stationboard only.

name: MobilityData GBFS systems catalogue
description: The canonical registry of every public bike/scooter share system worldwide: Country Code, Name, Location, System ID, operator URL, Auto-Discovery URL (the gbfs.json to crawl), supported GBFS versions and authentication requirements. 38 KB — this is the seed list that makes exhaustive GBFS collection possible, and it is keyless unlike api.mobilitydatabase.org.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GBFS v3 auto-discovery (PBSC/Careem BIKE)
description: The feed index every GBFS system exposes: named URLs for gbfs_versions, geofencing_zones, station_information, station_status, system_information, system_pricing_plans, vehicle_types. One hop yields the whole per-system dataset list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GBFS free_bike_status (dockless fleet positions)
description: Every free-floating vehicle right now: bike_id UUID, lat/lon, current_range_meters, current_fuel_percent, is_disabled, is_reserved, last_reported epoch, pricing_plan_id, vehicle_type_id and deep-link rental_uris. 85 KB per city — a live micromobility fleet census.

name: GBFS geofencing_zones
description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of no-ride / no-park / slow zones with per-vehicle-type rules (ride_allowed, ride_through_allowed, station_parking) and MultiPolygon geometry. 49 KB — an operator's own map of restricted urban space.

name: GBFS vehicle_types
description: Fleet composition: vehicle_type_id, form_factor, propulsion_type, max_range_meters and the pricing_plan_ids that apply. Resolves the vehicle_type_id foreign key in free_bike_status and station_status.

name: Digitraffic Finnish rail live trains at a station
description: Every train touching a station with its full timeTableRows: per-stop scheduledTime, liveEstimateTime, actualTime, differenceInMinutes, commercialTrack, cancelled flag, estimateSource, and causes[] giving the coded delay reason (categoryCode/detailedCategoryCode/thirdCategoryCode). Delay attribution per train per stop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Digitraffic Finnish rail train detail
description: One train number's latest run: departureDate, operatorShortCode and operatorUICCode, timetableType, timetableAcceptanceDate, runningCurrently/cancelled, version, and the ordered timeTableRows with station short codes, UIC codes, tracks and times.

name: Digitraffic Finnish rail operator registry
description: Every licensed rail operator in Finland: id, operatorName, operatorShortCode, operatorUICCode and the train-number ranges allocated to it by trainCategory (Cargo, Locomotive, Shunting, On-track machines). Maps any observed train number to the company running it.

name: Digitraffic Finnish TMS station live sensor data
description: Per-sensor readings from one traffic measurement station: sensor id, name (e.g. OHITUKSET_60MIN_KIINTEA_SUUNTA1 = vehicles/hour by direction), shortName, unit, value, measuredTime and the aggregation window. The detail hop under the station list already in the tree.

name: Digitraffic road maintenance vehicle tracking
description: GeoJSON LineString traces of actual maintenance vehicle movements: tracking id and previousId (chainable), sendingTime, startTime/endTime, created, tasks[] performed (MECHANICAL_CUT, SALTING, PLOUGHING...), direction, domain and source agency. 257 KB — real contractor activity on the road network.

name: Elexon BMRS REMIT message list
description: Index of REMIT inside-information filings (generation unavailability notices): id, mrid, revisionNumber, createdTime, publishTime and a direct url to the full message. Max 7-day window. This is the list half of the highest-value energy disclosure feed in GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Elexon BMRS REMIT message detail
description: One outage notice in full: messageType, messageHeading, eventType (Production unavailability), unavailabilityType (Planned/Unplanned), participantId, registrationCode, assetId, affectedUnit and its EIC code, biddingZone, fuelType, normalCapacity, availableCapacity, unavailableCapacity, event start/end, cause and revision number. Names the operator, the plant and the megawatts lost.

name: Elexon BM unit master reference
description: Every balancing mechanism unit in GB (389 KB): nationalGridBmUnit, elexonBmUnit, EIC, fuelType, leadPartyName and leadPartyId (the company legally responsible), bmUnitType, bmUnitName (plant name), demandCapacity, generationCapacity, transmissionLossFactor, credit assessment import/export capabilities, gspGroupId/gspGroupName and interconnectorId. Resolves any BM unit code seen in REMIT/BOALF/PN to its owning company and physical station.

name: Elexon interconnector reference
description: Every GB electricity interconnector with interconnectorId, interconnectorName and the counterparty biddingZone (Eleclink/France, Greenlink/Ireland, Moyle/Northern Ireland, BritNed/Netherlands, NSL/Norway, Viking/Denmark).

name: Elexon fuel type reference
description: Canonical fuel-type codes used across all BMRS datasets (BIOMASS, CCGT, COAL, NPSHYD, NUCLEAR, OCGT, OIL, PS, WIND and every interconnector pseudo-fuel). Needed to enumerate generation datasets exhaustively.

name: Elexon bid-offer acceptances (BOALF)
description: Every instruction the system operator issued to a generator in a settlement period: nationalGridBmUnit, bmUnit, acceptanceNumber, acceptanceTime, timeFrom/timeTo, levelFrom/levelTo (MW), deemedBoFlag, soFlag, storFlag, rrFlag. Per-plant dispatch record.

name: Elexon physical notifications (PN)
description: Each BM unit's declared output profile for a settlement period: dataset, settlementDate, settlementPeriod, timeFrom/timeTo, levelFrom/levelTo MW, nationalGridBmUnit and bmUnit. 55 KB per period. Joins to the bmunits reference for company attribution.

name: Elexon maximum export limits (MELS)
description: Declared maximum export capability per BM unit over time: levelFrom/levelTo, timeFrom/timeTo, notificationTime, notificationSequence, nationalGridBmUnit, bmUnit. 296 KB for one hour — reveals capability derating before it shows up as an outage.

name: Elexon disaggregated balancing services adjustment
description: Non-BM balancing actions with cost and volume, soFlag/storFlag, partyId, assetId, isTendered and service name — i.e. which counterparty was paid for what ancillary service in each settlement period.

name: Elexon market index prices (MID)
description: Per-settlement-period reference prices with dataProvider (APXMIDP, N2EXMIDP), startTime, settlementDate/Period, price and traded volume.

name: Elexon instantaneous generation by fuel type
description: Per fuel type: currentUsage MW and percentage, halfHourUsage and percentage, twentyFourHourUsage and percentage. Different endpoint from the outturn/summary already in the tree.

name: Elering Nord Pool spot price (Baltic)
description: 15-minute Nord Pool day-ahead prices per Baltic bidding area (ee, lv, lt, fi) as timestamp/price pairs. Keyless, no registration, unlike ENTSO-E.

name: Nord Pool day-ahead prices
description: Official exchange day-ahead auction results at 15-minute granularity: deliveryStart/deliveryEnd UTC and entryPerArea price map, plus deliveryDateCET, version and updatedAt. Keyless via the data portal API.

name: PSE Polish grid generation and capacity by unit class
description: 15-minute Polish grid record: gen_fv (PV), gen_wi (wind), gen_jga/jgo/jgm/jgw/jgz by unit class and contract band, matching capacity_* fields, ogr_mwe, kse_pow_dem (system demand), rez_under/rez_over_demand reserves, business_date and publication_ts. A different PSE dataset from the two already in the tree.

name: openSenseMap citizen sensor box registry
description: The global registry of citizen-operated sensor stations (15.9 MB — the limit parameter is ignored): box _id, name, exposure, model, coordinates, and a sensors[] array per box with sensor _id, sensorType (BMP085, DHT11, SDS011...), title, unit and lastMeasurement reference.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: openSenseMap box detail
description: One station with each sensor's lastMeasurement resolved inline to value and createdAt, plus sensorType, title and unit. Detail hop off the box registry.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: openSenseMap box sensor list
description: Sensor inventory for a station: sensor _id, boxes_id, sensorType, title, unit and lastMeasurement (value + createdAt). The sensor _id is the key for the time-series hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: openSenseMap sensor time series
description: Raw measurements for one sensor over a date window: value, createdAt and the per-reading location [lon, lat] (mobile boxes move). The third hop: registry -> box -> sensor -> readings.

name: Safecast radiation measurements
description: Volunteer radiation readings: id, user_id, value, unit (cpm), device_id, devicetype_id, sensor_id, station_id, channel_id, captured_at, height, latitude, longitude, and measurement_import_id linking back to the upload batch.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Safecast measurement detail
description: Single reading with its uploading user_id, device_id, original_id and measurement_import_id — the keys that pivot to the contributor and the drive log.

name: Safecast bGeigie import batches
description: Each uploaded survey drive: import id, user_id, source.url (the raw .LOG file on S3), md5sum, status and status_details, measurements_count, lines_count, approved flag, created/updated, name, description, credits, height, orientation and the cities covered — often in Japanese. Not present in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Safecast bGeigie import detail
description: One survey batch with the downloadable raw log URL, checksum, per-stage processing status, 4,147 measurement count, contributor credits and the route description. Links a named volunteer to a geolocated radiation survey.

name: EMODnet offshore hydrocarbon wells
description: Every offshore well in European waters as a point: code, name, country, year, purpose (Exploration/Production), content (Natural Gas/Oil), status (Abandoned/Producing), named operator and company, water depth and distance to coast. Paginable with count/startIndex.

name: EMODnet offshore platforms
description: Offshore installations: platformid, name, country, current_status, category (Fixed steel etc.), function, named operator, location_blocks (licence block ids), primary_production, topside and substructure weights, production_start, valid_from/valid_to, water_depth and remarks.

name: EMODnet subsea pipelines
description: Pipeline routes as MultiLineString with name, status, medium carried, operator, size_in (diameter), length_m, year, from_loc/to_loc endpoints, country code and source agency note.

name: EMODnet coastal nuclear power plants
description: Per-reactor records: site code and name, country, status (Operational / Permanently shut down), reactor count, thermal/gross/net capacity MW, reactor name, reactor type and model, fuel, cooling water source, named operator, NSSS vendor, start year.

name: EMODnet urban waste water treatment plants
description: UWWTD plants: uwwcode, uwwname, country, status, capacit_pe, treatment level, nremoval/premoval flags, UV/chlorination/ozonation/sand/micro filtration flags, and compliance pass-fail per parameter (bod5_tp, cod_tp, tss_tp, ntot_tp, ptot_tp) with load in population equivalent. Regulatory compliance per named facility.

name: EMODnet waste water discharge points
description: Discharge outfalls: dcpcode, dcpname, country, NUTS3 region, state, year, the uwwcode of the plant discharging (join key to treatmentplants), receiving water body type and id, WFD river basin district, sensitive-area classification and source dataset version.

name: EMODnet desalination plants
description: Desalination facilities: objectid, location and comm_name, country, NUTS3, project name, award_date and online_date, location_type, capacity_m3d, unit count and unit_size_m3d, technology (RO etc.), feedwater type, plant_status and customer_type.

name: EMODnet marine aggregate extraction
description: Sand and gravel extraction sites: areaid, extraction_area name, country, sea basin, year, material, area_of_activity_km2, permitted vs requested vs actually extracted amounts in m3 and tonnes, extraction_type and distance to coast. Licence-vs-actual volumes per named area.

name: EMODnet dumped munitions
description: Located munitions on the European seabed: munition_type, free-text description (calibre, dimensions, chemical or not, condition, whether neutralised or blasted), reporting date and infoprov source (OSPAR), distance to coast.

name: EMODnet port locations
description: Port point registry with port_id (BE003, BEANR...), port and portname, country, coordinates, data source and a traffic flag. port_id is the join key into EMODnet's portgoods / portvessels / portpassengers throughput tables.

name: EMODnet lighthouses
description: Navigational light structures with arlhs_number, name, country, status (removed/relocated/destroyed or not), distance_to_shore_m, position relative to coastline and comments.

name: EMODnet ocean energy projects
description: Wave and tidal energy installations as points with country, sea basin, project attributes and coordinates. Companion layer to oenergytests.

name: EMODnet UK subsea fibre and power cables
description: Cable routes with pipe id and pipe_dtino, name, descriptive text of the endpoints ("EIDER PLATFORM TO OTTER TEMPLATE POWER CABLE P1"), diameter, fluid/type (FIBRE), status, exposed and untrenched flags and the named operator.

name: EMODnet Dutch (Rijkswaterstaat) subsea cables
description: Netherlands-sourced submarine cable route geometry with the Rijkswaterstaat attribute set. One of five national cable layers on this WFS (bshcontiscables DE, shomcables FR, sigcables, maltacables, rijkscables NL, ukfibrecables GB).

name: EMODnet French (SHOM) subsea cables
description: French hydrographic service cable routes as MultiLineString with catcbl category code, status and the INSPIRE feature id.

name: EMODnet German (BSH CONTIS) subsea cables
description: German Bight and Baltic cable corridors from the BSH CONTIS register, high-vertex MultiLineString geometry with the CONTIS attribute set.

name: EMODnet worldwide shipwrecks
description: Wreck register: wreck_id, wreck_cate (dangerous/non-dangerous), status, position and horizontal datum, depth with method/quality/accuracy, water_dept, water level regime, vessel name, type, flag state, length, width, draught and sonar dimensions.

name: EMODnet military areas (polygons)
description: Declared military and defence zones at sea as MultiPolygon with country (and up to three claiming countries), status, up to three type classifications (National Defence Area, exercise area...) and a resource URL to the declaring authority's chart.

name: EMODnet aquaculture zones
description: Licensed aquaculture production areas as MultiPolygon with country, species group and zone attributes. 337 KB even at count=3 because of polygon density.

name: Internet Archive item metadata
description: Full item manifest: every file with name, source, size, format, mtime, md5, crc32 and sha1, plus the serving servers (d1/d2, dir), alternate_locations and the item's metadata block. Turns any archive.org identifier into a verifiable file-level inventory. Not present in the tree (only advancedsearch and /details were).

name: Internet Archive advanced search with field list
description: Solr-style search returning numFound plus the requested fields per doc. The identifier field is the key into /metadata/{identifier} for the file-level hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Wayback CDX with explicit field list
description: Capture index rows as [original, timestamp, statuscode, mimetype, digest, length]. Requesting fl= explicitly (including digest and length) is what makes content-change detection possible — the tree's CDX calls omit it and lose those columns.

name: OpenAlex work record (detail)
description: Full work record for one OpenAlex work id: DOI, PMID/MAG ids, title, publication date, primary_location + source (journal id, ISSN, host org), open-access status/OA url, authorships with per-author ORCID and institution ids+ROR+country, referenced_works list, related_works, cited_by_count and cited_by_api_url, topics/concepts, SDGs, grants. This is the record every other OpenAlex list row points at.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex work by DOI (id pivot)
description: Same full work record but keyed by DOI instead of OpenAlex id - lets you enter the OpenAlex graph from any Crossref/DataCite DOI you already hold and come back out with authors, institutions, funders and the referenced_works edge list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex work by PubMed ID (id pivot)
description: Full OpenAlex work record keyed by PMID - bridges a PubMed/EuropePMC hit into OpenAlex's authorship+institution+citation graph without a name search.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex author record (detail)
description: One disambiguated researcher: ORCID, all raw name variants seen in the literature, works_count, cited_by_count, h-index/i10, and the full affiliation history as (institution id, ROR, country, type) x years - i.e. where this person worked and when.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works by author id
description: Every work attributed to one OpenAlex author id (meta.count=68 for the probe), each row a full work object with co-authors, their institutions and countries, funders and citation counts. The author->publications hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution record (detail)
description: One institution: ROR id, country, type, homepage, acronyms and alternative names, lineage (parent institutions), geo coordinates, works/cited-by counts, associated_institutions and repositories.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution -> associated institutions / roles
description: Trimmed institution record exposing the org-graph edges: associated_institutions (each with id, ROR, country, type and relationship=parent/child/related) plus the institution's roles as funder/publisher/institution. Turns one university into its hospital, campus and institute network.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institutions under a parent (lineage)
description: All 19 institutions whose lineage contains Kyoto University - the sub-institutes, hospitals and centres rolled up under one parent org, each a full institution record with ROR and geo.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution by ROR id
description: Resolve a bare ROR identifier to the full OpenAlex institution record (works counts, lineage, geo, associated institutions). The ROR->OpenAlex join key.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works by institution ROR
description: All works with at least one author affiliated to a given ROR org (meta.count=499,568 for U. Washington), full work objects with co-author institutions and countries. Institution->output hop keyed on ROR rather than OpenAlex id.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex authors at an institution
description: Researchers whose last known affiliation is a given institution (meta.count=45,762 at Kyoto University), each with ORCID, name variants, h-index and full affiliation history. The institution->people roster hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works citing a work (forward citations)
description: Every work that cites a given work (meta.count=1,239 on the probe), returned as full work records - not just ids - so you get the citing paper's authors, institutions, funders and date in one hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works cited BY a work (reference list, expanded)
description: The reference list of a given work expanded into full work records (meta.count=239). Backward citation hop - what the paper stands on, with each reference's own authors and institutions.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex related works
description: OpenAlex's computed related_works for a seed work, expanded to full records - useful for widening from one document to its topical neighbourhood without a keyword query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex source/journal record (detail)
description: One journal or repository: ISSN-L and all ISSNs, host_organization (publisher id) and its lineage, works/OA works/cited-by counts, h-index, is_in_doaj, is_oa, APC prices, country and society affiliations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex publisher record (detail)
description: Publisher entity: alternate/legal titles in many scripts, hierarchy_level, parent_publisher and lineage, country codes, homepage, ROR/Wikidata ids, works and citation counts. Corporate-parent chain for the scholarly publishing industry.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex journals owned by a publisher
description: All 5,031 sources hosted by one publisher id (Elsevier BV on the probe), each a full source record with ISSNs, OA status and counts. Publisher->portfolio hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex funder record (detail)
description: Funding body record: alternate titles, country, description, homepage, awards_count (2.17M for NIH), works_count, cited_by_count, h-index, and cross-ids to Crossref Funder ID / ROR / Wikidata.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex funders by country (JP)
description: 1,140 Japanese funding bodies (JSPS/KAKENHI first), each with alternate names in Japanese and English, awards_count, works_count and cross-ids. Entry point for tracing Japanese public research money.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex topic record (detail)
description: One of OpenAlex's ~4,500 topics: description, keyword list, subfield/field/domain hierarchy, works_count and cited_by_count. Lets a topic id from any work record be resolved to a labelled research area.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution autocomplete (name -> id resolver)
description: Cheap name->entity resolver: returns OpenAlex id, short_id, display_name, a location hint, external_id (ROR) and the filter_key to use next. The correct first hop when you only have an org name string.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works aggregated by country
description: Server-side aggregation: counts of 2024 works per institution country (200 groups, CN 1.28M / US 1.21M ...). Gives distribution context for any filter without paging millions of rows.

name: OpenAlex institution collaboration countries (aggregation)
description: For one institution's whole output (355,103 works for Kyoto U), the count of co-authoring countries. A one-request international-collaboration profile for a named organisation.

name: OpenAlex works by UN SDG
description: Works classified to a UN Sustainable Development Goal id (23.5M works for SDG 3 Health), full work records. Policy-relevant slice of the literature keyed to an official UN vocabulary.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works by institution lineage + work type
description: Compound filter demonstrating lineage (rolls up child institutes) combined with document type; 696 reviews from the Kyoto University tree, each a full work record with authorships and funders.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 study record (detail)
description: The full 83KB study record behind one NCT id: sponsor org and class, collaborators, EudraCT/secondary ids, arms and interventions, eligibility, outcome measures, every trial site facility with city/country and investigator contacts, IPD sharing, oversight and results section. This is the deepest single hop in the whole trials domain and was NOT in the tree (only list queries were).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov study with results + derived sections
description: Same NCT detail forced to include ResultsSection (participant flow, baseline characteristics, outcome measure results, adverse-event tables) and DerivedSection (MeSH condition/intervention mappings). 88KB for the probe study - the adverse-events-behind-a-drug hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov batch fetch by NCT ids
description: Batch resolver: up to many NCT ids in one request with a chosen field projection. Lets a list of trial ids harvested elsewhere (from a sponsor, a drug label, a paper) be hydrated in one call instead of N.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov studies that have posted results
description: Most recently updated studies that actually carry a results section, including whyStopped text for terminated trials. Full protocol sections inline; feeds straight into the results/adverse-event detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov site/facility projection by location
description: Trials with a site in a named place, projected down to NCT id + every location facility and city + lead sponsor. Turns a geography into the list of hospitals running trials there and who is paying.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov field cardinality statistics
description: For every repeating field (secondaryIdInfos, locations, armGroups...) the distribution of how many entries studies carry, with studiesCount per size. Tells a collector how deep each nested array can go before it truncates.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov enum field value distributions
description: Every enumerated field with its full value set and study counts (ArmGroupType, restrictionType, overall status ...). The authoritative vocabulary for building filter queries against the trials API.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API version + data timestamp
description: apiVersion and dataTimestamp (2026-08-14T09:00:05 on the probe) - a 84-byte freshness probe to decide whether a re-crawl is warranted.

name: Crossref work record (detail)
description: Full deposited metadata for one DOI: publisher, reference-count, license terms with delay-in-days and TDM urls, funder array (name + Crossref Funder DOI + award numbers), authors with ORCID and affiliations, container title, ISSNs, update-to (retraction/correction pointers) and assertion blocks. The DOI->funding+licence hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref DOI registration agency
description: Which registration agency owns a DOI (crossref / datacite / medra / op ...). Cheap 157-byte router: tells you whether to follow a DOI into Crossref or DataCite before spending a real request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref Funder Registry entry (detail)
description: One funder in the Crossref Funder Registry with its full hierarchy-names map - every child agency and institute rolled under it (for JSPS: MEXT, RIKEN, JAXA, JAMSTEC, JAEA, NIMS ...) plus alt-names, location and descendant list. Funder->subsidiary-agency tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works funded by a funder
description: 265,916 works acknowledging one funder id, each a full Crossref work record with award numbers, licences, authors and affiliations. The money->output hop for any registered funding body.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works filtered by funder DOI
description: Same funder->works relation expressed as a filter, so it can be combined with type/date/licence filters and cursor-paged through the whole 265k set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref member (publisher) record
description: A publishing organisation as Crossref sees it: primary and alternate names, total/current/backfile DOI counts (25.2M for Elsevier), DOIs-by-issued-year breakdown, all owned DOI prefixes, and per-metadata-field coverage scores (affiliations, ORCIDs, funders, licences, references).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works by member (publisher)
description: 25.2M works deposited by one publisher, full records including licence urls and ISBNs. Publisher->corpus hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref journal record by ISSN
description: Journal-level record keyed by ISSN: publisher, total/current/backfile DOI counts, DOIs-by-year, and metadata coverage ratios (affiliations, ROR ids, funders, similarity-checking, abstracts) - a quality/behaviour profile of a venue.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works in a journal (by ISSN)
description: 446,597 works published in one ISSN, full Crossref records. Journal->article-corpus hop, cursor-pageable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref DOI prefix -> owning member
description: Maps a DOI prefix to the Crossref member id and legal publisher name that owns it (10.1038 -> member 297, Springer Science and Business Media LLC). Cheap ownership attribution for any DOI string.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works filtered by author ORCID
description: Works where a given ORCID appears in the deposited author list - the publisher-asserted (rather than self-claimed) side of a researcher's record, useful for cross-checking an ORCID profile.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works with machine-readable ROR affiliations
description: 1,087,754 works whose author affiliations carry structured ROR org ids rather than free text - the subset where institution attribution is reliable enough to join against ROR/OpenAlex without string matching.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref works with field projection (select)
description: Demonstrates the select= projection: returns only chosen fields (here DOI plus the full author array with ORCID, affiliation name and place) so large sweeps stay cheap while keeping the person->institution edge.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOI record (detail)

A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Philadelphia Realty Transfer Tax / recorded deeds and mortgages
description: Recorder-of-deeds records: document_id, document_type (DEED, MORTGAGE, SHERIFF DEED...), display_date, street_address, zip_code, opa_account_num, grantors and grantees, cash consideration and total consideration. name: Philadelphia L&I building permits

name: Philadelphia L&I commercial activity / trade licences
